description:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. title: Product Manager (AI & Blockchain) LATAM
description:
About us:

Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.

The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.

Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.

As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager - Central
description:
About Sigma Computing

Sigma Computing is at the forefront of cloud-based analytics and business intelligence, transforming the way businesses leverage their data to make informed decisions. Our platform bridges the gap between complex data queries and business insights, providing an intuitive interface for users of all technical backgrounds.

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager with a deep understanding of analytics and business intelligence to join our team. This role is critical for ensuring our customers maximize the value they derive from our platform, with a direct focus on improving Net Dollar Retention (NDR) through strategic account management and growth initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Account Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers and influencers within our customer base, with a focus on high-value accounts.
  • Analytics Expertise: Leverage your deep understanding of analytics and business intelligence to guide customers in optimizing their use of Sigma Computing's platform. Help them understand their data and gain actionable insights.
  • NDR Growth: Develop and implement strategies aimed at maximizing NDR. This includes identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling, as well as reducing churn through proactive engagement and solution-oriented support.
  • Customer Advocacy: Serve as the bridge between our customers and our product team. Advocate for features, enhancements, and integrations that will drive customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Success Plans: Collaborate with customers to develop and execute success plans that align Sigma Computing's capabilities with the customer's business goals and objectives.
  • Educational Initiatives: Design and deliver training sessions, webinars, and workshops to increase product knowledge, adoption, and engagement among our user base.

Required Skills / Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in a customer success, account management, or consultative role within the SaaS, analytics, or business intelligence industry.
  • Experience navigating complex enterprise sales environments with multiple priorities and stakeholders
  • Strong analytical skills with a proven ability to solve complex problems using data.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a knack for building trust and driving engagement.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and grow customer accounts, specifically focusing on net dollar retention.
  • Experience with SQL, data visualization tools, and cloud-based analytics platforms highly preferred (Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery)
  • ETL experience
  • Experience implementing production business intelligence solutions

title: Logistics Executive
description:

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What you will do

  • You will coordinate global transportation of goods and ensure prompt deliveries based on our customer needs

  • You will manage communication with third parties to ensure smooth business operations

  • You will open new trade lanes by finding new partners across the globe

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)

What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.

Tools for Humanity (TFH) designs and builds technology behind World. World is building a real human network designed to accelerate people in the age of AI. title: Senior Embedded Linux Engineer (all genders) - Yocto · Python · IoT Edge
description:
This position sits close to the embedded world, but it isn't traditional microcontroller firmware work. You'll own the operating system foundation and platform layer of our IoT devices - building and evolving our next-generation embedded Linux image - and develop the Python application layer that runs on top of it, inside our dockerized main application.

You'll work down at the OS and hardware boundary while shipping features up in the application layer. Typical areas include:

  • Designing and maintaining our Yocto-based Linux distribution for ARM devices with limited compute

  • Security on device, inter-process communication, networking, scheduling, observation

  • Over-the-air (OTA) updates for both the OS and applications

  • Integrating peripherals - watchdog, modem, AI accelerator - and improving their observability

  • Bridging the system layer and the application layer through Python and Bash

The work spans from driver- and kernel-level integration in C/C++, to adapting our Linux distribution with Yocto to the underlying hardware layer, to debugging system-level failures such as memory leaks, up to writing the Python software that turns hardware capabilities into product features.

You will be expected to pass a live coding interview for this role.

What to expect

  • Embedded Linux Platform: Design, build, and continuously evolve the next generation of our Yocto-based Linux distribution for ARM-powered IoT

Most job ads are written by no one, for everyone. I want to do this differently.

  • 3+ years as a control system engineer or mathematician

description:
Rust Engineer

Location: Remote or Berlin (Office available)

At Deepslate, we are building Speech to Speech Voice AI models that sound and act indistinguishably from a human. And we believe everyone should be able to use them.

With its endless languages, dialects, accents, subtle intonations, and speech melodies, voice remains a highly complex unsolved frontier.

That is exactly why we started Deepslate.

Backed by top-tier investors from the Tech and AI sectors, as well as a major German VC fund, we are incredibly well-funded and moving fast.

We are building the future of communication.

We aren't trying to build another standalone platform; instead, we are the intelligence engine powering countless other applications. Whether it's integrated as a module by a CRM provider, plugged into another Voice AI platform, or directly embedded into an enterprise system by our integration partners, our model is built to work wherever it is needed.

Your Role

Many core parts of our model stack are written in Rust. At the heart of it is our inference engine, written entirely in Rust.

Your mission is to build and improve these systems. You will work on the inference engine, take ownership of other Rust projects, and help decide how everything fits together. We need someone who enjoys writing good Rust code and can design software that stays understandable and maintainable as it grows.

Our models need to respond in real time. The software you build will directly influence how fast and reliable they are in an actual conversation.

What You'll Do

title: Fullstack Software Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Wer wir sind

  

RNA Digital Solutions wurde 2016 als Industrial Tech Startup gegründet. Unsere Expertise liegt im Digitalen Maschinenbau und wir beschäftigen uns insbesondere mit der digitalen Auslegung und Herstellung automatisierter Zuführlösungen. In 2021 erfolgte der Anschluss des Startups an den Weltmarktführer in der Zuführtechnik, der Rhein-Nadel-Automation GmbH. Unser Fokus liegt zu 100% auf der Softwareentwicklung. Unsere Software-Teams verteilen sich auf die Standorte München und Aachen. In München entwickeln wir unsere Dienste für Künstliche Intelligenz und Simulation. In Aachen nutzen wir die Nähe zum Shop Floor für Sonder-Digitalisierungsprojekte und Shop Floor-bezogene Software. 

Die Kombination von jahrzehntelanger Erfahrung im Bereich Zuführtechnik gepaart mit modernsten Technologien im Bereich der künstlichen Intelligenz ermöglicht es uns, die Zuführtechnik von Morgen zu entwickeln. 

Zur Verstärkung unseres Entwicklungsteams suchen wir einen erfahrenen Fullstack Software Engineer (m/w/d) mit Sitz im Raum München. Die Arbeit erfolgt größtenteils mobil, jedoch ist eine regelmäßige Anwesenheit im Office in München vorgesehen (ca. 1 Mal pro Woche).


Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung: Du treibst zusammen mit dem Team den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung interner Apps zur Prozessdigitalisierung und -automatisierung voran. Die React-basierten Apps kommunizieren über REST mit verschiedenen Django-Backends/-Microservices. Die containerbasierte Architektur umfasst auch KI-/ML-Module sowie automatisierte Physik-Simulationen.
  • Aufgabenspektrum: Du wirkst von der Anforderungsaufnahme über die Implementierung bis zur Auslieferung mit.
  • Schnittstellen: Du arbeitest in einem dynamischen Umfeld und stehst im engen Kontakt mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen, um Nutzeranforderungen zu verstehen und umzusetzen.

description:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.

About the role

Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public. That is an unusually rich attack surface, and securing it is a genuinely hard engineering problem rather than a checklist exercise.
You would be our first dedicated security hire. We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own and elevate the end-to-end security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and open-source ecosystem.
This is a unique, hybrid role for someone who excels at both sides of security: actively breaking systems to find vulnerabilities (hands-on penetration testing) and actively fixing them (opening PRs, patching infrastructure, and managing supply chain risks). If you want to build a world-class security foundation for a fast-growing open-source and SaaS platform, this role is for you.
This is a hands-on engineering role, not a GRC or compliance one.

What you would do

Your first six months would focus on the first three points below. The rest is where the role grows.

title: Customer Evidence Manager
description:
Role Description

Dropbox is hiring a Customer Evidence Manager to own and drive the customer-proof infrastructure that powers our managed sales motion. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a commercially minded, creatively grounded customer marketer who understands that the value of a customer story is not that it gets published — it is that it protects customer trust, gives buyers credible, accurate proof and moves a deal forward. You are the editorial authority on what good looks like, not the person writing every script: execution (writing, video, design) is delivered through agency partners you brief and direct.

Enterprise buyers do not decide on brand claims. They decide on credible proof from organizations like theirs: customer stories, ROI evidence, video testimonials, peer reviews, and competitive validation. In this role, you will produce that evidence and ensure it reaches sellers and customers at the moments it can have the greatest commercial impact.

You will own the program outcomes and operational rigor — setting the creative and editorial bar for what makes a great customer story, directing the agency partners who produce the work, and deploying that proof into active deals — and measuring evidence's impact on pipeline, win rates, and sales-cycle velocity. You will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Campaign Enablement, and product teams to prioritize proof for the full suite of Dropbox products and solutions, including AI capabilities, multi-product platform adoption, and priority vertical workflows. You will get substantial senior Sales and Marketing leadership exposure and a direct, measurable line to revenue during a pivotal shift in how Dropbox goes to market.

Responsibilities

  • Identify advocates, coordinate outreach with account teams, manage consent and approvals, record participation preferences, and avoid customer fatigue.
  • Set the creative and editorial direction and maintain the evidence taxonomy, freshness, and discoverability of the asset library — case studies, ROI studies, video testimonials, peer/G2 reviews, customer voice, and competitive proof.
  • Manage the sales content library (Highspot, Deeto, or comparable) — organize assets by deal stage, customer profile, vertical, and product; set and enforce freshness standards; and proactively surface content gaps.
  • Run a recurring Sales–Marketing feedback session to understand seller needs, assess content performance in live deals, and prioritize new evidence.
  • Ensure the right proof reaches the right seller for the right deal stage proactively, and track evidence utilization by account executive and deal stage to close adoption gaps.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations to build campaign attribution and reporting in Salesforce, measuring evidence's influence on pipeline, win rate, and sales-cycle velocity.
  • Provide monthly reporting to Sales and Marketing

description:
Natera is seeking an Associate Director to lead a team of Bioinformatics Scientists in our Women's Health and Organ Health research organization. You will oversee the scientific planning and execution of research and assay-development of diagnostic projects, and you will be responsible for creating production-ready pipeline components. You will manage your team and its professional growth, the research strategy behind new product development, and the handoff of research work into production.

The role calls for deep experience in algorithm and assay development, NGS data processing across multiple modalities, and the full life cycle of diagnostic product research and development in a regulated (CLIA) setting. You will evaluate new technologies and NGS assays, implement methods to optimize performance, and help define the product profile from a bioinformatics perspective, with input from R&D, Product, and Laboratory Directors.

Primary Responsibilities:

Team Leadership and Development: Lead and mentor a team of Bioinformatics Scientists. Own their professional growth, their responsibilities, and the standard the team holds itself to.

Research Strategy: Own the research strategy behind new product development, from scoping through execution, working with cross-functional stakeholders on what the team takes on and in what order.

Assay Science: Lead bioinformatics analysis for assay development and optimization, and troubleshoot experiments alongside laboratory scientists. This spans multi-omic approaches including methylation and fragmentomics and other cell-free DNA (cfDNA) derived features. It also spans short-read and long-read sequencing and both hybrid-capture and amplicon target enrichment.

Study Design and Data Quality: Partner with laboratory teams on study design at the research and feasibility stage, covering new technology assessment, optimization, and performance determination. Make sure the resulting data holds up before anyone builds on it.

Analysis Method Improvement: Advise and prototype improvements to analysis pipelines, including variant detection, quality control, and modality-specific processing: methylation calling, fragment-size and end-motif analysis, error suppression for deep targeted panels, and structural-variant calling.

Production Readiness and Handoff: Move research prototypes into stable production workflows. Automate the routine parts of research data management, pipeline execution, and reporting so the team's time goes to science.

title: Strategic Client Manager
description:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Our largest fleet clients are hugely important to Flock: they have more vehicles, more data and more opportunity to benefit from everything our connected proposition can offer, and we want to give them an even better experience as we grow. We’re looking for a Strategic Client Manager to become the primary face of Flock for our largest customers, owning the relationship and making sure they get the very best from us.

Nearly all of our business comes through brokers, and that remains central to how we work: you’ll sit at the heart of the client, broker and Flock relationship, working closely with our Broker Development Managers and teams across the business to deliver a brilliant joined-up service. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution, and use AI day to day to prepare for meetings, understand accounts, manage client queries and improve reporting, freeing up more time for relationships and problem-solving.

description:
About Quandela:

Quandela is a European deeptech company building modular, scalable and energy-efficient spin-photonic quantum computers.

We develop the full quantum computing stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to control systems, software and applications. Our platforms are available through the cloud and as on-premises systems.

Our ambition is to build fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation.

The role:

We are looking for an AI Scientist to join Quandela’s AI and Quantum Machine Learning team in Massy (near Paris)

You will develop and evaluate machine-learning approaches for quantum computing, covering both:

  • AI for quantum systems, including calibration, control, decoding for quantum error correction;
  • quantum and hybrid machine learning, including rigorous comparisons with state-of-the-art classical methods, using MerLin, Quandela's framework for quantum machine learning.

You will work on research with colleagues across AI, quantum algorithms, software, product and hardware.

The Massy team is a central part of Quandela’s AI activities. This role therefore offers significant ownership and the opportunity to help shape and grow the team over time.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, implement and train machine-learning and quantum machine-learning models.
  • Develop AI methods to improve the calibration, control and performance of quantum systems.
  • Benchmark classical, quantum and hybrid methods using meaningful baselines and evaluation metrics.
  • Contribute actively to the development of the MerLin framework.
  • Contribute to publications and collaborations with academic partners, including research ecosystem.

title: Software Implementation Engineer
description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don’t choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself, then choose the challenge, choose Heidi.

The role

 

The Software Implementation Engineer is a hands-on technical delivery role at the centre of complex NHS deployments. At Heidi, the CSM owns the customer from day one: the relationship, the rollout plan, the path to renewal. The Implementation Engineer is the technical arm they lean on: the person who personally configures SSO with the customer's IT team, sets up and provisions tenants, delivers EHR integrations through to go-live, configures agents and custom builds, and gives every technical problem a fast diagnosis and the right owner — fixing what is configuration, and handing confirmed product defects to Support Engineering, who own and drive their resolution.

description:
Your way into the future

As a Working Student in Purchasing, you'll help keep our SAP master data clean, accurate, and reliable — supporting the planning and procurement decisions that depend on it every day.

  • Strong attention to detail and comfort working through large, messy datasets.

description:
Bis heute haben wir Immobilienprojekte im Gesamtvolumen von über einer 1 Milliarde Euro erfolgreich entwickelt und umgesetzt. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung und Schaffung von bezahlbarem Wohnraum in Deutschland und Europa.

Wir denken nicht wie klassische Immobilienentwickler – sondern wie Unternehmer: mit industrieller Haltung, Effizienzfokus und klarer Verantwortung für das, was wir bauen. Unsere Projekte entstehen durch tiefes operatives Engagement, partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und der Überzeugung, dass Schlichtheit, Kosteneffizienz und Qualität Hand in Hand gehen können.

„Anders gebaut, um anders zu bauen.“

Unser Ansatz

In einer Zeit, in der viele technologiebasierte Produkte immer leistungsfähiger, zuverlässiger und gleichzeitig kostengünstiger werden, ist der Wohnungsbau in Deutschland in seinen Grundstrukturen seit Jahrzehnten nahezu unverändert geblieben. Wir setzen uns zum Ziel, dieses Paradigma grundlegend zu verändern: Durch die Entwicklung eines standardisierten, hochgradig optimierten Ansatzes wollen wir die Baukosten drastisch senken und gleichzeitig die Qualität und Verlässlichkeit des Wohnraums deutlich erhöhen. Kombiniert mit der zunehmenden Nachfrage nach bezahlbarem Wohnraum, wird dieses neue Modell den Weg für eine effizientere, nachhaltigere und sozialere Stadtentwicklung ebnen.

Unser Unternehmen basiert auf der Überzeugung, dass Schlichtheit, Kosteneffizienz und Qualität Hand in Hand gehen können.
Durch die Eliminierung traditioneller, kostenintensiver Strukturen – sowohl intern in der Projektabwicklung als auch extern durch gezielte Einzelvergabe statt Generalunternehmermodelle – senken wir Kosten, beschleunigen Entscheidungsprozesse und erhöhen die Transparenz. title: Kommunikationsstrateg:in (m/w/d)
description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres strategischen Teams suchen wir eine erfahrene Kommunikationsstrategin oder einen erfahrenen Kommunikationsstrategen (m/w/d) mit Fokus auf Gesamtstrategie.

Du entwickelst Kommunikations- und Kampagnenstrategien über alle Kanäle hinweg – von der Analyse der Ausgangslage über Positionierung und Kernbotschaften bis zum Maßnahmenplan. Du bist strategische Schnittstelle zwischen Kund:in, internem Team und Umsetzung und sorgst dafür, dass Strategie, Social Media, Kreation und Produktion zu einer konsistenten Gesamtkommunikation ineinandergreifen. Du machst aus Analysen belastbare Empfehlungen und bringst Menschen in Workshops zu konkreten Ergebnissen.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung von Kommunikations-, Marken- und Kampagnenstrategien über alle Kanäle hinweg
  • Analyse von Ausgangslagen, Zielgruppen, Märkten und Kanälen als Grundlage strategischer Empfehlungen
  • Konzeption, Vorbereitung und Moderation von Workshops und Befähigungsformaten – inklusive dokumentierter Ergebnisse
  • Übersetzung der Strategie in Umsetzung: Social Media, Kampagnen und Formate entlang klarer Ziele
  • Datenbasierte Steuerung: KPI-Definition, Reporting und Auswertung
  • Direkte Beratung von Kund:innen – im öffentlichen Dienst genauso wie in der Politik
  • Projektverantwortung von der Konzeption bis zum Ergebnis, auch in intensiven Projektphasen

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Agenturerfahrung – idealerweise in strategischer Kommunikation, Kampagne oder Beratung
  • Sichere Analyse- und Strukturierungsfähigkeit: komplexe Zusammenhänge erfassen, auf den Punkt bringen, in Empfehlungen übersetzen
  • Sicheres Auftreten vor der Gruppe: Workshops konzipieren, moderieren und zu Ergebnissen führen
  • Starkes Textgefühl und konzeptionelle Stärke
  • Eigenständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude an einem Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen

Join us to expand our network and make an impact!


Your Role and your tasks:
As an Account Executive (m/f/x), you will drive our growth across Europe. In your role, you will be responsible for the entire sales cycle - from customer acquisition to contract closure. You will:

  • Build and maintain long-term customer relationships through proactive communication.

  • Create proposal contracts and conduct negotiations.

  • Attend trade fairs and events to generate qualified leads.

  • Collaborate on the development and implementation of sales strategies.

Now let’s talk about you:

  • You are a passionate sales talent with a hunter mentality, who is driven to succeed by building valuable and long-lasting customer relationships.

  • You have excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, in German and English. Any additional language is an advantage

  • You have a proven track record of overachievement and hitting sales targets.

title: Head of Finance & Data (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Zahlen sind deine Leidenschaft, und du willst die Datenbasis dahinter nicht nur nutzen, sondern selbst gestalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als Head of Finance & Data (m/w/d) bist du das strategische und technische Fundament für unser weiteres Wachstum.

In dieser vielseitigen Doppelrolle verbindest du messerscharfe Zahlenkompetenz mit einem echten Gespür für Datenarchitektur und Reporting-Infrastruktur. Du baust nicht nur ein stabiles Controlling auf, sondern gestaltest parallel die technische Grundlage, auf der unser gesamtes Unternehmen datenbasierte Entscheidungen trifft. Kurz: Du hältst uns den Rücken frei und lenkst aktiv unseren Erfolgskurs mit.

  • Strukturen schaffen: Du baust belastbare Controlling-Strukturen und Reportings mit einer klaren, zukunftsorientierten Steuerungslogik auf.
  • Finanzen im Griff: Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Finanzplanung, das Reporting und die strategische finanzielle Steuerung.
  • Data-Infrastruktur gestalten: Du treibst den Aufbau unserer automatisierten Datenpipelines voran (u. a. BigQuery, angebunden an Shopify, Klaviyo und weitere Quellen) und sorgst dafür, dass Kennzahlen zuverlässig, aktuell und zentral verfügbar sind.
  • BI & Controlling verzahnen: Du entwickelst unsere Dashboards und Reporting-Tools (z. B. Looker Studio) so weiter, dass Finance-Kennzahlen und operative Daten in einem konsistenten Bild zusammenlaufen.
  • Prozesse skalieren: Du etablierst effiziente, smarte Prozesse im Finance- und Data-Bereich, die mit uns mitwachsen.
  • Sparring auf Augenhöhe: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CEO zusammen und berätst ihn als geschätzter Sparringspartnerin in allen strategischen Finanz- und Datenfragen.


Das steckt in deiner Haut

title: AI Growth Marketer (m/w/d) - remote
description:
Deine Rolle

Wir sind ein kleines, agiles Marketing-Team. Jede und jeder übernimmt hier Ownership, entwickelt eigene Strategien und setzt sie selbst um. Seit wir konsequent mit AI arbeiten, sehen wir deutlich mehr Chancen zu wachsen, als wir bisher angehen können. Deshalb holen wir jemanden dazu, der sich alles übergreifend ansieht, die größten Hebel erkennt und sie selbst in die Hand nimmt.
Du verantwortest Growth-Projekte end-to-end, auf bestehenden Kanälen und auf neuen, die Du selbst findest. Du baust selbst, stellst selbst live in der App, im App Store oder auf der Website, und wertest die Daten danach aus. Die Wege sind kurz, der komplette Projektzyklus liegt bei Dir.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Chancen in unseren Produkten finden. Du gehst regelmäßig durch Website, App Stores, Content, Jobboards und den Funnel bis Premium und findest die Stellen mit dem größten Hebel für Registrierungen und Umsatz.
  • Chancen im Markt erkennen. Du schaust genauso nach außen: Welche Trends und Plattformen bewegen unsere Zielgruppe gerade, welche Segmente oder Märkte lohnen einen Einstieg, welche Wachstumskanäle sollten wir aktivieren, die wir heute nicht nutzen, und was machen Wettbewerber.
  • Chancen bewerten und priorisieren. Du schätzt vorher ab, was realistisch drin ist und was es bringt, und bringst eine Shortlist ins Team.

Über tonies:

tonies ist die weltweit führende interaktive Audio-Plattform für Kinder mit mehr als 10 Millionen verkauften Tonieboxen und 125 Millionen Tonies. Das intuitive und preisgekrönte Audiosystem hat die Art und Weise, wie kleine Kinder unabhängig spielen und lernen, durch seinen kindersicheren, kabellosen und bildschirmfreien Ansatz verändert. Tonieboxen wurden bereits in über 100 Ländern aktiviert, und das Portfolio umfasst rund 1.400 Tonies in mehreren Sprachen. Teil unseres tonies-Teams zu werden bedeutet, an einer inspirierenden Mission mitzuwirken: innovative und bedeutungsvolle Erlebnisse für Kinder auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft des Spielens, Lernens und der Fantasie.

title: Software Engineer - Simulation Platform
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Shape the future of Proxima’s simulation platform: imagine and build with us

title: Werkstudent Go-To-Market & Partner Management (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Mission

Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen.

Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde.
Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben.

Warum es diese Stelle gibt: Wir bringen ein neues Produkt an den Start, das unseren Partnerbetrieben einen konkreten Engpass löst. Technisch ist es fertig. Was jetzt zählt, ist die Einführung — und die passiert nicht über eine Mail. Sie passiert in Gesprächen.

Deine Aufgabe: Diese Gespräche führen. Du bekommst eine Einarbeitung und einen Gesprächsleitfaden. Nach acht Wochen sollte auch dieser Leitfaden noch besser sein, weil du hundert Gespräche geführt hast. Wer nur die Liste abarbeiten will, ist hier falsch. Wer wartet, bis jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt, auch.

Wohin die Rolle wächst: Sie startet fokussiert: ein Produkt, ein definierter Partnerkreis, ein Gespräch nach dem anderen. Sie ist aber nicht als Telefonjob angelegt, sondern als Einstieg ins Partner Management — eigene Partner, Ende zu Ende, von Erstkontakt bis laufender Betreuung. Wie schnell das geht, hängt an dir, nicht an einem Kalender.

Konkret:

  • ANRUFEN, NICHT ABTELEFONIEREN: Du stellst das neue Produkt bei Bestandspartnern vor. Nicht Skript vom Blatt, sondern ein Gespräch, das beim Gegenüber ankommt.
  • DEN PITCH WEITERENTWICKELN: Du merkst, welcher Einstieg funktioniert und welcher Einwand immer wieder kommt. Du behältst das nicht für dich, du änderst den Leitfaden.
  • ZUHÖREN UND ZURÜCKSPIELEN: Was Partner am Telefon sagen, ist die ehrlichste

title: Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d)

Focus is on delivering innovative solutions that meet customer requirements as well as regulatory requirements, particularly those related to safety and effectiveness. The deliverables contribute to increasing the competitiveness and commercial success of Dornier MedTech and its subsidiaries. Solutions are provided in a cost- and time-efficient manner and by strong collaboration with stakeholders across department and operational structures.
Specific Responsibilities

  • Development and implementation of power and control electronic boards for complex medical devices.
  • Creation of electrical circuit and wiring diagrams for complex medical devices.
  • Development and implementation of electrical safety concepts to assure product functional safety.
  • Implementation and execution of concepts for product cost reduction.
  • Collection and determination of technical requirements and specifications.
  • Create component and system specifications and other quality related documents such as risk analysis, DFMEA, test and verification reports, etc. in compliance with international requirements (CE, FDA, MHLW).

title: Finance & AI Automation Intern (Remote Part-time)
description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. The category is growing rapidly because AI doesn't work on bad data. Behind the product sits a group of three companies in two currencies, and a small finance team that keeps all of it correct. We're hiring a Finance & AI Automation Intern to run core finance processes and automate the manual work out of them.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll join the Finance team that covers Soda Data NV (Belgium), Soda Data Inc. (US) and NannyML NV, the Belgian company we acquired in 2025. The work is real from week one: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges across three entities, two currencies and three accounting systems.

The second half of the job is making that work disappear. Finance at Soda builds agentically: Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an experiment on the side. You'll learn a process, run it until you know it cold, and then automate it. Sometimes that means an AI agent on GitHub, sometimes a well-designed formula - you pick the right tool and defend the choice.

Customer engineers who spend their week inside broken pipelines at Fortune 500s. Customers who will tell you things nobody has published anywhere. description:
About Genesis AI

Genesis AI builds the simulation platform powering the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. Our flagship product, Genesis World, is a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house GPU-accelerated, path-traced photorealistic renderer. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world.

About the Role

A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem.

We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out.

The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't.

Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. Making that reliable is its own engineering problem: agents are non-deterministic, they fail in ways a mesh operator doesn't, and they need guardrails, structured outputs, retries and verification around them. description:
About the role

We're looking for an IT Manager to own the day-to-day IT that keeps the company running smoothly and securely as we grow. This covers our people's devices, the office network, the tools everyone uses, and the support they rely on. It's a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving practical problems and making everyday IT work well, reporting into the CIO and based in London.

A big part of the job is security in a practical, operational sense. You'll keep devices patched and well configured, control who has access to what, bring order to the software and accounts that build up as a company grows, and make joining and leaving smooth and secure. You'll operate the controls and standards that the security team sets, and you'll be the person who makes them real in day-to-day work.

You'll work across the whole company, so you'll need to balance keeping people productive with keeping them secure, and be comfortable being the go-to person for anything IT.

Job responsibilities

  • Own endpoint security in practice, including device configuration, patching, controlling local admin rights, and reducing unmanaged software

  • Look after workplace and network security, including the office network and keeping guest and corporate access properly separated

  • Manage software and licensing across the company, and bring order to tools that have crept in without oversight

  • Manage 3rd party vendors such as internet suppliers

We're looking for someone to build our security operations capability from the ground up. This covers how we spot when something is wrong, how we respond when it is, and how we keep improving both. It's a hands-on leadership role for the early stages, so you'll be setting things up and running them, not managing a large team from day one.

You'll design how we do detection and monitoring for security, decide the right mix of in-house work and outsourced support, and set up how alerts are handled and escalated. You'll also lead how we respond to incidents, working closely with our engineering and reliability colleagues, since a lot of this sits alongside how they already keep our services running.

This is a deeply collaborative role. In particular you'll work hand in hand with our site reliability engineering (SRE) team, since much of security monitoring and response builds on the same tooling and ways of working they already use to keep our services running. We want to avoid heavy, siloed processes and instead build a lean, practical capability that fits how the rest of the business works, bringing in specialist help where it makes sense.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

Today, our software is validated mostly against real hardware, a process that consumes airframes, range time, and crew while sampling only a handful of nominal trajectories. The cases we actually build for, such as degraded GNSS, sensor dropout, electronic warfare, and multi-agent situations, are rarely reached economically that way. Your mission is to establish the scenario library, execution strategy, and interface bricks to turn our existing simulation platform into a fast, reliable, and continuous validation engine.

This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role. You inherit an active team of four engineers across Paris and Lausanne, with a target of around eight by mid-2027. Beyond leading the team, you become the technical authority on our scenario-based testing: defining what runs across SITL, HITL, and CI, holding critical technical boundaries with adjacent teams, and bridging the gap between simulation fidelity and real flight data.

Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. 

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. 

The role:  

We are looking for a Head of Data Science to build Paddle's data science capability from the ground up. Our Merchant of Record model gives us a data position no PSP or billing provider has: subscription and pricing context alongside granular payment-outcome data, across thousands of software businesses. This role exists to turn that into economic value by putting machine learning and agentic systems into production.

The mandate is deliberately narrow and deliberately ambitious: data science at Paddle owns automated decisioning inside the product — traditional machine learning and agentic systems alike — not decision-support analytics.

We have a long list of candidate opportunities than we can fund, spanning payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance. We have a working hypothesis about which of these pays back first, and we'll share it — but part of the job in your first quarter is to pressure-test it, size the alternatives yourself, and tell us where to start.

title: STAGE - ASSISTANT(E) VISUAL DESIGN CREATION (H/F) - NOVEMBRE 2026 (6 MOIS)
description:
LA MAISON
 
Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai.
 
Pour accompagner la forte croissance de la Maison, nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) Assistant(e) en VISUAL DESIGN CREAT

title: Cdi - Knitwear Designer - Menswear & Womenswear
description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

Jacquemus was founded by Simon Porte Jacquemus in 2009 in Paris, France.

Dedicated to the memory of the designer’s late mother, the brand draws inspiration from a passion for culture. The Jacquemus ready-to-wear and accessories collections for men and women reference the French way of life and universal gestures of beauty, encompassing influences from fine art photography to decorative arts, cinema, painting, and sculpture.

Throughout the years, Jacquemus has staged runway productions in unique and unexpected locations, including a Parisian swimming pool, the Musée Picasso, a lavender field in Provence, a wheat field outside Paris, a salt marsh in the Camargue, and a beach in Hawaii. More recently, the brand has embraced settings such as the canal of the Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), the Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), Casa Malaparte (La Casa) and Auguste Perret’s Parisian apartment (La Croisière).

Based in the 8th arrondissement of Paris, Jacquemus is an independent fashion house with over 300 employees. Renowned for its fast-growing digital presence and its worldwide business spread, the brand has created innovative retail experiences around the world before opening its first permanent flagship store at 58 Avenue Montaigne in Paris in 2022. Following this milestone, international boutiques have opened in New York (SoHo), London (New Bond Street), Los Angeles (Melrose Avenue) and Dubai.

Within the Jacquemus Knitwear Design team, you will work across both Womenswear and Menswear collections.

Working closely with the Head of Knitwear Design, you will contribute to the creative development of the collections, from initial research and concept through to fittings and final product.

Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

La compliance ne doit pas être seulement de la documentation : elle doit devenir une réalité concrète dans les entreprises. title: Responsable des Opérations de Services (F/H)
description: Notre client évolue dans le secteur de l'Ingénierie et développe des solutions technologiques à forte valeur ajoutée destinées à des entreprises innovantes présentes à l'international.  Le/la Responsable des Opérations de Services assure la coordination des opérations de service et veille à la qualité des prestations délivrées aux client·e·s. Ce rôle stratégique contribue à l'efficacité opérationnelle, à la satisfaction client et à la performance globale.    Superviser les opérations de service et garantir le bon traitement des demandes et réclamations.  Organiser et piloter les activités des équipes de service réparties sur plusieurs zones géographiques.  Répartir la charge de travail et accompagner la planification opérationnelle.  Définir et déployer les programmes de formation et de montée en compétences.  Suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (SLA, délais de résolution, satisfaction client, qualité de service, utilisation des ressources).  Produire les reportings et contribuer aux revues de performance.  Identifier les axes d'amélioration continue et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires.  Analyser les incidents récurrents afin d'améliorer les processus et l'expérience client.  Collaborer avec les équipes techniques, commerciales et de direction sur les sujets transverses.  Contribuer à l'identification d'opportunités de développement de services auprès des client·e·s.  Prévoir 30% de déplacements majoritairement en zone EMEA    Indemnités Grands Déplacements  ,    Notre client recherche un·e professionnel·le disposant d'une solide expertise en gestion des opérations de service, support technique ou service après-vente dans un environnement technique et en management d'équipe.  La maîtrise des indicateurs de performance, de la gestion des escalades et des outils de ticketing ou CRM est attendue.  La pratique professionnelle de l'anglais est requise.  Connaissance des domaines de CEM (compatibilité électromagnétique), tests RF ou environnements de haute technologie similaires appréciée.  Prévoir 30% de déplacements majoritairement en zone EMEA    ,   Michael Page  est un cabinet de recrutement spécialisé depuis plus de 40 ans dans le recrutement en CDI, en intérim, en management de transition, ainsi que du recrutement de dirigeants et des recrutements volumiques, en France et à l'international.   Notre mission :  aider les entreprises à trouver les talents qui contribueront à leur succès et accompagner les candidats dans la réalisation de leurs ambitions professionnelles, dans une grande diversité de métiers et de secteurs d'activité

title: SALES & CUSTOMER SUPPORT SPECIALIST
description: Divisione BLOK DPI | CRAI S.p.A.      Una divisione in crescita. Molte delle più importanti realtà industriali del Paese già al nostro fianco. E una squadra che vuole crescere ancora.   BLOK è la divisione DPI di  CRAI S.p.A.  dedicata alla protezione dell’udito professionale.  Stiamo crescendo velocemente e oggi lavoriamo con  molte delle più importanti realtà industriali italiane , seguendo progetti che ci portano ogni giorno a confrontarci con aziende, stabilimenti e professionisti in tutta Italia.  Per continuare a crescere vogliamo inserire una nuova persona nel nostro team.   Cerchiamo una persona organizzata, proattiva, con attitudine commerciale e voglia di fare. Qualcuno a cui piaccia lavorare con i clienti, trovare soluzioni e far avanzare le attività.      COSA FARAI CON NOI     Entrerai nel cuore operativo e commerciale della divisione BLOK.  Sarai uno dei punti di contatto tra  cliente, commerciali, tecnici e azienda , accompagnando il cliente nelle diverse fasi del rapporto con noi.     Ti occuperai di:   gestire un portafoglio clienti B2B, comprese aziende strutturate e  Key Client ;  mantenere un contatto diretto e continuativo con i clienti;  effettuare  telefonate e videoconference  di supporto al cliente, sviluppo commerciale e assistenza nelle attività;  svolgere prime call esplorative con clienti e potenziali clienti;  preparare offerte commerciali e preventivi;  seguire le opportunità commerciali e supportarne lo sviluppo;  organizzare appuntamenti e coordinare le visite dei nostri commerciali e tecnici presso le sedi dei clienti;  supportare il cliente nell’organizzazione e nella gestione delle attività programmate;  coordinarti con i diversi reparti CRAI per dare risposte rapide e concrete;  seguire il cliente anche nella fase di  post-vendita , mantenendo e sviluppando la relazione;  individuare nuove necessità e possibili opportunità commerciali;  partecipare a  trasferte, incontri ed eventi . title: USM Strategic Programs Manager
description: Job Description:    Are you a strategic thinker with a passion for aviation and an understanding of Used Serviceable Material (USM)? Join Satair as a USM Strategic Programs Manager to drive profitable growth and shape the future of sustainable aviation solutions. In this pivotal role, you will act as the voice of the customer, leading high-impact strategic initiatives and building long-lasting relationships across the global Airbus network.   What The Job Is ...   As the USM Strategic Programs Manager, you will report to the HO ASCCU and be accountable for planning, organizing, and engaging with USM entities to evaluate and drive strategic projects for Satair. You will develop concrete objectives and account plans to ensure profitable growth and outstanding customer satisfaction for assigned strategic programs within Satair.  Your main responsibilities:     Partner with internal teams and USM entities to identify, evaluate, and deliver new profitable USM business opportunities by leveraging organizational synergies.    Act as the responsible Account Director and focal point for key strategic initiatives, managing opportunities throughout the entire USM program lifecycle.    Maintain excellent, long-term relationships with existing and potential customers, managing operations-related interactions, complaints, and rapid issue resolution.    Bring a strong airline and MRO maintenance philosophy to support departments, acting as the true voice of the customer.    Ensure support organizations fulfill their obligations in accordance with SLAs, supplier operations, and spares availability.     Travel is required for this position to effectively engage with both internal and external customers. You should bring a minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience working in an airline, MRO, or USM group, complemented by a proven track record of successful customer engagement and USM market knowledge in commercial aviation. Your excellent analytical skills will help you see the bigger picture and derive long-term strategic recommendations, while your outstanding presentation skills will enable you to build rapport across a complex network. A solid understanding of the aviation business-specifically regarding spares support, supply chain management, and maintenance obligations-is essential. You must also possess an excellent command of both written and spoken English    What does your next challenge look like?    At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.  We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan. title: Bliv Kundedirektør i Private Banking Syddanmark og stå i spidsen for et vigtigt vækstområde
location: Odense, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
description: Vil du stå i spidsen for et ambitiøst Private Banking-team og være med til at udvikle et af Nykredits vigtigste vækstområder? Som Kundedirektør i Syddanmark får du ansvaret for at drive udviklingen af både medarbejdere, kunderelationer og forretning i et område med stort potentiale.   Du bliver en del af et strategisk vigtigt vækstområde i Nykredit, hvor du får ansvaret for at lede og udvikle et dygtigt team af Private Bankere. Sammen arbejder vi for at levere den bedste rådgivning og skabe de bedste kundeoplevelser.  Vi søger dig, der ikke kun har evnerne, men også interessen for at opbygge og vedligeholde relationer, så vi i fællesskab skaber et godt samarbejde og gode relationer, både i teamet og på tværs i organisationen.   Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver at:     sikre, at strategien bliver omsat til konkrete handlinger i teamet  fremme medarbejdertilfredsheden, hvor samarbejde og personlig såvel som faglig udvikling er i fokus  være med til at sikre, at Private Banking er forankret i sunde værdier og faglig ekspertise  skabe et engageret team, der arbejder målrettet på at optimere kundeoplevelserne  formidle tryghed og tillid, så både kunder og kolleger oplever dig som en tillidsskabende og troværdig leder.       Er det dig, vi leder efter?   Vi søger dig, som er motiveret, resultatorienteret og har en solid faglig og relevant baggrund.  Din praktiske erfaring med at yde kvalificeret rådgivning til formuende kunder kombineret med din ambition om at tage kundeoplevelsen til næste niveau er vigtigt for os.  Du har et godt analytisk blik og en struktureret tilgang, og med dine kommunikative evner og din oprigtige nysgerrighed er du i stand til at identificere dine medarbejderes færdigheder og bidrage til deres udvikling.  Med din handleevne, medmenneskelighed og engagement skaber du resultater, der forandrer, nytænker og forbedrer vores relationer til kunderne, samtidig med at du bidrager til at realisere vores fælles mål om at skabe værdi, overblik og tryghed for vores kunder.  Til gengæld lover vi både udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan.   Dit nye team   Du bliver en del af et team bestående af 21 Private Bankere, fire formuerådgivere samt et team af investeringsrådgivere. Vi samarbejder bredt med kolleger i Nykredit, herunder både med Lokalbanker, International og Private Banking Elite.  Hos os betyder godt humør, højt aktivitetsniveau og gode resultater meget, og du skal være indstillet på en afvekslende hverdag, hvor du sjældent sidder på den samme plads to dage i træk.  Vi har en frisk og uformel omgangstone - og lægger vægt på et positivt mindset.  Du har primært base i Odense, men får også mulighed for at arbejde fra forskellige lokationer i Regionalbank Syddanmark gennem vores lokalbanker.   Vil du vide mere?   Du er velkommen til at kontakte mig, Direktør Private Banking, Bjarne Claussen, på mobil 25 27 03 76 eller mail BCL@nykredit.dk, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. description: Lead Meaningful Client Projects and Inspire a Team to Succeed      Are you passionate about delivering successful client projects while also helping people grow and thrive? We are looking for a  Project Manager & Head of Implementation  to join Ropo’s Project Office and take on a unique role that combines client project leadership with people leadership. title: Training Manager Market Area Southern Europe
description: Job Description   Job Location: Elancourt  Working Model: Hybrid  Training Manager Market Area Southern Europe   TRAINING MANAGER MARKET AREA SOUTHERN EUROPE    (France, Italy, Spain)    Are you passionate about developing people, improving ways of working, and building impactful training programs that support business success?  We are looking for a Training Manager for the Market Area Southern Europe to design, implement, and continuously improve training and onboarding across the region within internal organization and dealer network. This position is located in Elancourt, France.   About The Role   In this regional role, you will work closely with departments and stakeholders to identify training needs, develop practical learning solutions, and support managers in implementing and following up on training activities.  You will play an important part in ensuring that employees have the knowledge, tools, and capabilities needed to succeed in their roles, while helping strengthen onboarding, training quality, and consistent working methods across the region.  The role suits a confident, energetic communicator who is comfortable delivering training sessions personally, facilitating groups, engaging with new people, and influencing stakeholders through collaboration, urgency, and initiative.   Your Key Responsibilities     Collaborate with departments and stakeholders to identify training needs and ensure alignment with company objectives.  Design and develop training programs for new hires and ongoing competence development.  Build and maintain a sustainable onboarding program.  Analyse existing work processes and contribute to the development of improved working methods.  Evaluate the effectiveness of training programs and drive continuous improvement.  Work closely with other Training Managers across Europe to share ideas, align ways of working, and benefit from a strong peer network.  Support managers with implementation, follow-up, and practical application of training activities.  Support train-the-trainer activities by helping trainers become more effective in their roles.  Deliver and facilitate training sessions personally, ensuring an engaging, practical, and business-relevant learning experience.  Contribute as a member of the Market Area Southern Europe management team, bringing a training and capability development perspective to business priorities.  Act as the point of contact for external training providers.     What We Are Looking For     A bachelor’s degree and a minimum of five years of relevant professional experience are required, preferably in areas such as Consultative Sales, Sales Training, Learning & Development, or related commercial functions.   Candidates should demonstrate a strong understanding of sales methodologies, adult learning principles (pedagogy and work science), and the ability to design, facilitate, and deliver impactful training programs that support business objectives and drive effectiveness. title: People & Culture Manager:in (m/w/d)
description: People & Culture Manager:in (m/w/d) – Heizma, Wien   40.000 € bis 60.000 € / Jahr (Base + Bonus)      About the job    Recruiting mit Ownership | People-Themen von Anfang an mitgestalten | Wachsendes Energie-Startup   Heizma ist das komplette Paket für die Energiewende zuhause: Wärmepumpen, PV-Anlagen und Batteriespeicher – inkl. Energiemanagement, Förderabwicklung und allem dazwischen. Alles aus einer Hand. Seit über 2 Jahren wachsen wir stark und zählen zu den dynamischsten Energie-Startups Österreichs: über 60 Mitarbeiter:innen, 10+ Mio. € Umsatz 2025 – und für 2026 haben wir uns deutlich mehr vorgenommen.     Wer so wächst, entscheidet sich über die Menschen, die er einstellt – und darüber, ob sie bleiben. Genau das ist deine Rolle.     Der Schwerpunkt liegt klar im Recruiting: Du führst die Gespräche, füllst die Pipeline und entwickelst die Wege, über die wir an die besten Leute kommen. About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Expansion Manager to focus on market expansion and build and scale Distribusion’s airport transfer operator network across Europe. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to build a business within a company. Working within Distribusion’s broader airport commercial strategy, you will own a clearly defined sub-segment end to end - from identifying attractive markets and securing operator partnerships to launching them and delivering measurable commercial growth.
You will have the opportunity to build the approach from scratch, deliver highly visible results and take on broader responsibility as the segment scales.


What you will do

  • Translate the broader airport strategy into a prioritised expansion plan, based on market potential, coverage gaps and clear business cases

  • Build a repeatable market-entry playbook, incorporating market feedback and lessons from execution

title: Service Techniker:in Photovoltaik (f/m/x)
description:
Über uns

Otovo ist ein führendes Unternehmen im Bereich erneuerbarer Energien, spezialisiert auf die Installation von Photovoltaik-Anlagen für Privathaushalte. Gegründet 2016 in Norwegen, sind wir heute in mehreren europäischen Ländern aktiv und seit 2021 auch in Deutschland tätig. Unser Ziel: Solarenergie für alle zugänglich, kosteneffizient und unkompliziert zu machen.

Otovo wurde gegründet, um ein einfaches, aber wichtiges Problem zu lösen: Hausenergiesysteme zuverlässig und sorgenfrei zu gestalten. Unser Team legt Wert auf Sicherheit, technische Exzellenz und exzellenten Kundenservice. Wir glauben, dass verlässliche Energie keine komplizierten Prozesse erfordern sollte.

Dafür bieten wir unseren Kunden einen Rundum-Service – von der Installation bis zur regelmäßigen Wartung – und sorgen dafür, dass Probleme schnell und effizient gelöst werden.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Diagnose, Wartung und Reparatur von Photovoltaik-Anlagen, Batteriesystemen, Ladestationen für Elektrofahrzeuge und zugehöriger elektrischer Komponenten

  • Durchführung der regelmäßigen Wartung: Überprüfung von Verkabelung, Inverter, Batteriezustand, Funktionstests

  • Inbetriebnahme und Updates von Anlagen (Commissioning): elektrische Konfigurationen, Erdungskontrollen, Inverter-Parameter, ATS-Tests von Generatoren

  • Ausführung elektrischer Arbeiten, sowohl routinemäßig als auch außerplanmäßig

  • Direkter Kundenkontakt: Fehlererklärung, Lösungsfindung, Follow-up

  • Dokumentation: Einsatzberichte, Fotos, Checklisten, verwendetes Material

  • Einsatzbereitschaft bei Notfällen und Bereitschaftsdienst

  • Alle Tätigkeiten unter strikter Einhaltung der deutschen Normen (VDE 0100, VDE 0105, GSE-Prozesse angepasst auf deutsche Anforderungen)

description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI is being built into more products every month, and every interaction consumes tokens. As usage grows, the costs add up quickly. The first race was adoption. The next one is efficiency, because inference costs increasingly decide what companies can afford to build and ship. We are building the efficiency layer for production AI. Our systems make AI dramatically leaner, cutting token usage and lowering the cost of every interaction without giving up the quality standards that matter. We work with enterprise software companies, and we want to become a core part of the global AI ecosystem.

You will work directly with our founder and CEO on whatever matters most that week. title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
description:
The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability.

Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain.

This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing.

The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains.

title: Finance & AI Automation Intern (Remote Part-time)
description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. The category is growing rapidly because AI doesn't work on bad data. Behind the product sits a group of three companies in two currencies, and a small finance team that keeps all of it correct. We're hiring a Finance & AI Automation Intern to run core finance processes and automate the manual work out of them.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll join the Finance team that covers Soda Data NV (Belgium), Soda Data Inc. (US) and NannyML NV, the Belgian company we acquired in 2025. The work is real from week one: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges across three entities, two currencies and three accounting systems.

The second half of the job is making that work disappear. Finance at Soda builds agentically: Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an experiment on the side. You'll learn a process, run it until you know it cold, and then automate it. Sometimes that means an AI agent on GitHub, sometimes a well-designed formula - you pick the right tool and defend the choice.

As our Senior Sales Compensation Analyst, you'll own the system and the monthly cycle that make that happen. You'll run calculations in Xactly Incent, tie every result back to its source data, and give Finance a close it can trust. About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

We are looking for a Graphene Device Physics Modeling Expert, to develop and refine physics based models for graphene photonic devices. Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. The Senior SDRs who win here treat every "no" as a data point and every "yes" as a chair at the table.

title: Front-End Web Specialist (12-month fixed term contract)
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.
