title: Marketing Manager - Manda
description:
The company

It's still difficult for business owners to sell their business, or buy others, in the sub-£10m enterprise value market. Information asymmetry, lack of knowledge and low transaction values make it hard, and most M&A firms shy away from the segment because they can't serve it profitably. A generation of owner-managers is approaching retirement, and most of them have no realistic route to a sale.

manda exists to fix that. We match buyers with sellers in the part of the market everyone else ignores, and we finance acquisitions ourselves so buyers arrive pre-qualified and often pre-financed. We've sold the first businesses, funded the first acquisition loans, and we're now opening the platform up beyond the businesses that already bank with us.

manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders. Since 2012 iwoca has provided more than £4 billion in funding and its mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments. That backing is why we can serve this market where others can't: a deep footprint in the SME economy with 150,000+ UK customers, the data and infrastructure of an established lender, and the ability to build clean, automated processes instead of running an advisory firm on spreadsheets.

We're looking for a Marketing Manager to own how business owners find manda, iwoca's M&A platform. You'll be our first marketing hire, joining as we open the platform to business owners who don't yet bank with iwoca. Almost everything about how we reach them is still to be decided, and you'll be the one deciding it.

title: Senior Veterinary Surgeon - Small Animal

Salary up to £65,000 DOE plus Welcome Bonus up to £5,000!

 
 
At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.
 
 
Wilton House Veterinary Clinic is looking for an experienced Small Animal Veterinary Surgeon to join our friendly and highly collaborative team in a senior clinical capacity. This is an exciting opportunity for a confident clinician looking to take the next step in their career, combining a varied and rewarding caseload with the opportunity to support and mentor less experienced colleagues, while remaining focused on clinical practice rather than management responsibilities.
 

You'll be joining a supportive team that genuinely values collaboration, continuity of care, and high clinical standards. Working alongside certificate holders in Cardiology, Small Animal Surgery and Small Animal Medicine, you'll have the opportunity to discuss cases, continue developing your own clinical interests, and help support and mentor our new graduate and less experienced colleagues.

 

Our caseload is diverse and engaging, with patients including cats, dogs, rabbits, small furries, occasional exotic species and backyard chickens. title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
description:
Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit.

The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible.

The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability.

title: Specialist, Business Process SOX and Internal Controls
description:

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. title: SEC Reporting Manager
description:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About The Role

Volta is building AI-ready data centre infrastructure across the UK, Norway, Germany, Spain and the US, and is preparing for a US public listing as a foreign private issuer following a Series A led by a16z and Altimeter. Getting our external reporting infrastructure ready - US GAAP financial statements, SEC-standard disclosures and input to the supporting close processes - is one of the finance function's defining projects over the next 12 to 16 months.

As SEC Reporting Manager you will build and run the external reporting process: preparing US GAAP consolidated financial statements and footnotes, drafting disclosures to SEC standard, and constructing the supporting evidence and tie-out discipline expected of a registrant. You will work directly with the Director of Technical Accounting and the VP Accounting and be central to the F-1 preparation and the first audited financial statements.

This is a build role, not a maintain role - you will create the reporting calendar, the disclosure checklists and the tie-out packs from scratch and see them through a first-year Big Four audit into a live registration statement.</

description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Kriya sits inside that story as Allica's platform for building new credit products. We already offer invoice finance to mid-market SMEs. We are now evaluating how best to launch unsecured lending products to SMEs, building on the well-known MarketFinance loans franchise, but backed by Allica's balance sheet, cost of funds, and 30,000+ SME customer base.

Role Description
Small businesses can't afford to wait around. When a cash flow gap or a growth opportunity appears, the SMEs we serve need funding that moves at the same speed they do, which is exactly the gap Kriya's unsecured lending products are built to fill.

We are looking for a Commercial Finance BDM to help drive new business across Kriya's unsecured, high-velocity SME lending products. This is an entrepreneurial, high-activity sales role: you'll build and manage your own pipeline of prospects, qualify fast, and take ownership of your numbers. Every conversation with a prospective customer is different, and how well you manage your own pipeline rather than any one big deal is what will make the difference to your results. You will also have Allica’s wider distribution network to make the most of.

The products:

  • Invoice Finance, Export lending, SME loans and working capital products

title: No-Code & E-Mail-Marketing Spezialist (m/w/d)
description:
Wir suchen jemanden, der E-Mail-Marketing wirklich versteht.

Nicht nur "Newsletter verschicken". Sondern den ganzen Prozess: Leads identifizieren, Daten anreichern, Kampagnen aufbauen, automatisieren, messen, verbessern. Von der ersten Domain bis zur sechsten Antwort.

Lippe Personal vermittelt seit 2017 Fachkraefte an medizinische Praxen in ganz Deutschland. Ueber 1.000 Stellen in mehr als 500 Praxen besetzt. 20-koepfiges Team in Duesseldorf. Echter Umsatz, echte Kundenbeziehungen.

Unser E-Mail-Marketing laeuft bereits. Wir generieren darueber jeden Monat sechsstelliges Auftragsvolumen. Aber wir wissen, dass da noch deutlich mehr drin ist, und genau dafuer suchen wir dich.

Was du bei uns machen wirst:

Du baust und optimierst unsere E-Mail-Outreach-Infrastruktur von Grund auf. Du recherchierst und scrapst Leads automatisiert, reichst sie mit Clay an und sorgst dafuer, dass nur saubere, relevante Kontakte in unsere Sequenzen fliessen. Du entwickelst personalisierte Kampagnen, die sich nicht nach Massenmail anfuehlen. Du baust n8n-Workflows, die repetitive Prozesse abnehmen. Du setzt Job-Scraper auf, die offene Stellen bei medizinischen Praxen in Echtzeit identifizieren, damit wir genau dann kontaktieren, wenn der Bedarf entsteht. Du ownes das Thema, kein Mikromanagement, keine endlosen Abstimmungsrunden.

Konkret bedeutet das:

Leadgenerierung und -scraping mit Prospeo, Apify und vergleichbaren Tools

title: Business Development Manager, EU Airport transfers (all genders)
description:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Business Development Manager, focus on Market Expansion, build and scale Distribusion’s airport transfer operator network across Europe.
This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to building a business within a company. Working within Distribusion’s broader airport commercial strategy, you will own a clearly defined sub-segment end to end - from identifying attractive markets and securing operator partnerships to launching them and delivering measurable commercial growth.
You will have the opportunity to build the approach from scratch, deliver highly visible results and take on broader responsibility as the segment scales.


What you will do

  • Translate the broader airport strategy into a prioritised expansion plan, based on market potential, coverage gaps and clear business cases

  • Build a repeatable market-entry playbook, incorporating market feedback and lessons from execution

title: Disability Claims & Underwriting Specialist
description:
This role is for one of our clients

Compensation: $80 per hour

We are partnering with a leading AI lab to train frontier models on high-quality insurance reasoning data. We're hiring Disability Claims & Underwriting Specialists to design realistic disability adjudication and risk-selection scenarios, evaluate model outputs against established industry standards, and help shape how the next generation of AI reasons about disability definitions, medical and vocational evidence, and benefit entitlement.

We welcome group and individual disability claims examiners, disability underwriters, vocational rehabilitation professionals, return-to-work and absence-management specialists, and appeals reviewers from carriers, TPAs and employer-side programs.

Requirements

What You'll Do

  • Design realistic scenarios involving short- and long-term disability claims, elimination periods, own-occupation and any-occupation definitions, residual and partial disability, offsets, recurrent disability and claim duration management
  • Create work products such as claim determinations, benefit calculations, medical and vocational evidence summaries, transferable-skills analyses, return-to-work plans and appeal decisions
  • Write "golden" reference responses at experienced disability-professional quality
  • Grade AI-generated responses against structured rubrics for definitional accuracy, evidentiary support, benefit-calculation correctness and procedural fairness
  • Identify misapplied disability definitions, unsupported functional conclusions, missed offsets, incorrect benefit math, and failures to document the administrative record
  • Provide written feedback the research team uses to improve model behavior
  • Participate in onboarding office hours and calibration sessions

You're a Good Fit If You

  • Have 2+ years of professional experienc

description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning

We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.

title: Junior Complaints & Compliance Specialist
description:
Complaints and Compliance Specialist

Location: Berlin (office first)

The team

The Complaints team sits within Operations and works every day to make sure merchants who run their businesses on SumUp get fair, fast, and compliant resolutions whenever something goes wrong with a payment. As payment volumes grow, so does the complexity of the cases the team handles, from delayed payouts to disputed chargebacks, and this role exists to build the specialist skills needed to resolve these cases with precision and care. Joining now means learning the mechanics of payment processing from the ground up, working closely with Risk, Engineering, and Finance, and helping shape how SumUp responds to some of its most sensitive merchant and regulatory moments.

What you'll do

  • Investigate and resolve merchant complaints tied to payment processing, including authorisations, settlements, payouts, and chargebacks
  • Dig into processor logs, payment gateways, and payout systems to find the root cause of each issue and document the findings clearly
  • Draft clear, compliant final responses to merchants that meet regulatory timelines and internal SLAs
  • Work closely with Payment Operations, Risk, Engineering, and Finance to unblock complex cases
  • Keep case documentation audit ready and flag emerging patterns or recurring issues to the wider team
  • Contribute to playbooks and knowledge base articles that help the team resolve future cases faster

You'll be great for this role if...

  • Foundational understanding of payment processing, covering authorisations, settlements, payouts, and basic chargebacks
  • Comfort working with a CRM or ticketing system, following SOPs, and keeping precise, audit ready documentation
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, customer friendly responses under regulatory constraints</

title: Engineering Manager | Applied AI
description:
We're looking for an Engineering Manager to own AI at one of the fastest-growing AI legal tech companies in Europe. Over 2,000 lawyers use JUPUS every day, and the AI behind it is already in production and already in front of customers. You'd own the team, the technical roadmap, and the standard everything gets built to.

You'll report to our Head of Engineering and lead our AI team. This is a leadership role, not a senior engineering seat with a lead title. You won't be shipping features yourself, and that's deliberate- we want someone whose leverage comes from the team they build and the calls they make.

Your Challenge and Opportunity in This Role

Legal work is document-heavy, judgement-heavy, and almost untouched by AI. We've trained on over a million German court rulings and handled over a million cases, so the hard part isn't proving AI belongs here. The hard part is doing it well enough that a lawyer will put their professional judgement behind the output.

Your job is to make that repeatable. The field throws up something new every week and most of it is noise. We need someone who can tell the difference, turn that judgement into a roadmap, and build a team that can actually deliver it.

Tasks

Leading the team

title: (Junior) CRM Manager (m/w/d)
description:
DEINE MISSION

Wenn du Teil eines dynamischen Teams sein möchtest, das die Lebensmittelbranche revolutioniert, dann bist du bei yfood genau richtig.

Deine Aufgaben als CRM Manager

Zur Verstärkung unseres CRM-Teams suchen wir im Rahmen einer Elternzeitvertretung zunächst für 2 Jahre einen (Junior) CRM Manager, der unsere Kundenkommunikation über alle Märkte hinweg operativ mitgestaltet.   • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Grafik, Content und dem Webshop-Team

DAS MACHT DICH AUS

title: Integrations Engineer (SDK)
description:
Voice is becoming the primary interface for technology. For the first time in history, we can use natural language to control and interact with our devices, services, and applications, and we're only at the beginning of the adoption of Voice and Physical AI across industries. Current voice interactions, however, still lack a fundamental human skill: nuanced understanding of audio scenes and environments. Navigating complex auditory scenes, distinguishing between multiple voices, or focusing on a main speaker are all part of the challenge of "teaching machines to hear like human beings."

At ai-coustics, we're building the audio intelligence layer and developer tooling to enable more robust and intelligent voice agents and Physical AI applications. Today, Voice AI companies like Perplexity, PolyAI, LiveKit, AssemblyAI or Telli use our SDK to prepare their agents for real-world acoustic challenges. Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month.

We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital, as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity. We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers.

Role overview

We're looking for an Integrations Engineer to make our SDK easy to adopt on the platforms voice agent developers actually build on. title: Platform Engineer (AWS)
description:
Voice is becoming the primary interface for technology. For the first time in history, we can use natural language to control and interact with our devices, services, and applications, and we're only at the beginning of the adoption of Voice and Physical AI across industries. Current voice interactions, however, still lack a fundamental human skill: nuanced understanding of audio scenes and environments. Navigating complex auditory scenes, distinguishing between multiple voices, or focusing on a main speaker are all part of the challenge of "teaching machines to hear like human beings."

At ai-coustics, we're building the audio intelligence layer and developer tooling to enable more robust and intelligent voice agents and Physical AI applications. Today, Voice AI companies like Perplexity, PolyAI, LiveKit, AssemblyAI or Telli use our SDK to prepare their agents for real-world acoustic challenges. Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month.

We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital, as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity. We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers.

Role overview

We're looking for a Platform Engineer to own our cloud infrastructure on AWS. Our SDK runs on customers' devices and servers, and every session talks to our platform: EKS clusters, Aurora Postgres, ElastiCache, CloudFront, Temporal, all managed with Terraform and GitOps. You will be the single accountable owner of this platform: its reliability, security, cost and the deployment pipelines the engineering teams rely on.

title: (Senior) DevOps Engineer - Infrastructure & Security (m/f/d)

Du willst Infrastruktur nicht nur betreiben, sondern verantworten? Bei uns gehört dir der komplette Stack – vom Proxmox-Cluster im eigenen Rechenzentrum über Firewalls und VPNs bis zu AWS und den Deployment-Pipelines.

Testsieger ist eines der größten Vergleichsportale Deutschlands: 4,2 Millionen Produkte, Testberichte, Kundenbewertungen und ein integrierter Preisvergleich, der Millionen Nutzer zum richtigen Kauf führt. Ein 20-köpfiges Team mit direkten Wegen und ohne Konzern-Overhead.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb von Linux-Serverumgebungen (Debian/Ubuntu) – du weißt, wie man Systeme auch ohne Assistenz von A nach B bringt
  • Fundierte Netzwerkkenntnisse: TCP/IP, Routing, DNS, Load Balancing, Firewall- und VPN-Administration

  • Ansible in Produktion, Container

title: Senior Control Systems Engineer – Vehicle Dynamics & Abstraction (m/f/d)
description:
We are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer to lead the design and execution of robust control layers across a highly diverse fleet of autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will act as the critical boundary layer to the upper autonomy stack. As the industry transitions toward End-to-End driving models, your primary mandate is to ensure that high-level motion commands are executed sensibly and strictly safeguarded at the physical limits of the vehicle. 

Your designs will address complex, real-world scenarios rather than idealized environments. You will build control architectures that remain robust under severe, highly non-linear real-world conditions. This includes handling sudden tire slip, navigating challenging terrain such as mud, gravel, potholes, and dense vegetation, maintaining stability on steep inclines and side slopes, and delivering predictable tracking despite asymmetric system degradation, such as a damaged mechanics.

description: foodora is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.   Job Description    From groceries and flowers to dog food and phone chargers - these days, you can order just about anything through the foodora app. This level of convenience is made possible by the expertise of our Marketplace team. We're currently on the lookout for our next superstar Account Manager to join this dynamic group. In this role, you'll be the key ingredient in nurturing and strengthening relationships with our existing partners, ensuring that every collaboration becomes a mutual success story! If you want to be a part of reshaping the way people do their shopping, now is your time!    Your mission   Join our team and create an impact in the quick commerce revolution! We partner with retailers across various industries with a strong focus on grocery partnerships.    Manage a dynamic portfolio ranging from influential local businesses to the largest brands within the grocery and retail sector.  Educate our partners within quick commerce and analyze their performance on our platform to set a joint plan for future success, with a strong focus on developing their digital business.  Develop a successful collaboration with partners and create a commercial plan with primary focus on order and revenue growth.  Drive partner engagement and visibility by planning and activating promotions across your portfolio.    We are looking for a true foodorian who enjoys working in a  dynamic  environment and is eager to elevate our team. To thrive in this role, you'll need to bring loads of  energy  and  drive - we are not just closing deals, we are creating new consumer behaviors and we need you to take it to the next level!  Cooperation  is our secret sauce, and we believe that effective teamwork turns prospects into partners. Your  solution-oriented  mindset allows you to see a new approach instead of the bumps in the road. If you’re  responsible  and capable of juggling multiple tasks without dropping the ball, you’ll fit right in. Since you’ll be collaborating with various partners, building and maintaining  strong relationships  will be your bread and butter, driving our collective success   Qualifications     Minimum 4 years of working within B2B Sales or Customer Success with good results   Fluent in Swedish and English  You have a valid driver's license  Any experience from working with or within FMCG is a big plus.     Additional Information     Wellness allowance topped with the opportunity to participate in many work/life balance initiatives at foodora such as wellness hour & reduced price on massage.  Employee discount at foodora (woho!) and awesome friday break

title: Senior Account Manager
description: Willst du Veränderung und Wachstum bewirken? Willst du ein modernes, digitales Produkt auf partnerschaftlicher Ebene verkaufen? Werde dann als  Senior Account ManagerIn  Teil von Coople. Um diese Herausforderung anzunehmen, brauchst du eine gesunde Portion Ehrgeiz und eine echte Machermentalität. In dieser Position übernimmst du eine kommerzielle Schlüsselrolle, in welcher du unter anderem:     ... bestehende Kundenbeziehungen aktiv pflegst und weiter ausbaust. Du hast regelmässige Kontaktpunkte mit deinen Kunden (Cross- und Upsellingaktivitäten, Feedback, Renewals, usw).     ... deine Kunden fundiert und datenbasiert analysierst, und darauf aufbauend tragfähige Account-Pläne entwickelst, die als Leitfaden für nachhaltiges Kundenwachstum dienen.     … den Markt beobachtest und analysierst (bspw. Engpässe im Markt, Konkurrenzwissen), und interne Forecasts und Reports erstellst.     … die Schnittstelle zwischen dem Kunden und unseren internen Abteilungen (bspw. Marketing, Legal, Operations, Product Management) bist. Du planst und koordinierst die internen Kundenprozesse für deine Accounts.      Dein Profil   Wir suchen Kandidaten, die strukturiert mit ihren Kunden arbeiten und Spass am Erreichen ambitionierter Ziele haben. Ausserdem solltest du folgende Erfahrung mitbringen:      Idealerweise eine kaufmännische Grundausbildung und eine betriebswirtschaftliche Weiterbildung, aber vor allem dein Verkaufstalent und dein Erfolgshunger bilden den Schlüssel zum Erfolg  Du hast 5 Jahre professionelle Erfahrung in ähnlichen kommerziellen Positionen  Du hast eine Affinität zu digitalen Produkten generell, und bist ein echter AI-Enthusiast: du experimentierst gerne, lernst schnell und weisst, wie du neue Tools für dich arbeiten lässt  Du arbeitest gerne selbständig und erfolgsorientiert und kannst dich problemlos auf sich verändernde Strukturen und Prozesse einstellen  Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau und gute Englischkenntnisse sind unerlässlich       Bereit für deinen nächsten Schritt in einem dynamischen HR-Tech-Unternehmen?   Bei Coople verbinden wir Unternehmen und Arbeitnehmende über eine Plattform, die für flexibles Arbeiten entwickelt wurde. Als führende Flexwork-Plattform der Schweiz helfen wir Unternehmen, smarter zu planen und Menschen dabei, Jobs zu finden, die zu ihrem Leben passen. Unsere Werte – Agile, Collaborative, Empowering, Fair und Passionate – zeichnen unser Team aus und prägen unsere Arbeitsweise, mit der wir wirklich etwas bewegen wollen.     Ansonsten profitierst du bei uns von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und von einem Arbeitsumfeld, das begeistert. In unserem Zürcher Office ist für alles gesorgt: ein Kühlschrank voll deiner Lieblingsgetränke, zweiwöchentliche gemeinsame Company Lunches und regelmässige Team Events.

title: Customer Experience Manager
description: Position Summary   We're seeking a Customer Experience Manager to lead and transform the end-to-end customer experience strategy across Trojan Technologies' Industrial and Residential business segments. In this role, you'll design and implement scalable CX programs that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and loyalty across two distinct market segments. This is an opportunity to own a high-impact function at the intersection of strategy and execution, building a best-in-class customer experience practice within a purpose-driven, global organization.  You'll work closely with Sales, Product Management, Operations, and Service teams to align customer journey strategies with business outcomes and eliminate friction at every touchpoint. Success in this role means achieving measurable improvement in Net Promoter Score (NPS) and customer satisfaction metrics within 12–18 months, while establishing repeatable, scalable processes across the Industrial and Residential portfolios.   Detailed Role Responsibilities   In this role, you will:    Understand, identify, and translate customer pain points into measurable KPIs, actionable improvement plans, and strategic initiatives, by partnering with Customer Service and Field Service teams and ensuring the teams are appropriately structured, trained, and resources to deliver consistent world-class customer experience across APAC.  Establish and drive service excellence standards across customer service, field service, technical support, and aftermarket operations, ensuring alignment with customer expectations and business objectives.  Develop and implement regional service operating rhythms and performance reviews, ensuring customer experience KPIs are regularly monitored, reviewed, and acted upon across all functions impacting the customer journey.  Build and manage a Voice of Customer (VOC) program that captures actionable insights across customer segments, channels, and touchpoints to inform continuous improvement.  Drive cross-functional alignment by partnering with Sales, Service, Product Management, and Operations to resolve systemic pain points and improve journey performance.  Champion a customer-centric culture by coaching internal teams on CX best practices and embedding customer feedback loops into day-to-day decision-making.  Manage escalations and complex customer issues by establishing clear resolution frameworks that reduce time-to-resolution and improve customer outcomes.      The Customer Experience Manager will have direct ownership and accountability for the following customer experience and responsiveness metrics:     Commercial quotation response time  Customer inquiry response time  Order acknowledgement cycle time  Product delivery performance (On-Time-In-Full)  Service response & resolution time  Spare parts order fulfillment lead time  Spare parts on-time delivery  Customer complaint closure cycle time  Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)  Net Promoter Scor

Utvikle kunde- og forretningsstrategier basert på innsikt, analyse og kundebehov.  Designe fremtidige kunde- og medarbeiderreiser, prosesser og driftsmodeller.  Hjelpe kunder med å ta i bruk ny teknologi, AI og data-drevne arbeidsmåter for å forbedre kundeopplevelser og operasjonell ytelse.  Drive workshops, fasilitere beslutningsprosesser og samarbeide med ledere og fagspesialister på alle nivåer.  Bidra til forretningsutvikling, tilbudsarbeid og videreutvikling av våre fagområder innen CX Transformation     Din profil     Du har 3+ års erfaring fra management consulting eller byrå, med prosjekter innenfor kundeopplevelse, markedsføring, salg og/eller kundeservice  Mastergrad med sterke akademiske resultater  Sterk strategisk og analytisk forståelse, med evne til å strukturere komplekse problemstillinger  Du trives med å jobbe i tverrfaglige team og evner å bygge tillit hos kunder og kolleger.  Du har erfaring med å lede eller bidra til komplekse endrings- og transformasjonsinitiativ  Du har sterke kommunikasjonsevner (på norks og engelsk, minimum B2-nivå) og er komfortabel med fasilitering, presentasjoner og stakeholder management.  Du har en forståelse for hvordan teknologi, data og KI påvirker CX. Erfaring med CRM/MarTech plattformer (Salesforce/Adobe) er en fordel.     Hvorfor Vil Du Trives Hos Oss   Hos oss er det rom for å skape din egen rolle og karriere. Initiativ, samarbeid og utvikling er nøkkelaspekter når vi beskriver vårt arbeidsmiljø. Det finnes uendelige muligheter for å akselerere din karriere og utvikling. Vi har et sterkt fokus på menneskene i selskapet og ønsker å sikre at våre konsulenter har de beste mulighetene til å prestere og utvikle seg selv.    Spennende og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver i ett av verdens største konsulenthus. Du vil ha leveranseansvar, lede og/eller delta i tverrfaglige team for å skape varige resultater for våre kunder.  Tverrfaglig ekspertise, der du får samarbeide med markedsledende kunder og et globalt nettverk av erfarne konsulente

description: Gastgeber:in. Leader:in. Zahlenmensch. Gute Seele.    Vollzeit | ab sofort   Sie lieben Hotels, weil dort jeden Tag Menschen zusammenkommen? Sie können Gastgeber:in sein, Teams führen, Zahlen lesen und gleichzeitig dort anpacken, wo Sie gebraucht werden? Dann könnte das hier genau Ihr Platz sein.   Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die unseren gesamten Hotelbereich mit Herz, Klarheit und Weitblick führt. Jemanden, der Reservierung und Revenue wirklich beherrscht, Controlling versteht und trotzdem nicht im Büro verschwindet. Jemanden, der seine Teams kennt, seine Gäste kennt und am liebsten mittendrin statt nur dabei ist.  Aufgaben   Ihre Welt bei uns    Sie sind die zentrale Verbindung zwischen Reservierung, Rezeption, Housekeeping und Spa – und gemeinsam mit Ihren Führungskräften sorgen Sie dafür, dass aus vielen einzelnen Bereichen ein großartiges Gästeerlebnis wird. Leader:in mit Herz  – Sie geben Orientierung, führen Meetings, entwickeln Menschen und stehen hinter Ihren Teams.    Zahlenmensch mit Weitblick  – Reservierung, Revenue, Forecasts, Budgets und Controlling gehören für Sie selbstverständlich dazu.    Strukturgeber:in  – Sie behalten den Überblick, setzen Prioritäten und bringen Dinge ins Rollen.    Hands-on  – wenn an der Rezeption viel los ist, ein Gast etwas braucht oder im Housekeeping Unterstützung gefragt ist, sind Sie sich nicht zu schade, selbst mit anzupacken.    Troubleshooter:in  – wenn es irgendwo brennt, bleiben Sie ruhig und finden Lösungen.    Visionär:in  – Sie möchten nicht einfach verwalten, sondern unser Haus gemeinsam mit uns weiterentwickeln.    Sie arbeiten eng mit der Direktion zusammen , nehmen an den relevanten Tages-, Monats- und Strategie-Meetings teil und haben dabei immer eines im Blick: Menschen, Qualität und wirtschaftlichen Erfolg miteinander zu verbinden. Wichtig sind uns      Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Führungsposition im Hotel   sehr gute Kenntnisse in Reservierung & Revenue Management, Controlling, Kennzahlen und wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen   Freude an Führung, Kommunikation und Teamentwicklung   Organisationstalent und einen klaren Kopf – auch wenn es einmal turbulent wird   eine echte Hands-on-Mentalität   sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2)   vor allem: Herz für Menschen und Freude an echter Gastgeberschaft    Benefits   Und was erwartet Sie bei uns?      Ein Haus, das anders sein möchte. title: Consumer Marketing Manager
description: Vil du lede og utvikle fremtidens Consumer Marketing i Coloplast Norge?   I Coloplast Norge søker vi en ambisiøs, kommersielt orientert og strategisk sterk Consumer Marketing Manager som ønsker å være med på å forme neste fase av vår Consumer & Direct-satsing i samspillet mellom digitale og fysiske kontaktpunkter.  Dette er en nøkkelrolle for deg som brenner for å skape vekst gjennom innsikt, datadrevet markedsføring og sterke kundeopplevelser. Du vil ha et bredt ansvar for å utvikle og gjennomføre markedsstrategier som tiltrekker nye brukere, styrker konverteringer og skaper langsiktige relasjoner gjennom hele brukerreisen.  Som Consumer Marketing Manager blir du en sentral del av Consumer & Direct-lederteamet og får stor innflytelse på både strategiske prioriteringer og kommersielle resultater.   Om rollen   Som Consumer Marketing Manager i Norge vil du sikre at markedsføringen understøtter våre vekstambisjoner på tvers av produkter, kanaler og brukergrupper. Rollen kombinerer strategisk ledelse med operativ gjennomføring, og du vil samarbeide tett med salg, digitale funksjoner, nordiske og globale team samt eksterne partnere. Du vil være en viktig drivkraft i arbeidet med å skape sømløse brukerreiser fra første kontaktpunkt til langsiktig bruk av våre produkter og tjenester, en nøkkelspiller for å skape fremtidens Consumer & Direct forretning i Coloplast Norge.   Dine ansvarsområder    Strategi og vekst     Utvikle og drive den årlige Consumer & Direct-markedsstrategien i samarbeid med C&D lederteamet.  Identifisere vekstmuligheter basert på markedsinnsikt, brukerbehov og kommersielle mål.  Sikre at markedsaktiviteter direkte bidrar til økt brukervekst, konvertering og lojalitet.       Kampanjer og kundeopplevelse     Lede planlegging og gjennomføring av kampanjer, produktlanseringer og markedsaktiviteter på tvers av digitale og fysiske kanaler.  Videreutvikle brukerreiser og sikre en sømløs opplevelse gjennom hele kundelivssyklusen.  Styrke samspillet mellom Consumer- og HCP-kanaler for å skape en helhetlig kundeopplevelse.       Data og kommersiell effekt     Analysere markeds- og CRM-data for å identifisere innsikt og omsette denne til konkrete tiltak.  Måle, evaluere og optimalisere effekten av markedsaktiviteter basert på definerte KPI-er.  Sikre lønnsom og effektiv bruk av markedsbudsjettet.       Samarbeid og prosjektledelse     Drive tverrfaglige prosjekter på tvers av organisasjonen.  Samarbeide tett med salgsteam, nordiske og globale funksjoner samt eksterne byråer og leverandører.  Skape engasjement og resultater gjennom tydelig kommunikasjon og godt samarbeid.       Hvem ser vi etter?   Vi ser etter en markedsfører som kombinerer strategisk forståelse med sterk gjennomføringsevne.  Du er analytisk, kommersielt orientert og motiveres av å skape målbare resultater. Samtidig har du evnen til å se helheten, bygge relasjoner og samle mennesker rundt felles mål.  Du trives i et miljø med høyt tempo og mange interes

title: Support Lead
description: Support Lead till Carla   Vill du vara en del av ett supportteam som gör skillnad i ett av kundens största köp? Vi söker en trygg, engagerad och strukturerad Support Lead som är delaktig i att utveckla teamet och verksamheten och sätter standarden för riktigt bra kundservice.   Om Carla   Vi på Carla vill sätta en ny standard för hur man köper bil. Vårt mål är att göra det lika enkelt och tryggt att köpa eller leasa en laddbar bil online som att handla annat på nätet. Supportteamet har en avgörande roll i att skapa den tryggheten, från den första frågan efter leverans till situationer där något inte blivit som kunden förväntat sig.   Om rollen   I den här rollen arbetar du primärt med operativt supportarbete och visar vägen i hur vi bemöter kunder, bedömer komplexa ärenden och hittar hållbara lösningar. Tillsammans med teamet balanserar du hög kundnöjdhet med effektiva processer och god kostnadskontroll.  Du är inte formellt personalansvarig för teamet, men leder och samordnar det dagliga arbetet i Carlas supportteam. Du säkerställer att teamet prioriterar rätt, ger kunderna tydlig återkoppling och driver ärenden hela vägen till lösning. Du skapar förutsättningar för kollegorna att lyckas genom ett närvarande ledarskap, tydliga arbetssätt och stöd i svåra kunddialoger.  Du rapporterar till Support & Logistikchef och arbetar nära interna avdelningar likväl externa samarbetspartners och intressenter.   Ditt uppdrag     Hantera supportärenden genom att ge våra kunder en exeptionell kundupplevelse  Leda den dagliga driften. Samordna och prioritera teamets arbete, följa upp kortsiktig bemanningsplanering och tillgänglighet samt säkerställa att kunder får återkoppling i tid.  Coacha och stötta teamet. Ge löpande feedback, vara ett bollplank i svåra ärenden och hjälpa teamet att utvecklas i kundbemötande, problemlösning och exekvering.  Säkerställa kvalitet och framdrift. Följa upp att ärenden dokumenteras, att överenskommelser hålls och att reklamationer, returer och återbetalningar hanteras enligt våra processer.  Leda i komplexa kundärenden. Stötta teamet i bedömningar utifrån kundunderlag, verkstadsutlåtanden, garantivillkor och försäkringsfrågor samt till fullo äga och ta ansvar i ärenden som kräver extra erfarenhet och omdöme.  Hantera eskaleringar. Följa upp negativa kundomdömen och vara ägare och drivande i ARN-ärenden med ett professionellt och lösningsorienterat mindset.  Ge nya kollegor en bra start. Stötta introduktionen och säkerställa att nya medarbetare blir trygga i våra system, rutiner och kunddialoger.  Utveckla arbetssätten. title: Päällikkö, konsultointi ja käyttöönotot
description: Oscar Software hakee  konsultoinnin ja käyttöönottojen päällikköä johtamaan konsultointitiimin toimintaa  ja rakentamaan kannattavaa, skaalautuvaa palveluliiketoimintaa yhdessä palvelujohtajan ja osaavan organisaation kanssa.     Tehtävä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden ottaa laaja vastuu suomalaisen ohjelmistoyhtiön konsultoinnin kehittämisestä tilanteessa, jossa siirrytään räätälöidyistä toimituksista kohti tuotteistettua SaaS-liiketoimintaa. Vahva asiakaspohja, oma tuotekehitys ja uuden sukupolven Oscar P1 -tuoteperhe luovat perustan käyttöönottomallien uudistamiselle ja nykyasiakkaille tarjottavien palvelujen kehittämiselle.      Oscar Software yrityksenä      Oscar Software on yli 20-vuotias suomalainen ohjelmistoyhtiö, joka tarjoaa toiminnanohjauksen, talouden, verkkokaupan ja digitaalisen liiketoiminnan ratkaisuja erityisesti teollisuuden ja tukkukaupan yrityksille.     Oscarilla on yli 700 asiakasta, noin 120 ammattilaista ja vahva, lähes 50 henkilön tuotekehitysorganisaatio. Yhtiön liikevaihto oli vuonna 2025 noin 14,1 miljoonaa euroa. Oscar toimii Tampereella, Espoossa ja Raisiossa. Kotimaisuus on Oscarille tärkeää, ja tuotekehitys tehdään kokonaan Suomessa.      Tehtävänkuva ja keskeiset vastuut      Tehtävässä vastaat noin 20 asiantuntijan konsultointitiimin johtamisesta, tuloksellisuudesta ja jatkuvasta kehittämisestä. Vastuualueeseesi kuuluvat ERP-käyttöönotot sekä uusille että nykyisille asiakkaille ja asiakkaiden liiketoimintaa tukevien konsultointipalvelujen kehittäminen.      Keskeisiä vastuitasi ovat:      • Johdat konsultointitiimin arkea ja varmistat, että yhteiset tavoitteet muuttuvat käytännön tekemiseksi.  • Vastaat konsultoinnin tuloksesta, resursoinnista, toimitusmalleista ja laadusta.  • Kehität käyttöönottojen kannattavuutta, ennustettavuutta ja yhteisiä toimintatapoja.  • Rakennat nykyasiakkaille palveluja, jotka auttavat hyödyntämään järjestelmää ja kehittämään asiakkaan liiketoimintaa.  • Vahvistat konsultointikyvykkyyttä ja tuet osaamisen jakamista yli tuotelinjojen.  • Kehität mittareita ja tiedon hyödyntämistä työn suunnittelussa, seurannassa ja päätöksenteossa.  • Vahvistat tiimin omaa vastuunottoa ja kykyä ratkaista arjen tilanteita.  • Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä myynnin, asiakaspalvelun, tuotehallinnan ja tuotekehityksen kanssa.     Tehtävässä odotetaan läsnäoloa konsulttien arjessa sekä kykyä muuttaa suunnitelmat konkreettisiksi toimintatavoiksi ja mitattaviksi tuloksiksi.     Kuulut Oscarin operatiiviseen johtoryhmään ja raportoit palvelujohtaja Jenna Tuomiselle. Johtamisvastuut on jaettu: sinä vastaat toiminnan ja tuloksen johtamisesta, palvelujohtajalla on hallinnollinen esihenkilövastuu ja kaksi kasvunvalmentajaa tukee konsulttien kehittymistä ja hyvinvointia.      Odotukset ensimmäisten kuukausien aikana      Ensimmäisten 1–6 kuukauden aikana tärkeintä on ottaa konsultointitiimin toiminta haltuun, rakentaa luottamus ihmisiin ja muodostaa selkeä kokonaiskuva asiakkaista, käyttöönotoista ja toiminnan nykytilasta.

title: Client and Delivery Manager - Major Engagements
description: Are you the person a client trusts within the first hour, even though they've never met you and someone else made the promise you now have to keep?      You might currently be a Research Director, Client Service Director or Client Director in a research or insights agency, or an Engagement Manager, Delivery Manager, Delivery Lead or Engagement Lead in software or product delivery. If you're properly embedded in that role, keep reading.      Datamine has championed data, analytics and AI for over 30 years. As organisations across Australia and New Zealand increasingly invest in AI and data-driven decisions, we’re seeking a Client & Delivery Manager to join our Client Services team to deliver projects and solutions to our clients.     If you want a role where your judgement is needed rather than just useful, this is it.     This is a full-time role based in our Parnell office.        About the role  An engagement lands on your desk the moment it's won, sold on a promise you didn't personally make, and it's yours from there: on scope, on margin, with the client's confidence intact. Getting the first big one right is what earns the second.     In this role, you’ll stand between a client’s ambiguous want and a technical team’s reality and make calls that stick with both sides, ultimately translating technical outputs into a compelling story to present back. You don't need analytics or data science depth; we have specialists for that.     You’ll build trust with a client who doesn’t know us yet, often under delivery pressure, and resolve disagreements between the client and the delivery team rather than passing them up the chain. You’ll talk about money without flinching, and you’ll carry the ongoing advisory relationship with the clients you hold: sitting with a senior stakeholder, asking what they're really facing, and shaping the next piece of work out of what you hear.     This isn't pre-sales or business development. It isn't day-to-day retainer or product delivery, and it isn't people management.        No two days look exactly the same, but your work will typically involve:      Taking handover of a newly won engagement from Sales, and testing the promise against reality before the client hears otherwise  Setting firm deliverables, acceptance criteria and a delivery plan before work starts, not after  Leading multi-workstream engagements end to end, on quality, timeliness and margin  Having the hard commercial conversation when scope or margin needs pulling back on track  Briefing the Owls and technical team on an engagement, then trusting them to run it  Catching a wrong number or a data inconsistency before it reaches the client  Sitting with senior stakeholders, unscripted, to shape the next piece of work  Converting a first engagement into a second, and building the relationship that gets you there  Updating core project management systems and reporting project progress to the wider team         What you'll bring      8-15 years of co

title: Manager, COA Scoring Delivery & Operations
description: IQVIA  Clinical Outcomes Assessments (COAs)  organization leads the industry in generating data to ensure that the patient voice is incorporated into the development and commercialization of medication and other drug/non-drug interventions.  The  Scoring Delivery and Operations Manager  will lead the end-to-end delivery and internal operational workflow for COA scoring. The role will work directly with clients and study teams to assess scoring needs and methodologies, define the appropriate IQVIA solution and delivery approach. The position will take overall responsibility for coordinating the ingestion of new scoring algorithms—from source-material collection and BRD development through scientific review, test-dataset generation, scoring-library programming, validation, QA and release across IQVIA’s scoring products. The position will also serve as the principal client-facing contact, providing expert guidance, clear progress updates and a responsive, client-centric experience. description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Applications will be accepted until October 13, 2026.

Role Description

As a Software Engineer on the Metadata team, you’ll build and operate the large-scale distributed databases that every Dropbox service depends on.   • Contribute to system design reviews, postmortems, and reliability improvements
  • Write high-quality, efficient code in Go and Rust for performance-critical systems

On-call work may be necessary occasionally to help address bugs, outages, or other operational issues, with the goal of maintaining a stable and high-quality experience for our customers.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong expertise in distributed systems fundamentals including replication, consistency, partitioning, and fault tolerance

  • Proficiency in Go, Rust, C++ or similar systems languages
  • Familiarity with consensus and coordination systems (e.g. Raft, Paxos, ZooKeeper, etcd)
  • Experience operating production services and participating in on-call rotations

Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We're at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, the context-engineering layer for AI-driven software delivery used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. We're investing deeply in making Develocity's unique data and decades of domain expertise accessible to both humans and AI agents, with trust, evidence, and explainability at the core of everything we build.

About Agicap


Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.

title: AI Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Karriere

Wir suchen erfahrene AI Engineers, die KI nicht nur demonstrieren, sondern produktiv bekommen – als Teil komplexer Business-Anwendungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden tragen müssen. Du bist Softwareentwickler mit echter Engineering-Tiefe, idealerweise mit Full-Stack-Erfahrung, und du bewegst dich sicher in Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS und/oder Azure. Du denkst LLMs, Agenten und datengetriebene Services von Anfang an mit – und weißt, wo sie fachlich sinnvoll sind und wo nicht.

Ein Schwerpunkt liegt für uns im Agentic Engineering: Systeme, die nicht nur antworten, sondern handeln – mit Tool-Zugriff, mehrstufigen Abläufen, Zustand, Fehlerbehandlung und klar definierten Grenzen. Genau hier trennt sich der Prototyp von der Lösung, die man einem Kunden guten Gewissens übergibt. Und genau hier brauchen wir Leute, die beides können: Modelle verstehen und robuste Software bauen.

Wichtig ist uns: Diese Rolle bleibt hands-on. Du baust selbst, du deployst selbst, du debuggst selbst. 

Bei nerdware steht nicht nur der Code im Mittelpunkt, sondern vor allem der Mensch dahinter. Die beste technische Lösung entsteht dort, wo Teamgeist, offene Kommunikation und gegenseitiges Vertrauen gelebt werden. Wenn du menschlich zu uns passt, hast du den wichtigsten Schritt bereits gemacht.

Wir arbeiten in einem Feld, das sich schneller verändert als jedes andere in der Softwareentwicklung. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, neugierig bleiben und Hype von Substanz unterscheiden können. Eigeninitiative, technischer Weitblick und die Freude daran, gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln, sind uns genauso wichtig wie ein respektvoller und wertschätzender Umgang im Team.


Deine Aufgaben

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Your Mission

As our AI-Enabled Governance Associate, you will help strengthen how lemon.markets runs and improves governance processes across third-party management, partner oversight, and operational controls in a regulated environment.

This role starts with a strong focus on third-party-related governance, including external providers, partners, and intra-group relationships. Over time, the scope can evolve further toward governance excellence, KPI/SLA monitoring, control effectiveness, and AI-supported process improvement.

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We're at the center of this shift. We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding; we strive to understand diverse viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
description:
Introduction

At a glance 

  • Location & work model: Berlin, hybrid
  • Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester (KubeVirt), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph
  • Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware
  • Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team
  • Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must

Why this role is special 

Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. 

SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time.

title: AI and Computer Vision Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

We want you as a hands-on AI and Computer Vision Engineer to build the perception capability behind autonomous close-proximity operations: models that estimate the relative position and orientation of non-cooperative spacecraft from camera images, trained largely on synthetic and lab data, and optimized to run on the compute we can actually fly.

This is a builder role. You write the training code, run the experiments, take the models onto embedded and neuromorphic hardware, and own the results.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as AI and Computer Vision Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

  • Designing, training and evaluating deep-learning models for 6-DoF pose estimation of non-cooperative spacecraft

  • Owning the full training pipeline: dataset generation and management, augmentation, domain adaptation between synthetic, laboratory and orbital imagery, experiment tracking and reproducibility.

  • Optimizing models for flight-representative compute (knowledge distillation, pruning, quantization and quantization-aware training) and benchmarking latency, memory and power against onboard constraints.

  • Porting and evaluating models on embedded and neuromorphic hardware, and characterizing the accuracy versus energy trade-off.

  • Building explainability and uncertainty into the pipeline so failure modes such as high occlusion can be debugged and the technology is a credible candidate for certification.

description:
Aortex entwickelt patientenindividuelle Stentgrafts für die endovaskuläre Behandlung von Aortenaneurysmen. Genau für diese Menschen entwickeln wir eine neue Prothesengeneration: eine ultradünne, präzisionsgewebte Polymermembran, kombiniert mit einem selbstexpandierenden Nitinol-Stent, gefertigt in einem patentierten Webverfahren und geometrisch aus der CT-Bildgebung des einzelnen Patienten abgeleitet.

Wir sind ein Startup in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase mit Sitz in Hamburg, gegründet von zwei Ingenieuren mit Erfahrung aus der industriellen Serienentwicklung. In Magdeburg entsteht gerade unser zweiter Standort, an dem wir unsere Entwicklungsarbeit bündeln. Unser deutsches Patent ist erteilt, die internationale Anmeldung läuft, erste Prototypen sind charakterisiert, und wir arbeiten eng mit universitätsmedizinischen Zentren und etablierten Auftragsfertigern zusammen.

Dafür suchen wir dich: Du bringst das Gesamtsystem aus Stentgraft, Stent, Katheter und Delivery-System technisch voran und baust die Prüfumgebung auf, mit der wir seine Sicherheit und Leistungsfähigkeit belegen. Du arbeitest an einem Produkt, das noch entsteht, und prägst damit, wie es am Ende aussieht.

Ein erheblicher Teil der betroffenen Patientinnen und Patienten ist mit den heute verfügbaren Standardprothesen anatomisch nicht behandelbar und bleibt deshalb von der schonenden, minimalinvasiven Therapie ausgeschlossen. Genau für diese Menschen entwickeln wir eine neue Prothesengeneration: eine ultradünne, präzisionsgewebte Polymermembran, kombiniert mit einem selbstexpandierenden Nitinol-Stent, gefertigt in einem patentierten Webverfahren und geometrisch aus der CT-Bildgebung des einzelnen Patienten abgeleitet.

Wir sind ein Startup in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase mit Sitz in Hamburg, gegründet von zwei Ingenieuren mit Erfahrung aus der industriellen Serienentwicklung und Strategieberatung. In Magdeburg entsteht mit dieser Position unser zweiter Standort, den du von Beginn an mit aufbaust. Unser deutsches Patent ist erteilt, die internationale Anmeldung läuft, erste Prototypen sind charakterisiert, und wir arbeiten eng mit universitätsmedizinischen Zentren und etablierten Auftragsfertigern zusammen. Vor uns liegt der Weg zur klinischen Erstanwendung und zur Zulassung eines Medizinprodukts der Klasse III, einschließlich der dafür notwendigen präklinischen Prüfungen und Tierstudien.

Dafür suchen wir dich: Du übernimmst die regulatorische Verantwortung für unser Produkt und baust unser Qualitätsmanagementsystem von Grund auf. Du gestaltest also nicht ein bestehendes System mit, sondern entscheidest, wie es aussieht.

  • Du entwickelst die regulatorische Strategie für Aortex in Europa und den USA, legst Konformitätsbewertungsroute und Zeitplan für unser Produkt der Klasse III fest und steuerst die Auswahl und Zusammenarbeit mit der Benannten Stelle.

description: Customer Success Specialist (Onboarding & Support)       Locatie: Amsterdam (kantoor)   Uren: 36 - 40 uur per week  Salaris: € 3.500 - € 4.500 bruto per maand o.b.v. fulltime en ervaring, plus pensioen en vakantiegeld  Taal: vloeiend Nederlands     Transportbedrijven kiezen voor Roadsoft omdat tachograafregels ingewikkeld zijn en wij ze simpel maken. Jij bent degene die die belofte waarmaakt op het moment dat het ertoe doet: de eerste weken van een nieuwe klant.      OVER ROADSOFT   Roadsoft maakt tachograafsoftware voor transportbedrijven. Sinds 2007 helpen we inmiddels meer dan 2.500 wagenparkbeheerders om aan de rij- en rusttijdenwetgeving te voldoen, zonder dat ze er zelf expert in hoeven te worden.     Ons platform leest tachograafdata uit, laat zien waar overtredingen zitten en zet ze om in concrete taken. De Digitale Assistent gaat een stap verder: via WhatsApp helpt hij chauffeurs onderweg met hun tachograaf en handelt hij overtredingen rechtstreeks met hen af. De planner of wagenparkbeheerder heeft er daardoor nauwelijks nog omkijken naar.     We zijn een team van ruim 30 collega's met een kantoor in Amsterdam.         DE ROL   We zoeken een Nederlandssprekende Customer Success Specialist die nieuwe klanten van de Digitale Assistent van getekend contract naar een werkende oplossing brengt.     Je plant de implementatietrajecten zelf in en voert ze zelf uit. Je belt de klant, richt het account in, neemt de planner of wagenparkbeheerder stap voor stap mee en helpt de klant om de chauffeurs met de juiste interne communicatie aan te sluiten.     Daarnaast ben je de vaste achtervang van ons supportteam. Loopt de telefoon over, is een collega met pauze of is het druk in de ticketbox, dan spring jij bij. Je hoeft niet elke hardwarevraag zelf op te lossen, maar je staat klanten goed te woord en zorgt dat hun vraag bij de juiste persoon terechtkomt.     Je werkt nauw samen met Customer Success, Support, Sales en Product. Omdat jij dagelijks ziet waar nieuwe klanten tegenaan lopen, heeft jouw feedback directe invloed op het product en op het onboardingproces zelf.      WAT JE GAAT DOEN    Onboardings inplannen: je belt nieuwe klanten, plant de implementatie-afspraak in en legt die vast in HubSpot. Je bewaakt de onboardingpijplijn, zodat geen klant tussen wal en schip valt.  Implementaties uitvoeren: je bereidt het account voor, controleert of data en koppelingen kloppen en loopt op afstand met de klant door de inrichting. Je legt uit hoe de Digitale Assistent werkt, wat chauffeurs gaan merken en wat de klant zelf nog moet doen.  Chauffeurs aan boord krijgen: een Digitale Assistent werkt pas als de chauffeurs meedoen. Je helpt de klant om hen goed te informeren en aan te melden.  Klanten wegwijs maken in het platform: je laat zien waar overtredingen, taken, meldingen en rapportages staan, en wat de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) bij een controle verwacht. title: Head of Customer Success, Support and Professional Services
description: Rockstar is recruiting for a global leader in urban forestry software and services. Their SaaS platform helps cities, counties, states, universities, nonprofits, and tree care companies inventory, manage, and grow their urban forests, with more than 20 million trees under management across North America, the UK and Europe, and Australia/New Zealand. They pair market-leading software with professional services, GIS, and urban forestry consulting so customers succeed from first login to citywide canopy goals.   The Role    The company is hiring their first unified leader for the entire post-sale customer experience. You will own three teams (Customer Success, Technical Support, and Professional Services) and be accountable for everything that happens after a deal closes: onboarding and training, adoption, support, implementation and paid services delivery, renewals, and expansion.  This is a people-management role first. You will lead a team of seven (two Customer Success Managers as direct reports plus a five-person Support and Professional Services team) and you own hiring, coaching, performance, and career development across all three functions.  It is also a player-coach seat in the most literal sense: you will carry a working book of business of your own, deliberately smaller than a standard CSM load, because the fastest way to lead this org well is to learn their customers, renewal mechanics, and delivery processes firsthand, not from a dashboard. You will carry their net revenue retention and gross retention numbers, and you will also run the day-to-day engine, a tiered technical support operation, an implementation and training practice, and a renewal pipeline that serves both a public-sector and private-sector customer base. You will set strategy at the leadership table and get your hands dirty in the queue, the pipeline, and customer escalations in the same week.   What You'll Own    Customer Success and Retention      Personal book of business:  smaller than a typical CSM portfolio, that you own end-to-end: onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion. This is how you earn credibility with your team and stay close to the details of how their processes actually work.   Renewal pipeline:  end-to-end in HubSpot (from closed-won handoff and app delivery through onboarding, growth, renewal quoting, and invoicing), including the long procurement and PO cycles typical of municipal, university, and nonprofit customers.   Retention targets:  net revenue retention and gross retention targets; churn prevention driven by engagement and product-usage health signals, with an early-warning motion rather than renewal-time surprises.   Expansion:  upsell and cross-sell of modules and services plus quoting for all paid services work.   Strategic accounts:  strategic account and cohort programs that deepen relationships with their most important customers. Du trivs med att arbeta proaktivt och ser affärsmöjligheter innan kunden själv efterfrågar dem. Du har lätt för att skapa förtroende och bygga långsiktiga relationer, och du går igång på att driva flera dialoger och projekt parallellt med en bra struktur. Utöver detta:       ✓ En genuin nyfikenhet på kundernas affärer och vilja att förstå deras mål och vision för att kunna hjälpa dem dit.     ✓ Erfarenhet av att självständigt utveckla och förvalta kundrelationer.    ✓ Bekväm med att använda AI i ditt dagliga arbete, för att jobba smartare och mer effektivt.    ✓ En grym förmåga att växla mellan ärenden; stora som små, och att se problem som en kul utmaning. En bra inställning löser det mesta!     ✓ Vara flytande i både svenska och engelska då vi har både kollegor och kunder i andra länder. Kan du även finska är det ett stort plus i kanten!        Vi förstår att du inte kan allt från start, så därför är det viktigt för oss att hitta rätt person med ett starkt engagemang, driv och vilja att lära - därmed kommer vi lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.       Vårt erbjudande     Ett företag med en kultur där work-life balance, personlig utveckling och eget ansvar står i fokus. På Viskan

location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: The Company   Sofar is the leading ocean intelligence platform. We've built the world's largest real-time ocean sensor network, turning billions of measurements into insights trusted by scientists, governments, and the maritime industry alike. Our data helps customers increase efficiency and reduce emissions — and our goal is to create the ocean intelligence needed to ensure a sustainable future for the planet we call home.  Our Wayfinder product runs on board the largest shipping vessels in the world, providing critical voyage optimization and real-time decision support for sea captains and shoreside operations teams. Wayfinder uses Sofar's proprietary marine weather forecasts — powered by our global Spotter sensor network — alongside accurate vessel performance models to deliver measurable fuel savings, emissions reductions, and CII compliance outcomes.   The Role   As Senior Customer Success Manager, EMEA you will be the primary relationship owner for Sofar Wayfinder customers across the EMEA region — one of our fastest-growing and most strategically important markets while also being the most regulated market and the one where the commercial case for voyage optimization is sharpest. You'll partner closely with fleet operators, technical and commercial shoreside teams, and vessel crews to drive adoption, deliver measurable value, and build the kind of long-term partnerships that anchor Sofar's expansion in the region.  This is a high-impact, high-visibility role. You'll be the connective tissue between Sofar's global Customer Success practice and a market that is redefining how shipping companies approach voyage efficiency and sustainability. You will be based in Copenhagen and work alongside our EMEA sales team, our product and data science teams, and our 24/7 routing operation. This is a senior individual contributor role with a high degree of autonomy. You will own your portfolio end to end, set the approach for how to serve your accounts in the region, and be expected to drive it without close supervision.   What You'll Own     The full customer lifecycle for Wayfinder accounts across EMEA, from onboarding and fleet activation through renewal and expansion.  Commercial outcomes for your portfolio: measured fuel and cost savings per voyage, adoption across the contracted fleet, and vessel-count growth within existing accounts.  Regular performance reviews with owners, operators, and charterers, evidencing delivered savings and translating them into the next expansion conversation.  Portfolio health, identifying risk early and resolving it with urgency across both shoreside and technical stakeholders.  Renewal and expansion conversations in partnership with the EMEA sales team.  The voice of the customer, synthesizing feedback into a clear input to product roadmap and go-to-market decisions.  Represent Sofar at maritime industry events across EMEA, in hubs including Copenhagen, Hamburg, Athens, Oslo, London, Rotterdam, and Geneva.     Req

title: Client Success Manager
description: Client Success Manager  til Readpeak Danmark     Er du god til mennesker, digital annoncering og til at få kunder til at lykkes – og har du lyst til at arbejde tæt sammen med nogle af Danmarks største annoncører og mediebureauer? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.     Readpeak er Nordeuropas hurtigst voksende programmatiske platform inden for Native Advertising, og vi søger nu en erfaren, dynamisk og proaktiv Client Success Manager til vores danske team.      Hvad kommer du til at lave?   Kort fortalt: Du skal hjælpe vores kunder med at få succes – og få dem til at få endnu mere ud af Readpeak.     Du bliver en betroet rådgiver for vores kunder og får ansvar for relationen fra onboarding og løbende rådgivning til kampagneperformance og strategisk udvikling.  I praksis kommer du blandt andet til at:      Opbygge og udvikle stærke relationer til nogle af Danmarks største annoncører og mediebureauer  Proaktivt rådgive kunderne med fokus på at skabe succesfulde kampagner og udvikle deres investering i Readpeak.  Blive ekspert i Readpeak-platformen og bruge din viden til at udvikle og eksekvere innovative kampagnestrategier, der understøtter kundernes mål.  Bruge data og performance til at identificere indsigter, anbefalinger og nye vækstmuligheder  Tage ansvar for onboarding og løbende uddannelse af kunder samt afholde strategiske sessioner, der gør dem endnu bedre til at bruge platformen og optimere deres kampagner.  Afholde kundemøder, performance evalueringer og strategiske sessioner  Hjælpe med tekniske spørgsmål omkring tracking og kampagne-setup  Samarbejde tæt med vores interne Sales-, Product-, Marketing- og Operations-teams og være kundernes stemme internt i Readpeak  Levere fremragende kundeservice, reagere hurtigt på kundernes behov og aktivt indsamle feedback, så vi løbende kan forbedre kundeoplevelsen.  Og selvfølgelig vil du også få lov til at eksperimentere med AI      Og så forventer vi faktisk også, at du blander dig.      Hvem er du?   Din uddannelse er ikke det vigtigste for os.     Det vigtigste er, at du har solid erfaring med digital annoncering, forstår data og performance og – ikke mindst – rigtig godt kan lide at arbejde med kunder.     Vi forestiller os, at du har relevant erfaring fra eksempelvis et mediebureau, en AdTech-virksomhed, en DSP eller en anden digital platform. Erfaring med programmatisk annoncering er en klar fordel.     Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:      Har 4+ års erfaring fra en kunderettet rolle, gerne inden for programmatisk annoncering, digitale medier eller SaaS  Har solid forståelse for programmatisk og digital annoncering  Er stærk til at opbygge relationer og kan tale med både specialister og senior stakeholders  Kan omsætte kundernes forretningsmål til konkrete kampagnestrategier og anbefalinger  Er analytisk og komfortabel med at bruge data til at finde indsigter og muligheder  Arbejder proaktivt og ser muligheder, før kunden selv spørger efter dem  Har kommerciel forståelse og motiveres

title: Teamleader till kundservice på JYSK

Vi fungerar som spindeln i nätet mellan våra butiker, onlineverksamheten och B2B, vilket innebär en vardag med högt tempo, snabba beslut och många kontaktytor. För att trivas hos oss gillar du en miljö med högt i tak, där egna initiativ och nya idéer uppmuntras.  På JYSK värdesätter vi våra medarbetare högt och lever efter vårt medarbetarlöfte: ”Bring Dedication - Meet Possibilities.”   Rollen som Teamleader   Som Teamleader ansvarar du för ett team på cirka 8-12 medarbetare. Ditt viktigaste uppdrag är att skapa resultat genom människor. Genom ett tydligt och närvarande ledarskap, kontinuerlig coachning och uppföljning hjälper du dina medarbetare att utvecklas, ta ansvar och nå sin fulla potential.  Du säkerställer att teamet når uppsatta mål inom både service och försäljning, samtidigt som du driver teamets utveckling framåt.  Du ingår även i ledningsgruppen för JYSK Kundservicecenter Sverige, där du tillsammans med övriga ledare förväntas bidra till verksamhetens fortsatta utveckling och vår ambition att bli Sveriges bästa kundservicecenter.   Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden     Säkerställa att teamet når uppsatta KPI inom service och försäljning  Coacha, utbilda och utveckla medarbetarna kontinuerligt  Genomföra daglig coachning genom bland annat medlyssning och individuella samtal  Ansvara för schemaläggning och bemanning  Rekrytera och anställa nya medarbetare  Säkerställa ett gott samarbete med andra avdelningar inom JYSK samt med externa partners  Bidra aktivt till utvecklingen av kundservicecentrets arbetssätt och resultat     Vem är du? Du vågar fatta beslut, tar initiativ och motiveras av att utveckla både människor och verksamhet.  Du har ett tydligt affärs- och kundfokus och förstår hur engagerade och välutvecklade medarbetare skapar goda resultat. Med ditt ledarskap och driv bidrar du till att utveckla både ditt team och vårt kundservicecenter. title: Arbetsledare med personalansvar till Kundcentrum

Befattningen erbjuder ett varierande arbete i samverkan med övriga sektioner vid garnisonen, arbete med förekommande system, allt ifrån fordon och vapenutrustning till sambands- och sjukvårdsmateriel. I teamet arbetar vi både tillsammans och enskilt, härvid ställs krav på dig att vara prestigelös samt ta stort ansvar för enskilt arbete. Vi ser gärna att du även har goda ledaregenskaper bl.a kommunikativ förmåga och social kompetens.  Stor vikt kommer att läggas på personlig lämplighet.   För att myndighetens uppdrag ska vara framgångsrikt förutsätts att alla medarbetare uppträder enligt den värdegrund som finns.
