title: Teamleader Customer Center
description: Blir du engasjert av ledelse, salg og kulturbygging? Da kan akkurat du være vår nye teamleder på kundesenteret i Sarpsborg.   Kundesenteret er ofte kundens første kontaktpunkt hos oss, og en viktig kanal for å leve opp til kundeløftet vårt – å hjelpe mye. Vi sørger for at kundene våre har forsikringer tilpasset sin livssituasjon og sine behov, og vi lykkes aller best når vi jobber som et team.  Vi ser etter deg som brenner for å jobbe med utvikling av mennesker, og som evner å skape entusiasme. Du legger til rette for at teamet ditt gleder seg til å komme på jobb.   Om rollen   Å være teamleder på kundesenteret handler først og fremst om å hjelpe andre til å lykkes. I rollen får du både personal- og resultatansvar.  En viktig del av hverdagen vil bestå i å trene og utvikle rådgiverne i salg av forsikringer. Du leder, coacher og følger opp teamet med fokus på kompetanse og utvikling av prestasjoner.  Et like viktig ansvarsområde er å jobbe med oppgaver knyttet til helse og arbeidsmiljø. Du tar aktivt ansvar for å fremme positivt engasjement, en sterk lagånd, og for å skape et godt arbeidsmiljø som er bygget på respekt og tillit. Ditt bidrag i utviklingen av kundesenteret er sentralt for at vi skal være en arbeidsplass hvor våre medarbeidere trives og har det gøy.   Om kundesenter Sarpsborg (region Øst)   I Sarpsborg er vi rundt 100 engasjerte medarbeidere som jobber sammen for å skape trygghet for kundene våre. Lederteamet består av 7 teamledere og regionleder, som sammen jobber for at våre medarbeidere skal få den utviklingen og coachingen de trenger for å lykkes. Hos oss har vi et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø, med kollegaer og teamledere med ulik bakgrunn og erfaring.  Vi tror på at trivsel og moro på jobb bidrar til at vi når målene våre. Vi er opptatt av samarbeid, og du vil jobbe tett med regionens lederteam. Samtidig får du muligheten til å bygge relasjoner og utvikle samarbeid med ledere i andre regioner. Vi jobber aktivt for å skape effektive samarbeidsprosesser på tvers av organisasjonen, og vi deler erfaringer og læring for å bli enda bedre – sammen.  Teamet du skal lede er et nyetablert dagteam med cirka 11 meget dyktige forsikringsrådgivere.   Vi tilbyr     Et inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø med sosiale sammenkomster  Karriere- og utviklingsmuligheter i Nordens største forsikringsselskap  Meget gode personalforsikringer, samt høy pensjonssparing  Et sterkt fagmiljø med høy kompetanse  En helsefremmende arbeidsplass med bl.a. økonomisk treningsbidrag  Moderne lokaler på Grålum     Hvem er du?   Vi ser etter deg som liker å lede mennesker, er selvstendig og dyktig til å skape samarbeid. Du er god til å bygge tillitsforhold, og tør å utfordre og delegere ansvar.  Du er resultatorientert, og kan vise til god måloppnåelse i det du har foretatt deg tidligere. Du liker å ta initiativ, er handlekraftig og evner å prioritere.  Du utvikler trygge relasjoner med respekt og varme, og du har evnen til å kombinere omsorg med tydelige forventninger

title: Key Account Manager - Harvey Norman NZ
description: Job Description   At the Electrolux Group, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.  Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.  Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home!   About The Role   As Key Account Manager, you will drive growth across a key retail partner by delivering revenue, profit and market share targets. You’ll develop and execute commercial plans aligned to business strategy, leveraging insights and data to identify opportunities, mitigate risk and influence outcomes.  You will lead account strategy, manage forecasting to meet demand, and partner cross-functionally to ensure strong execution across stores. Building trusted relationships internally and externally will be critical to maximising performance and delivering ongoing success.   What You’ll Do     Own and grow relationships with key retail customers, driving sales and performance.  Develop and deliver clear sales and marketing plans aligned to business strategy.  Partner with internal teams (marketing, category, supply and sales) to execute plans effectively in-store.  Use data and market insights to identify opportunities, manage risks and stay ahead of competitors.  Communicate regularly with sales teams to ensure strong execution at store level.  Lead customer meetings, reviewing performance, forecasts and promotional activity.  Manage key account administration including pricing, rebates, forecasts and business cases.  Proactively monitor performance and identify opportunities using sales, inventory and market data.     Who You Are     You are a highly driven, commercially astute National Account Manager ready for a new role that will challenge and develop you  Your background is within Whitegoods, Consumer Electronics, Retail or other ‘product’ related company   A confident communicator who can influence, present and connect at every level  Customer centric, with a natural instinct for uncovering needs and unlocking growth opportunities  Results-driven, with a strong track record of delivering and exceeding targets  A strategic thinker who thrives on turning plans into action and owning outcomes end-to-end  Data-savvy, able to translate insights into compelling commercial decisions  A skilled negotiator who builds trusted, long-term partnerships with senior stakeholders  Highly organised and adaptable, with the ability to juggle priorities and keep things moving  Experienced in managing weekly forecasts, ensuring accuracy and alignment between supply and demand  Power Bi and SAP experience would be advantageous     Core Competencies     Ambitious - You always strive for b

title: Key Account Manager - Service
description: KONE Middle East, Turkey & Africa (KMTA) is embarking upon an exciting growth phase, and to complement our growth plans and drive our sustainable success with customer strategy, Service is a strategic priority for our Business.  As part of this effort, we are looking for an energetic and enthusiastic Key Account Manager with a strong customer-focused mindset to be based in our Doha, Qatar office and report to the Deputy GM & Head of Sales for Qatar.  In this role, the Key Account Manager is responsible for developing mutually beneficial relationships between KONE and customers who are strategic or nationally/locally important. He/she maximizes KONE’s current and future share of the customer’s business by identifying solutions and developing processes that add value to both KONE and the customer.   Key Responsibilities:    Customer Relationship Management     Accountable for managing strategic and/or Core 1 customers assigned to him/her  Accountable for accuracy of customer data and hierarchies.  Accountable for customer plans, their approval, and follow-up with the unit management  Accountable for building and coordinating relationships on many levels between customers’ organization and KONE as well as other stakeholders.  Responsible for evaluating any commercial or operational risks or customer complaints related to the account and raising them with the Management team.     Sales     Responsible for creating and managing opportunities in his/her customer base with the account teams  Responsible for sharing customer knowledge and contacts to support other account team members to win the orders  Creates value propositions with clearly described benefits of KONE solutions for customers’ needs  Accountable for national or frame agreements and managing the customer’s contract portfolio  Responsible for developing the profitability of the customers’ business with KONE according to the account plan.     What We’re Looking For:     Tender & Contract Management: Proven experience managing governmental/public tenders, including reviewing ITT (Invitation to Tender) requirements, completing customer-specific tender documentation/templates, and managing RFIs to clarify requirements with clients before submission. Experience in negotiating contractual terms and conditions, rather than solely commercial terms or scope of work, is also required.  We’re seeking someone with a strong customer-first mindset who is proactive, analytical, and passionate about delivering results  Bachelor’s degree holder  Minimum of 5 years of sales experience, with a strong background in business development and prospecting. Experience within the Elevator industry will be an added advantage.  Proven track record of handling key accounts and delivering commercial success.  Strong commercial acumen, excellent negotiation and presentation skills.  A natural relationship builder who thrives on collaboration and influence.  Excellent English communication skills.

title: Key Account Manager Sector Industrial - Bilbao
description: Si, como nosotros, trabajas mejor cuando se confía en ti, súmate a nuestro equipo >>   Porque en Elis sabemos que podemos contar con las personas que forman parte de nuestro equipo, les damos responsabilidades, les formamos y les ayudamos a crecer. ¡Creemos en ti y en el poder del equipo para lograr nuestros objetivos!  Unirse a Elis significa también elegir un grupo francés con presencia internacional, sólido, humano y comprometido con la economía circular desde hace más de 75 años. ¿Nuestra misión? Alquiler y mantenimiento de artículos textiles, de higiene y bienestar para profesionales. ¡Y hacemos todo esto combinando siempre altos estándares con nuestro enfoque de Responsabilidad Social Corporativa!   ¿Conoces muchas empresas que tengan más de 100 años y sigan siendo el número uno?    ¡Don’t choose Elis si no quieres asumir retos!   ¡Si te motiva gestionar relaciones clave con clientes, impulsar el crecimiento comercial y asegurar la satisfacción de los mismos, esta oferta es para ti!  En nuestra empresa, el/la Key Account Manager se encargará de dirigir la gestión de las cuentas estratégicas, optimizando la relación con nuestros principales clientes y asegurando el cumplimiento de sus expectativas. Serás responsable de mantener una comunicación fluida, cumplir con los estándares de calidad del sector y responder a las demandas comerciales, contribuyendo al crecimiento de la compañía. Responsabilidades, liderazgo, remuneración motivadora, ¿te sientes tentado/a?  ¿Sí? Entonces, únete a nosotros >>  ¿Cómo será tu día a día?    Llevarás a cabo la gestión de las cuentas clave de los clientes del sector industrial  Supervisarás el servicio a los mismos anticipando posibles necesidades y resolviendo aquellas incidencias que puedan derivarse  Serás el/la responsable de llevar a cabo la negociación con los clientes tanto para los contratos de servicio como para actualización de las tarifas  Te enfocarás en mejorar y ampliar las relaciones con los clientes, centrándote en poder crecer a nivel interno en las cuentas más estratégicas  Te convertirás en la persona de confianza para los clientes, estableciendo relaciones a largo plazo con ellos     Nos encantaría que formes parte del equipo si…     Tienes formación en Comercio, Ventas, ADE o similar.  Aportas más de 3 años de experiencia en puestos similares en el área comercial.  Capacidad para trabajar por objetivos y enfocado/a en el buen servicio al cliente  Eres una persona analítica con habilidades para liderar el cambio, siendo capaz de hacer propuestas de mejora  Sabes cómo motivar y acompañar a tus compañeros/as, inspirando confianza y determinación.  Permiso de conducir tipo B.  Orientación hacia la mejora y optimización del servicio.  Una personalidad emprendedora, comunicativa, negociadora y empática.  Experiencia en relacionarte con diferentes departamentos en un entorno dinámico.     Que tendrás con nosotros     Paquete retributivo muy interesante con un fijo + variable en bas

title: Private Banking Relationship Manager
description: Location:  Flexible within the lower North Island, with the successful candidate able to be based in New Plymouth, Wellington, Palmerston North, Whanganui or Lower Hutt.   Permanent | Full-time (40 hours per week, Monday to Friday)   Kia mahi tahi tātou ki ASB | Join ASB  At ASB, we're driven by one purpose: to accelerate financial progress for all New Zealanders.  Our Private Banking team partners with customers who have complex and evolving financial needs, providing personalised banking, lending and specialist solutions built around long-term relationships and trusted advice.  We're looking for an experienced Relationship Manager to join our Private Banking team. This is an opportunity to work with a portfolio of high-value customers, deepen your expertise in relationship management, and build a rewarding career within one of New Zealand's leading banks.  Whether you're currently working in banking, wealth, financial services, business development, or another relationship-focused environment, this role offers the chance to take your career to the next level while making a meaningful impact for customers.  Te tūranga | About the role  As a Private Banking Relationship Manager, you'll manage and grow an established portfolio of customers, becoming a trusted adviser who understands their goals, ambitions and financial priorities.  You'll work closely with customers to deliver tailored banking and lending solutions, while collaborating with a network of specialist partners across ASB to provide a seamless and personalised experience.  This is a role that combines relationship management, commercial acumen, and strategic thinking. You'll have the autonomy to manage your portfolio while being supported by a highly experienced and collaborative team.   Key Responsibilities Include     Managing and growing an established portfolio of Private Banking customers  Building long-term, trusted customer relationships through proactive engagement and exceptional service  Identifying opportunities to support customers across lending, deposits and specialist banking solutions  Partnering with internal specialists to deliver tailored financial outcomes  Developing a deep understanding of customers' financial circumstances, goals and evolving needs  Building strong referral relationships and identifying opportunities to grow your network  Ensuring all risk, compliance, operational and lending requirements are met    Ō pūkenga | About you  You'll be a strong relationship builder who enjoys creating meaningful customer connections and delivering outstanding outcomes.  You may already have experience in banking, financial services, wealth management, business development or another customer-focused industry where trust, credibility and relationship management are critical to success.   We'll Be Particularly Interested In Hearing From People Who     Have proven experience managing customer or client relationships  Build trust quickly and maintain strong stakeholde

title: Manager Customer Relations
description: Provide enterprise leadership and strategic direction for NZTA’s complaints management approach   Develop and implement a coordinated and increasingly centralised enterprise complaints model   Turn complex complaint data and customer feedback into enterprise insight, risk intelligence, and action   Influence senior leaders, strengthen organisational accountability, and drive system-wide service improvement   Palmerston North is preferred but we will consider Wellington, Hamilton or Auckland      Te Whiwhinga mahi | The opportunity   As Manager Customer Relations, you will provide enterprise-level leadership of NZTA’s complaints management approach, shaping and implementing a coordinated and increasingly centralised model across the organisation. You will set strategic direction, strengthen governance and accountability, and work with senior leaders to embed consistent, transparent, and customer-centred complaint practices across diverse business areas. Drawing on a high degree of insight and analysis, you will bring together complaint data, customer feedback, operational performance, and emerging risk information to identify systemic themes and translate them into clear priorities, strategic advice, and organisation-wide improvement action. This is a highly influential role, focused on building enterprise capability, lifting service performance, and ensuring customer insight drives better decisions, continuous improvement, and organisational learning.   Key Responsibilities Include     Lead NZTA's Customer Relations (Complaints) function, setting strategic direction, leading people and performance, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality complaint management and resolution services.   Drive the development and implementation of a coordinated and increasingly centralised complaints management approach across NZTA, establishing consistent processes, standards, reporting, and governance. Lead the growth and maturation of the Customer Relations function to support the staged transition of complaint management activities into a centralised operating model.   Ensure timely, fair, and effective resolution of customer complaints, including complex, sensitive, high-profile, Ombudsman, and Ministerial escalations, in accordance with legislative requirements, organisational policies, and customer service standards.   Champion NZTA's Customer Service Standards across the organisation, using complaints insights, guidance, and performance information to promote consistent customer-focused behaviours, strengthen accountability, and improve service quality and customer outcomes.   Provide strategic advice and reporting to senior leaders on complaint performance, customer concerns, emerging themes, and organisational risks to support informed decision-making and prioritisation.   Driving continuous improvement, smarter ways of working, and efficient use of resources   Leading teams through frequent change while maintaining service quality and morale     You

This is a varied, people-focused leadership role at the heart of village life. As a senior leader within the Area Operations Unit, you will play a key role in shaping investment priorities, driving operational excellence, fostering strong Local Board relationships and enabling your team to deliver outstanding community outcomes. title: Customer Service Representative
description: Vi hjälper företagare att sälja sina bolag. För många av våra kunder är det en av de viktigaste händelserna i livet. Och när de väl blivit kunder förtjänar de service i världsklass.     Vi driver de ledande marknadsplatserna för företagsöverlåtelser i Sverige (Bolagsplatsen) och Finland (Yrityspörssi). Tillsammans har vi hjälpt  över 10 000 ägare att sälja sitt bolag.      Nu söker vi en  tvåspråkig kundservicespecialist  till vårt  Helsingforskontor , som arbetar mot både Bolagsplatsen och Yrityspörssi.      Rollen i korthet    Du är kontaktpunkten för våra befintliga kunder i både Finland och Sverige, och  assisterar de som har köpt en annons av oss i syfte att sälja sitt företag.   Du hanterar fakturafrågor, annonseringsuppgifter, köparmatchning, klagomål och kontoärenden från start till mål.  Snabb, tydlig och professionell service är standarden.       Vi söker dig som    Talar  flytande finska  och  flytande svenska , båda behövs dagligen.  Är lugn under press och tydlig i skrift.  Är organiserad, strukturerad och bekväm med CRM- och ärendehanteringsverktyg.  Vill vara en del av att bygga något stort. Du kommer att forma hur vi arbetar med kundservice på två marknader.       Vi erbjuder    Konkurrenskraftig lön och förmåner.  Ett snabbväxande, lönsamt bolag lett av erfarna entreprenörer.  Ett litet, ambitiöst team med höga krav och tydligt fokus på resultat.  Modernt kontor i Helsingfors, Vanda Airport.  En tydlig playbook att utgå från och friheten att förbättra den.       Bli en del av oss   Vi är en grupp erfarna entreprenörer som värdesätter dina kunskaper, idéer och personliga utveckling. Du spelar en nyckelroll i ett team som hjälper entreprenörer i Sverige och Finland att framgångsrikt sälja sina bolag.     Vi ser framemot din ansökan!  Hugo Åkerman, VD Bolagsplatsen & Yrityspörssi

title: Salesperson
description: Haemme palvelumyyjää Tampereelle tai Jyväskylään 🤝     Tässä roolissa huolehdit kattavan asiakassalkun kasvattamisesta ja kehittämisestä sekä toimit asiakkaiden yhteyshenkilönä palvelusopimusasioissa. Tunnistat asiakkaiden tarpeita ja viet niitä eteenpäin organisaatiossa.     Työ on asiakassuhteiden kehittämistä ja palvelusopimusmyyntiä, jossa keskeistä on asiakkaan liiketoiminnan ymmärtäminen ja pitkäjänteinen tekeminen. Asiakkaasi sijaitsevat Pohjois-Pohjanmaan ja Lapin alueella, joten tehtävään kuuluu myös liikkumista asiakasalueella.     Toivomme, että sinulla on kokemusta asiakastyöstä tai myynnistä sekä kykyä tunnistaa asiakkaiden tarpeita. Aiempi kokemus B2B-ympäristöstä, jälkimarkkinoinnista tai huolto- ja kunnossapitoliiketoiminnasta tukee tehtävässä onnistumista.     Tarjoamme monipuolisen roolin asiakassuhteiden parissa, kattavat henkilöstöedut (mm. Epassi, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus ja laaja työterveyshuolto) sekä huipputiimin tuen arjessa.      Jos nautit asiakastyöstä, olet taitava kuuntelemaan asiakkaiden tarpeita ja aidosti kiinnostunut heidän arjestaan sekä motivoidut tavoitteellisesta tekemisestä, saatat olla etsimämme tekijä.      📍 Sijainti: Pirkkala tai Jyväskylä  📅 Haku päättyy: 30.9.2026      Lue lisää ja hae tehtävään:   https://ats.talentadore.com/apply/palvelumyyja/m5nBW4      Tutustu yritykseemme:   mv-jaahdytys.fi

title: Customer Success Partner
description: What we offer:   This is an exciting career opportunity in an international, challenging business setting known for diversity and being a high paced environment. You will get to focus on creating valuable relations with current and new customers and work with highly professional teams in an environment where you will be valued, recognized and well rewarded.  You will work with amazing and diverse colleagues with a deep sense of commitment to live Our Values and together, go all the way for our customers, society and for each other.   The Position   The Customer Success Partner will be responsible for developing customer relationships that promote retention and loyalty. They will support and work together with the Area Sales Team to ensure that assigned customers achieve their expected business outcomes with Maersk solutions. The role is based in Auckland, New Zealand.   Key Responsibilities     Partner closely with Sales teams through established engagement channels, helping strengthen customer relationships, accelerate growth opportunities, and ensure customers realize maximum value from their investment with Maersk.  Support Sales in developing and executing customer growth strategies by aligning internal stakeholders to customer business goals and priorities.  Monitor customer performance against agreed objectives, proactively identifying opportunities and risks, and working with Sales to drive adoption, retention, and business growth.  Act as a customer advocate, addressing customer needs and coordinating effective issue resolution to support both customer satisfaction and commercial outcomes.  Manage customer allocation programs and collaborate with customers and Sales teams to ensure delivery against agreed commitments.  Support the Sales team in managing tender opportunities by coordinating cross-functional inputs and ensuring competitive, customer-focused proposals are delivered on time.  Coordinate quoting, pricing, contracting, and implementation activities, enabling efficient execution of customer opportunities and commercial agreements.  Drive timely contract renewals and contract management activities, partnering with Sales to maximize retention and minimize revenue risk.  Facilitate customer business reviews, account planning sessions, and pipeline discussions, providing insights that support growth, retention, and account development.  Build strong relationships across Sales, Product, Operations, CX, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to deliver seamless customer outcomes and support sales success.  Identify opportunities for service expansion, cross-selling, and upselling, collaborating with Sales teams to convert opportunities into sustainable growth.     Accountable for:     Contract compliance and governance  Customer retention and renewal success  Invoice quality and issue resolution  Delivery of customer commitments  Customer satisfaction and Net Promoter Score (NPS)  Volume growth and commercial performance  Custome

title: Customer Service Officer
description: Job Description   This position is responsible for ensuring excellent customer service and efficient administration of the existing client base. It will also include assisting and developing business opportunities.   Job Requirements     Certificate in a relevant business-related field, High School Certificate or equivalent    Previous experience in customer relations/sales  Experience in creating teamwork  Effective communication verbally and written  Ability to resolve problems through to complete resolution in a timely, effective manner  Strong organisational and prioritisation skills   Strong technical/numerical skills   Ability to share knowledge and coach team members  Business acumen and commercial awareness  Knowledge of fleet management products, services, systems and processes is desirable     Job Responsibilities   The major responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to:  Thoroughly and efficiently respond to enquiries and educate the customer to ensure that they have  received all the information to make decisions in regard to leasing a vehicle  Comprehensively learn and understand SG Fleet’s products, processes, contract types and services and provide support and advice to customers on these  Process customer requests on behalf of or via other teams/ parties whilst always being conscious of the end-to-end delivery stream that is invisible to the external customer  Resolve customer complaints through following the Customer Complaint Management Process   Maintain excellent systems notes that are accurate, complete and timely. Apply Customer Service best practices in line with Customer Experience trainings received.     Job Benefits   Some of our perks include...   Recharge and relax with up to 4 days of wellness days every year  We offer industry leading 20 weeks paid parental leave  Monetary service milestone awards  Career progression opportunities  Education support towards learning and development, includes a learning budget per year, free access to LinkedIn Learning and more  Two paid volunteer days each year  Health and wellbeing support including a subsidy and an Employee assistance Program   Learn more by watching ​Careers at SG Fleet

title: Senior Associate, Membership
description: We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented  Senior Associate, Membership  to support the day-to-day administration and growth of our membership program. The successful candidate will play a key role in managing membership applications, coordinating onboarding activities, maintaining member records, and supporting ongoing member engagement initiatives.  This position is ideal for a proactive professional who enjoys working with stakeholders and delivering a seamless member experience.      Key Responsibilities    Review and process incoming membership applications.  Maintain accurate and up-to-date member records and databases.  Prepare onboarding packs, welcome materials, and membership documentation.  Support member onboarding activities and ensure a smooth application journey.  Coordinate member communications and respond to membership-related inquiries.  Assist with annual membership renewals and retention initiatives.  Monitor membership data accuracy and ensure compliance with internal processes.  Collaborate with internal stakeholders to enhance the overall member experience.       Requirements    Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.  3-5 years of experience in membership administration, customer success, stakeholder engagement, account management, or a similar role.  Strong administrative, organizational, and coordination skills.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  Experience managing databases, CRM platforms, or membership management systems.  High attention to detail and accuracy.  Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.       Preferred Qualifications    Experience supporting member onboarding and engagement programs.  Familiarity with CRM and membership management platforms.  Experience working with professional associations, chambers, industry bodies, or membership-based organizations.  Knowledge of customer relationship management and retention best practices.       What We're Looking For    A customer-centric and service-oriented mindset.  Strong relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills.  Excellent problem-solving and organizational abilities.  A proactive individual who takes ownership and follows through on commitments.  Passion for delivering an exceptional member experience.       To apply, please submit your CV along with a brief summary of your relevant experience and accomplishments.      #MembershipManagement #MembershipJobs #StakeholderEngagement #CustomerSuccess #MemberExperience #AccountManagement #BusinessOperations #AdministrationJobs #CareerOpportunity #NowHiring #DohaJobs #QatarJobs #LinkedInJobs #ApplyNow

title: Customer Success Consultant
description: For our location in  Madrid or Barcelona  we are looking for a motivated  Customer Success Consultant  (m/f/d) for 40 hours/week.      Your Job    Serve as the  main Customer Success point of contact for a portfolio of Hornetsecurity customers , building strong relationships with customers and their partners and helping them maximize the value of their Hornetsecurity solutions.   Proactively manage customer engagement  by scheduling and driving regular Success Reviews, follow-up meetings and other relevant customer touchpoints.  Regularly  assess customer satisfaction, product adoption and overall account health , identifying potential risks, dissatisfaction or underutilization at an early stage and proactively initiating appropriate actions.  Travel to meet customers and partners onsite on occasion.  Identify and mitigate churn risks by developing appropriate action plans and  coordinating with Sales, Partners, Support, Presales and other internal stakeholders  when required.  Help customers understand and adopt relevant new capabilities, features and best practices, ensuring they continuously derive value from their Hornetsecurity investment.  Identify potential  cross-sell and expansion opportunities  based on customer needs and usage, and proactively engage the appropriate Sales representative to develop the commercial opportunity.  Work closely with our channel partners to ensure coordinated customer engagement, particularly where the partner owns or manages the customer relationship.  Act as the voice of the customer within Hornetsecurity, ensuring relevant feedback, concerns and improvement opportunities are communicated to the appropriate internal teams and followed through.  Maintain  accurate and up-to-date documentation  of customer interactions, calls, meetings, risks, agreed actions and next steps in Salesforce, ensuring visibility and effective collaboration across teams.  Coordinate customer issues and escalations with the appropriate internal teams and maintain ownership of the customer communication and follow-up until an appropriate resolution or next step has been agreed.  Drive  continuous improvement  of Customer Success processes and contribute to initiatives that increase customer satisfaction, adoption, retention and long-term customer value.       Your Profile    You have  proven experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a comparable customer-facing role , ideally within IT, cybersecurity, SaaS, or another technology environment.  Experience working in a fast-paced, international technology company is a plus.  You are a  proactive, highly motivated self-starter  who takes ownership of customer relationships and follows actions through to completion, while also working effectively as part of a team.  You have  excellent written and verbal communication skills in Spanish and English , are comfortable engaging with different stakeholders, and have the ability to influence and build trusted relationships. title: Key Account Representative
description: Wat ga je doen?  Als Key Account Representative ken je alle in´s en out´s van de supply chain van de klanten. Je stelt de klanten centraal en bouwt een goede band en lange termijn relatie met ze op. Het is jouw verantwoordelijkheid om de klant met alle vragen te ontzorgen en om problemen op te lossen. Je bent dagelijks actief bezig met het intern verzamelen van informatie en geeft proactief feedback aan de klanten.    Verzorgen correspondentie, e-mails en telefonie met klanten;  Beantwoorden van klantvragen en/ of eventueel doorverwijzen/ overdragen;  Verzamelen en proactief verstrekken van informatie over diensten;  Maken en nakomen van duidelijke afspraken met key accounts;  Ontvangen van opdrachten en deze verwerken in ons Transport Management Systeem;  Afmelden van zendingen in interne en externe systemen;  Bewaken van de afgesproken KPI’s;  Bijhouden en opstellen van diverse rapportages;  Werken aan verbetering werkprocedures en aanmoedigen van initiatieven hiertoe;  Zorgdragen voor een juiste communicatie, afstemming en informatieoverdracht op zowel de afdeling Key Account als ook naar de andere afdelingen.    Dit biedt KLG Europe    Een deskundig team, waarmee je samen het resultaat bereikt en met plezier kunt terugkijken op je werkdag en je afgeronde planning;  Werken bij een groeiende en kerngezonde logistieke dienstverlener waar normen en waarden al decennia lang een belangrijke rol spelen;  Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, met een mooi salaris op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;  Werken in een laagdrempelige organisatie waar de lijntjes kort zijn;  Aandacht en ruimte voor opleiding, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en doorgroeimogelijkheden.  - Je krijgt in de basis 26 vakantiedagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband. Elke 5 dienstjaren krijg je hier een extra verlofdag bij (we noemen dit loyaliteitsdagen);   De vrijdagmiddagborrel in het KLG café is ook altijd gezellig om samen de week af te sluiten;  Leuke activiteiten en uitjes. Enterprise Sales Team, Channel Sales Team 등 타 세일즈 조직과 협업하며, 최선의 의사결정을 주도하고 빠르게 가맹점 설치·결제가 일어날 수 있도록 소통해요.    이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요    세일즈 조직에서 영업 전략·영업 관리·영업 기획 등의 업무를 5년 이상 수행해 오신 분을 찾고 있어요.  가맹점주, 세일즈 조직, 세일즈 이네이블먼트 조직 등 여러 이해관계자와 동시에 소통하며 업무를 조율하고, 매끄러운 협업 경험을 만들어 오신 분이 필요해요.  POS, 키오스크, 결제 단말기 등 오프라인 디바이스에 대한 이해를 갖추셨거나 매장 환경에 대해 이해하고 계신 분이면 더 좋아요.  배달 플랫폼, 결제사, 포스사, 오더사 등 매장 관련 도메인에서 일해보신 분이라면 더 빠르게 적응하실 수 있을거에요.  현장의 목소리와 정량적 수치 양쪽에 모두 관심을 가지고 현상을 파악하실 수 있는 분이여야 해요.    이력서는 이렇게 작성해 주세요    팀의 영업 전략을 수립한 경험을 공유해 주세요. 어떤 문제의식이 있었고, 어떤 해결방법을 택하셨는지, 어떤 지표로 성과를 측정했는지 구체적으로 적어주세요.  이해관계자 간 이견이 있을 때 어떻게 조율했는지, 실제 사례를 들어 설명해주세요.  운영 프로세스를 개선해서 효율을 높인 경험이 있다면, Before/After를 수치로 보여주세요.  빠르게 변하는 상황에서 우선순위를 정하고 실행한 경험을 구체적으로 작성해주세요    토스플레이스로의 합류여정    서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 > 최종 합격 및 입사

title: Manager Integration Delivery
description: Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. You'll will shape and execute the enterprise integration delivery model, ensuring secure, reliable, and scalable connectivity across internal systems and third party platforms that underpin the airline’s digital and operational ecosystem. This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.  Please submit your application

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!

What We Do…

We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online - quickly and simply.

We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.

And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 50,000 hotels in 150+ countries - with over 130 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.

About the Senior Sales Executive role...

Are you ready to take the next step in your SaaS Sales career? Do you want to be part of the technology shaping the future of the travel industry? Join our international, dynamic and outgoing team in Barcelona!

You will become a trusted advisor to hotel owners, building awareness about how our products can benefit their property. You will have the chance to learn about the challenges that accommodation providers face, and offer a solution that will bring value to their day-to-day and bottom line. Joining SiteMinder as the leader in dynamic hotel revenue management, you will be at the forefront of innovation in the sector.

We won't throw you into the deep end - you'll be trained on our products, industry and sales processes. We have a month-long sales training and onboarding program to make sure you are set up for success. You will be supported by a dedicated sales coach and a buddy, as well as your team leader, who will coach and motivate you to achieve your professional goals.

We know that an attractive compensation package is a key motivator in sales. SiteMinder offers you not only this, but also a working environment that represents ambition, collaboration, self-development and customer-centricity. If you identify with our core values (We Hustle, We Come Together, We Grow, We Make Things Simple) and you are a sales hunter at heart, we want to hear from you!

What you'll do...

  • Client acquisition - Create new opportunities and upsell current customers. You will be responsible for the full sales cycle, from outreach to demo and closing.

  • Achieving sales KPIs and targets

  • Working with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skill

title: Clinical Operations Lead (Clinical Trial Manager)
description:
Responsible for the clinical operations of a project within a defined regional/global level. Provides oversight of project deliverables, assigned Clinical Research Associate (CRAs) and Investigator sites in accordance with the Monitoring Plan, Protocol, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines and local regulations. The COL acts as a primary liaison between the CRAs and the clinical project team. Additional responsibilities include project specific training of CRAs, conducting assessment visits with CRAs, implementation of enrollment and recruitment strategies, preparation of the monitoring plan and other structural documentation and the oversight of monitoring visit scheduling, site and monitoring performance metrics, issue escalation and corrective actions. The COL will develop study tools for site and CRA use, review visit reports, review and track protocol deviations, and support other objectives for clinical operations and the clinical project team.

Project Oversight

  • Overall oversight of (a group of) regional CRAs to ensure (site) compliance with study protocol, study plans, ICH-GCP, local regulations and study timelines.
  • Monitoring support visits (Co-monitoring), per project requirements, to aid the site/CRA in the satisfactory performance and compliance with standards mentioned above.
  • May support clinical project team by providing oversight of study deliverables related to other departments (e.g. Data Management, TMF Operations, etc.)
  • Oversee regional startup and feasibility activities.
  • Assist in vendor management activities as required per project.
  • Perform review of visit reports for quality, compliance and appropriate site management.
  • Assure compliance with high quality and timely project deliverables according to the project requirements and the monitoring plan.
  • Proactive management of site and country performance (recruitment, data collection, document collection, TMF review etc.) and inform clinical project team on progress.
  • Contribute to financial project management processes as applicable. May include but may not be limited to input on revenue recognition, site payments, and site pass-through expense review.
  • May be required to manage/oversee investigator sites including CRA responsibilities, on a temporary or permanent basis.

Project Liaison

  • Conduct regular global CRA calls with the monitoring and site management team, as well as individual/country CRA calls
  • Attend meetings with Study Sponsor to provide status updates on country and site progress
  • Provide operational support and guidance to the monitoring team throughout project.
  • Provide project training/mentoring to regional CRAs on study procedures, clinical plans and guidelines, and timelines for the study. Ensures study specific training requirements are completed and documented.

title: Growth Manager - Short-Form Content (Instagram & TikTok)
description:
Wir sind XO, eine Creator-Management-Agentur. Als Growth Manager übernimmst du die Short-Form-Strategie von 2-4 Creators von A bis Z: Scripts, Shot Lists, Feedback an Creator und Editoren, und ständiges Testen bis die Zahlen stimmen. Dein einziges echtes Ziel: Views, die zu echter Reichweite werden.

Aufgaben

Virale Short-Form-Videos analysieren, verstehen warum sie funktioniert haben, und das für unsere Creator adaptieren.

Scripts und Shot Lists schreiben, die deine Creator dann aufnehmen. Ihnen präzises Feedback geben, was gut war, was nicht, was sich ändern muss.

Editoren und Poster steuern. Du besitzt das Ergebnis, sie führen aus.

Jeden Post analysieren: warum hat das eingeschlagen, warum ist das gefloppt, worauf setzen wir diese Woche.

Mutige Ideen schnell testen, wegwerfen was nicht funktioniert, skalieren was funktioniert.

Qualifikation

Das ist kein 9-to-5. Wenn Sonntagabend ein Reel viral geht, bist du dran. Wenn unter der Woche um 22 Uhr ein Account gesperrt wird, kümmerst du dich. Das Wochenende ist normalerweise frei, aber bei Emergencies springst du ein, ohne Diskussion. Wenn dich das abschreckt, ist der Job nichts für dich.

Was wir wollen:

Besessenheit von Short-Form. Du schaust täglich stundenlang freiwillig TikTok und Reels und kannst erklären, warum ein Video funktioniert. Du lernst das nicht erst, du lebst es schon.

Ownership-Mentalität. Du behandelst die Accounts deiner Creator wie dein eigenes Business. Keine Ausreden, kein "der Editor hat nicht geliefert", du machst es möglich.

Analytischer Blick. Du kannst dir 20 Videos anschauen und uns sagen, welches Muster die erfolgreichen verbindet.

Fließend Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Nicht verhandelbar.

Bonus, kein Muss: Erfahrung im Aufbau von IG- oder TikTok-Accounts, Agentur- oder Marketing-Hintergrund. Uns zählt Drive und Gespür mehr als dein Lebenslauf.

Benefits

2.500 EUR Grundgehal

title: CRM Manager
description: Bras droit du Head of E-commerce sur la réinternalisation complète du CRM (Klaviyo, Wax, Recharge). Tu construis les flows de zéro (welcome, post-achat, panier abandonné, win-back, réactivation abonnés), conçois ses templates dans Figma, pilote la segmentation, les A/B tests et le reporting hebdo.  Sur Recharge, tu travailles la rétention : relances, upgrades, réduction du churn.     Audit et refonte des flows Klaviyo  : welcome series, post-achat, panier abandonné, win-back, réactivation abonnés, construits de zéro, pas de template repris.     Conception des templates emails dans Figma  et intégration dans Klaviyo.     Pilotage de la segmentation et des A/B tests  sur l'ensemble des flows.     Gestion du planning éditorial  et reporting hebdomadaire sur ce qui progresse réellement.     Optimisation de la rétention sur Recharge  : relances intelligentes, upgrades de formule, réduction du churn.     Exploitation de la donnée client  pour personnaliser les campagnes, pas pour remplir des slides.     Suivi des KPIs clés  : abonnés actifs Recharge, LTV 12 mois, repeat rate, open rate et CVR des flows.          Télétravail 1 jours / semaine    Tickets restaurants    Compléments alimentaires (100€/mois)    Espace Sauna           + de 3 ans d'expérience sur un poste CRM ou e-commerce, en environnement DTC ou DNVB. Tu as idéalement évolué dans l'univers des compléments alimentaires, de la santé, de la beauté ou du sport, tu connais les codes de ce marché et les contraintes réglementaires qui vont avec.    maîtrises Klaviyo de bout en bout : tu construis des flows de zéro, tu sais lire un rapport de délivrabilité, tu segmentes finement au-delà des critères évidents. Tu es autonome sur Figma, tu conçois tes templates toi-même et tu les intègres proprement.    Tu as déjà géré un outil d'abonnement type Recharge. Tu sais ce qui fait bouger un taux de rétention et tu ne traites pas un client qui suspend comme un client qui résilie.    Tu connais le produit que tu portes. Tu ne pousses pas un email générique, tu construis une offre pertinente pour le bon segment, au bon moment.    Tu penses en hypothèses, tu testes, tu valides par la donnée. Un taux qui stagne te dérange, et tu sais quoi faire pour le bouger.    Tu es à l'aise en petite structure. Tu prends des décisions sans attendre trois validations, et tu reportes ce qui avance vraiment, pas ce qui fait bien sur un slide.    Une bonne connaissance de Shopify et du parcours client est un plus : elle t'aide à envoyer chaque flow vers la bonne page. Et si tu t'intéresses concrètement à ce que l'IA peut apporter dans une stratégie CRM, encore mieux. Te Haeata/The Opportunity   Come and join the leadership team at Auckland District Court Family & Civil registry.  In this role, you'll be one of five Service Managers reporting to the Manager of Justice Services. You'll work collaboratively with the team to enhance public trust in the Law of Aotearoa New Zealand.  We seek someone with substantial experience in team management, who can offer guidance, training, and support to ensure both professional development and efficient performance while fostering a positive team culture and environment.  We are looking for someone with the following skills, qualities, and experience:    Proven ability in using data and relationships to drive a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, consistency, and accountability  Skilled at building and maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders  Enthusiastic about providing access to timely justice for our communities  Committed to values of Respect, Integrity, Service, and Excellence  Ability to think on your feet and make quick, sound decisions  Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment – Auckland District Court is not for the faint-hearted!  Sustaining quality service delivery through periods of change and transition  Provide quality leadership coaching and support to build and maintain a high-performance team culture.     Ō Pūkenga/Skills And Experience   To be successful in this role, you will need the following skills, knowledge, and experience:    Ability to set the tone, expectations, and culture of the team, fostering an environment of trust, respect, and continuous learning.  Experience in operational management within a fast-paced, dynamic, and customer-focused environment.  A solid record in change management and implementing new business processes.  Proven leadership skills in coaching, motivating, and guiding staff to meet targets, understand their impact on the overall objectives, and build a high-performing culture.  Strong people skills for establishing effective working relationships and collaborating with various agencies and stakeholders.  Solid analytical, tactical, and technical knowledge of Family and Civil matters, along with strategic abilities.  Well-developed verbal and written communication skills.  Ability to exercise sound judgment and political sensitivity.  Excellent attention to detail, time management, and planning skills     Mō Mātou/About Us   At Te Tāhū o te Ture - the Ministry of Justice, we're committed to strengthening people's trust in the law of Aotearoa, New Zealand.  you will be joining our team at a challenging and genuinely exciting time. We would offer the successful person the opportunity to make a difference, the chance to be part of a vibrant and dynamic team, learn new and interesting things, and gain experience in a wide range of areas

title: Field Operations Manager

For nearly two decades, we’ve been a trusted leader in smart metering and digital solutions, helping businesses and communities make better energy decisions.      People are at the heart of everything we do. Bluecurrent offers a supportive, inclusive workplace with fantastic benefits, growth opportunities, and an authentic commitment to sustainability. Take ownership of commercial and operational performance, including rates, quality, service levels and health, safety and environmental outcomes.  Build confidence in delivery through clear performance governance, regular KPI rhythms, cost controls and benefits tracking.  Shape a fit-for-purpose operating model that supports growth, scalability and clear accountability across the BES operation. Demonstrated experience managing contractors, subcontractors or field service providers.  A commitment to health, safety and environmental leadership and continuous improvement. title: Palvelupäällikkö pääkaupunkiseudulle
description: RTK-Palvelu Oy on suomalainen kiinteistöpalvelujen monialayhtiö jo 50 vuoden kokemuksella. Yhtiön 3000 ammattilaista antaa asiakkailleen päivittäin mahdollisuuden keskittyä olennaiseen. Olemme aidosti ylpeitä liiketoimintamme jalommasta tarkoituksesta, jonka myötä olemme omistajamme kautta jo vuosikymmenten ajan tukeneet lasten ja nuorten urheilua ja hyvinvointia valtakunnallisesti.  Oletko valmis astumaan palvelupäällikön rooliin dynaamisessa siivouksen toimialan ympäristössä? Tunnistatko itsestäsi ammattimaista intohimoa monipuoliseen tehtäväkenttään ja olet valmis viemään esihenkilönä tiimimme uudelle tasolle? Kehittyvä RTK-Palvelu tarjoaa ammattilaisilleen mahdollisuudet ammatilliseen kehitykseen. Kasvun myötä on meille avautunut paikka johtamistaitoiselle ja kokonaisuudet hallitsevalle  PALVELUPÄÄLLIKÖLLE!    Tehtävänkuva ja odotukset Työssäsi vastaat siivouksen toimialan nimettyjen asiakkuuksiemme ja henkilöstömme johtamisesta pääkaupunkiseudulla .  Toimit tiimisi esihenkilönä ohjaten vastuualueesi tuloksellista toimintaa. Olet joukkuehenkinen ja sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot, suomen ja englannin kielen taito on tehtävässä välttämätöntä. Kykysi ylläpitää ja vahvistaa asiakassuhteita on tärkeää menestymisellemme.Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää kokemusta tiimien johtamisesta, yhteistyökykyä ja sosiaalisuutta: on tärkeää, että osaat ja aidosti haluat innostaa henkilöstöä. Arvostamme pitkää kokemusta siivouksen toimialan esihenkilötehtävistä ja siivousalan erikoisammattitutkintoa. Työsi on jatkuvaa kehittämistä. Olet innostunut työstäsi ja valmis kehittämään niin omaa kuin tiimisi työtä. Yrityksessämme vaalitaan hyvää työilmapiiriä ja olemme valmiita auttamaan toinen toisiamme. Työsi tueksi saat koko yrityksen tuen ja työtä tehdään oikeasti yhdessä yli yksikkörajojen.Kannat vastuun omasta tekemisestäsi ja vastavuoroisesti annamme sinulle vapauden työskennellä itsenäisesti. Työ on luonteeltaan liikkuvaa, joten edellytämme sinulta ajokorttia, oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksesi.   Tarjoamme Pääset osaksi motivoitunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä tiimiä, jossa arvostetaan jokaisen panosta. Yhteisömme ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava, mikä luo parhaat mahdolliset edellytykset onnistumiseesi.Pidämme huolta henkilöstömme osaamisen kehittämisestä sekä työhyvinvoinnista. title: AI-Native Implementation Manager (DACH / Belgium)
description: About Oper    Oper, a European Fintech company, is a leader in cloud-based digital mortgage software. We provide personalized journeys for borrowers and lenders. Oper's technology streamlines the mortgage application process, eliminates paperwork, and increases transparency.   The fastest growing part of our business is  Herman , our AI agent for mortgage origination. Herman reads documents, checks them, and works a credit file the way an analyst would, inside the regulated workflow of a real bank. It runs on sovereign EU infrastructure, because our clients cannot send mortgage data anywhere else. Phase by phase, it automates more of the origination process: first employed borrowers, then the self-employed, and onward. This is not a chatbot bolted onto old software. It is agentic software doing real work in a regulated environment.   A passionate and engaging team of around 30 stellar Fintech operators works vigorously to transform European mortgages by enhancing efficiency and alleviating borrower anxiety. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Motive Ventures, we have raised EUR 14 million, placing Oper at the forefront of revolutionizing mortgages in Europe. Oper currently has offices in Zürich, Switzerland, and Antwerp, Belgium.   The  AI-Native Implementation Manager  role sits at the centre of how we deliver Herman, and the broader platform around it, inside the bank.    Your Mission    You bring Oper's software into large financial institutions. And you help build the services organisation that delivers it. This is a builder role. You shape how we work, alongside the founding and management team, while running real implementations from day one.   Delivering Herman means understanding both the bank's reality and what the agent can actually do, then closing the gap between them. You do not need to be a delivery veteran. What matters more is how you think. You understand complex systems quickly. You work your way deep into things. You enjoy being close to the customer, and you have the analytical sharpness to understand how software architecture works and why certain decisions get made.   You work alongside forward deployed engineers, not above them. You translate between the bank and the product. You coordinate distributed teams. You are on-site when it matters, but not full time.  Tasks    Run Herman and platform implementations, from kick-off to go-live.   Build relationships with the right people in the bank: product, risk, IT, and the business.   Coordinate distributed teams across engineering, QA, and product.   Translate architectural and compliance decisions into something the client understands and trusts.   Drive change inside the institution, not just feature delivery.   Feed the roadmap, not just the delivery. Your field experience directly informs our agentic product strategy, and the team learns from it.   Use AI to shape your own work. The Koast Agent is the next layer: an AI that reads the account, spots what matters, and acts inside guardrails. 
 Our customers are media buyers. When something breaks, it is not a support ticket to them. It is a campaign that did not launch, a budget that did not move, or an account they cannot see. They need someone on the other end who has run ads, knows what they are looking at, and can tell the difference between a Meta API error, a user mistake, and a real bug.

You will run these sessions yourself, then build the playbook and the in-app flow so the next hundred customers need less of you. 
  Support, end to end.  Intercom is yours. Response times, resolution quality, the help center, the macros, the escalation path. You will answer tickets yourself until the volume justifies a hire, and you will know every customer by name before you delegate a single one. 
  Triage and the bridge to engineering.  You decide what is a bug, what is a feature gap, what is Meta being Meta, and what is user error. Bugs get reproduced, documented with steps and account context, and filed in Shortcut with enough detail that an engineer can fix it without asking you a follow-up question. Patterns get surfaced in the weekly review with numbers: how many customers, how much spend affected, how often.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion
description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE).

The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon.

A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools.

Whether it's visiting the people closest to us, starting an exciting adventure, or a career-defining business trip, travel is essential.

title: Partnerships Manager (South East)
description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

Finding effective ways of generating new business is critical to our continued growth. One way is through partnerships with third-parties who refer their SME clients to Allica on an ongoing basis based on mutual trust. Our Partnerships Team work with trusted advisors to established SMEs, in particular their Accountants.

As a Partnerships Manager, you will develop and nurture relationships with accounting firms across your region, taking a consultative, B2B sales approach. You’ll own the end-to-end client experience for Business Rewards Account clients - from generating introductions through to onboarding and funding and coordinate with our specialist Relationship Manager team on additional lending needs. The role involves regional travel, in-person meetings and you’ll be supported by our Marketing team in running events.

Principal Accountabilities

• Manage a regional portfolio of accounting firms- covering cold outbound, warm inbound, and active introducers- moving each firm through the pipeline to become a repeat client introducer.

• Build trust and credibility through a consultative approach, positioning Allica as the most recommended bank by accountants.

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You lead engineering at ecoplanet: 11 engineers in two squads, including two squad leads.

This is the most senior engineering role in the company. There is no CTO above you. You own the technical direction, not just the delivery of someone else's plan, and you are the engineering voice on the leadership team.

It is also a hands-on job. With a team this size you stay close to the code and the architecture. If you have been away from technical work for a few years, this might not be the right role for you.

What you will own:

  • The team. 11 engineers, which includes two engineering managers. Hiring, performance, growth, and keeping good people
  • The systems. Our Cockpit SaaS platform, the metering and IoT integration layer, the data platform (time-series ingestion, quality, pipelines), the forecasting and optimization services, and the automation that acts on customer assets
  • The technical direction. Architecture, build-vs-buy, and the big platform calls
  • Delivery. Quarterly roadmap execution, owned together with Product
  • Operations. Reliability, on-call, incidents, security posture, and cloud spend


What You’ll Achieve

  • Get the best out of the team you have and grow only where it clearly adds. At 11 people, losing one strong engineer costs more than one extra hire gains. But you should be capable of growing the team substantially if business demands it

Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.

The team

You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Your Role

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work in the Pricing & Revenue context, focusing on data-driven improvements for forecasting, pricing logic, and product insights. You will develop analyses and models that demonstrate measurable impact in our product – with thorough evaluation, a solid data foundation, and pragmatic implementation. You will collaborate closely with Product & Engineering.

Your Responsibilities

  • Model Evolution: You will develop and optimize our forecasting and pricing models as well as data-driven decision logics, always with methodical pragmatism and a strong focus on impact.

  • Smart Workflows: You drive reproducible workflows (versioning, clear pipelines, meaningful tests) and automate recurring analyses and evaluation runs.

description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Success & Retention Manager based in United Kingdom.   As Customer Success & Retention Manager, you will own the customer experience from the first purchase onward, with direct responsibility for retention, refunds, customer satisfaction, winback, and brand reputation. title: Customer Growth Manager, Amazon Just Walk Out Technology - 3P Services
description: Description   As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.  Amazon Just Walk Out as a Service (JWOS) delivers solutions to our Retail Customers to simplify shopping for their shoppers. Our enterprise-ready, autonomous retail technology enables shoppers to simply enter a store, grab what they want, and just go. Born from years of experience at Amazon Go, Just Walk Out uses a combination of technologies to eliminate checkout lines bringing fast and convenient transactional experiences to shoppers. JWOS is seeking a Manager, Customer Success to build first class customer service and operational support programs for our customers. This role drives customer success in several ways such as value realization, steady-state operational support, continuing customer education, and operational excellence initiatives. This function plays a critical role in defining our global customer success strategy and building the tactical playbooks, processes, and mechanisms to deliver this mandate. In this role, you will design the infrastructure for post-launch customer support, engage with customers to define requirements, and help see around corners for future needs. This role never stops iterating and never stops inventing on behalf of our customers.  The ideal candidate has a track record of success leading in ambiguous and high-pressure entrepreneurial situations, has impeccable communication and project management skills, and has demonstrable experience in customer success. Our team values an ability to own projects and work autonomously, to deliver results scrappily and at scale, and be authentic as we accomplish our goals together. This candidate understands the profundity of our revolutionary technology and the power of building and earning trust.  Key job responsibilities     While always placing the customer first, drive global strategy to serve both our end users: the customer and the shopper   Develop and track customer success metrics   Develop and hit monthly, quarterly, and annual goals to improve customer satisfaction   Track and monitor industry trends and make recommendations   Develop operational excellence series and drive partner teams to deliver upon action items to improve customer experience   Parlay operational excellence outputs into value realization initiatives to strengthen our value proposition   Pursue new ideas for value creation

Designing this well is a systems problem. AI Gateway is live, the model ecosystem changes every week, and the team can move from an observed problem to production quickly. This is a rare chance to use your product judgment, design craft, and code to shape a developer product and ship the experience yourself.

title: People Operations Manager
description:
About the role

NetBox Labs is hiring a People Operations Manager to run the day to day operations behind a globally distributed team. We are 135 people across the US, UK, Canada, Australia, France, and Spain, and we are still growing. Every hire, change, and exit creates a contract, a benefits enrollment, a system record, and a compliance obligation under that country's rules. This role owns that work, mostly in Justworks and Deel.

Most of our headcount is in the US, so that is where the transaction volume sits. Our international population is smaller and considerably more complex, with different filing requirements and employment rules in each country. International work is a meaningful share of this job, not an occasional task.

You will also build. You will help us consolidate into a single system of record and keep people data clean enough so that the team can plan against it. You will stand up the operational infrastructure behind our leveling and compensation framework, and you will automate the manual cycles that currently take a week every quarter. You will work directly with the VP of People with real ownership of how the work gets done rather than a queue of tasks to route.

Who this is for

This role is for someone who takes real pride in the craft of operations. You are fast and precise inside an HR system and you trust the record you leave behind. You notice when two systems disagree and you want to know why. You also spot the problem behind the ticket.

When something breaks twice you come back with a fix and a recommendation instead of a flag. Hand you a messy, half-defined project and you turn it into a plan. You already use AI in your own work and you would rather teach a tool to handle the repetitive part than build a better spreadsheet.

Much of this work is detailed, and it matters most when nobody has to think about it. This role is focused on making the operational foundation solid, with real latitude in how you get there.

What you will own

Employee lifecycle operations

  • Own new hire setup end to end in Justworks, including onboarding records, and tax setup, benefits enrollment, and systems access

  • Own exits end to end, including termination processing, final pay, benefits continuation, equity coordination with Finance, and access removal

  • Process every employee change, including comp, title, level, manager, location, and employment status, with clean documentation behind each one

  • Manage employment documentation, contracts, amendments, and letters across our US and international entities

  • Serve as first line support for employee questions on pay, benefits, leave, time off, and policy

  • Maintain and improve the people operations knowledge base and process documentation

GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

About this role

The Internal Audit Field Officer (IA FO) is a member of the Recipient Safeguarding and Advocacy team. Their role is to ensure eligible recipients are safeguarded, their rights are protected, their choices are respected, and that they have the necessary support mechanisms to fully realize the impact of the transfers they receive from GiveDirectly.

The IA FO will be responsible for conducting recipient surveys and associated processes to identify and mitigate risks, investigate cases of potential fraud or recipient harm, and provide recommendations to resolve cases. Part of the IA FO’s responsibility includes supporting the Community Engagement Manager in field risk assessment, recipient protection, and community mobilization and engagement.

Establish data-driven reporting that allows leadership to understand customer behavior, identify revenue leakage, and measure the effectiveness of retention and winback initiatives. title: Head of Customer Success (w/d/m)
description: Für unsere Jobs gibt es keine Bewerbungsfristen. Solange der Job angezeigt wird, kannst du dich bewerben. Wir brauchen kein Anschreiben, nur deinen Lebenslauf oder XING-/LinkedIn-Profil.  Deine Aufgaben    Du baust die Customer-Success (CS)-Funktion bei Diamant von Grund auf auf: Coverage-Logik, Kund:innensegmentierung sowie Playbooks für Onboarding, Adoption, QBR und Renewal, inklusive operativem Rollout im Team.  Du rekrutierst ein Team aus CS-Manager:innen und entwickelst es weiter, mit Fokus auf Skill-Aufbau, KPI-Ownership und einer Kultur, die Kund:innennähe und unternehmerisches Denken verbindet.  Du implementierst ein Health-Score-Modell aus Produktnutzungsdaten, Supporthistorie und Engagement-Signalen, das Churn-Risiken früh erkennt und Wachstumssignale sichtbar macht.  Du verantwortest die zentralen CS-Kennzahlen wie GRR, NRR, Adoption Rate, Health Score, Renewal Rate sowie CSAT/NPS und leitest daraus Maßnahmen zur nachhaltigen Kund:innenentwicklung ab.  Du sorgst gemeinsam mit Consulting und Support für saubere Übergaben entlang der Customer Journey vom Onboarding bis in die laufende Betreuung und bist Sparringspartner für Sales bei Renewals und Upsells.  Du treibst KI-gestützte CS-Prozesse voran, von automatisierten Touchpoints über Health Monitoring bis zum Onboarding und bist die Stimme des Kunden im Unternehmen, indem du strukturiertes Produktfeedback aus dem Feld in die Produktorganisation trägst.    Dein Profil    Du bringst mehrere Jahre Führungserfahrung im CS oder Post-Sales-Umfeld eines B2B-SaaS- oder Softwareunternehmens mit und hast bereits nachweislich eine CS-Funktion aufgebaut.  Du arbeitest datengetrieben, erkennst Zusammenhänge in CS-Daten und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Nutzung, Kund:innenzufriedenheit und -bindung ab.  Du hast Playbooks, Kund:innensegmentierungen und Coverage-Modelle entwickelt und verfügst über Erfahrung mit CRM- und CS-Tools sowie idealerweise mit Finance-, ERP- oder Accounting-Software.  Du verstehst die wirtschaftlichen Hebel von Revenue, Retention und Marge und arbeitest dabei eng und auf Augenhöhe mit Sales und Product zusammen, etwa bei Renewal-Gesprächen oder der Priorisierung von Produktfeedback.  Du hast Builder-Mentalität, baust Strukturen und Prozesse erfolgreich auf und nutzt KI gezielt, um Betreuung und Onboarding skalierbar zu machen.  Du kommunizierst klar und direkt auf allen Ebenen, von Kund:innen auf C-Level bis zum eigenen Team, und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sicher Englisch.    Diese Benefits warten auf dich ...  Gemeinsam Lösungen finden  Werde Teil eines Experten-Teams, das Kundenzufriedenheit großschreibt und Erfolge gemeinsam feiert.  Individuelle Förderung  Praxisnahe Schulungen und Weiterbildungen, die dich fit für alle Herausforderungen machen.  Flexibilität im Alltag  Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten.  Kundenfokus statt Stress  Strukturierte Prozesse und moderne Tools erleichtern deine tägliche Arbeit.
