In this role, you'll be a key partner in our post sales efforts by building relationships with Security teams, establishing healthy feedback loops to help guide our product development and design solutions that ensure long term growth with our customers. You’ll have the opportunity to make a significant impact in shaping the future of our product, selling process and success in across all markets.    What You'll Do      Meet and exceed revenue targets by working closely with our SMB customers’ Security teams.   Manage existing customer relationships to drive renewal and upsell opportunities.   Create an unparalleled customer experience throughout the customer life cycle.   Collaborate with our Go-to-market, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to increase customer adoption.   Be responsible for running Quarterly Health Checks, renewals, and overall health of existing customers.       What You'll Bring      5 plus years of experience in a renewals Customer Success role for B2B SaaS solutions.   Experience selling in the cybersecurity (or related) industry.   Proven track record of meeting or exceeding renewal and upsell quotas.   An understanding of how to drive success in an early stage, fast-paced environment and take ownership to get the task done.   A collaborative mindset and the ability to build meaningful relationships throughout the sales process.   Strong written and verbal communication and experience communicating at every level including the C-Suite.   An aptitude to take on new projects outside the normal scope of the day to day role as needed.   The best candidates for Socket are talented, hard working, competitive, and not afraid to fail. They are team first but willing to take the lead with minimal guidance and supervision.   Willingness to travel for customer and company meetings as needed.     Hiring is a big decision on both sides. Read more about our Hiring Philosophy and how we approach the process at Socket.   Benefits:  Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer:    Market competitive salary bands  Meaningful equity program  Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage)  Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge  Paid parental leave

title: Myynti- ja asiakkuusjohtaja (yksityinen sektori) – Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
description: Job Description   Haluatko vaikuttaa siihen, miten teknologia ja digitaalinen innovaatio luovat uutta liiketoiminta-arvoa?  Etsimme nyt  Myynti- ja asiakkuusjohtajaa (yksityinen sektori)  Tieto Tech Consultingille vastaamaan valituista asiakkuuksista, kasvattamaan nykyistä liiketoimintaa ja rakentamaan uutta yhdessä asiakkaiden ja tiimimme kanssa.  Tässä roolissa työskentelet teknologian, liiketoiminnan ja asiakkuuksien rajapinnassa ja pääset vaikuttamaan merkittävien asiakkaidemme liiketoiminnan kehitykseen.   Mikä on Tieto Tech Consulting?    Tieto Tech Consulting on digitaalisen suunnittelun ja ohjelmistokehityksen yksikkö, jossa autamme asiakkaitamme kasvamaan yhdistämällä liiketoimintamuotoilun, teknologisen osaamisen ja modernin ohjelmistokehityksen.  Asiakkainamme on yli 130 organisaatiota eri toimialoilta – kuten julkishallinnosta, pankkisektorilta, eläkealalta, energiasta, logistiikasta ja valmistavasta teollisuudesta.  Kehitämme arkipäivän digitaalisia palveluita, joita todennäköisesti käytät itsekin ja joilla on todellista vaikutusta ihmisten arkeen ja yhteiskuntaan.  Tarjontamme pohjautuu konsultointipalveluihin ja räätälöitäviin asiakaskohtaisiin ratkaisuihin, joita rakennamme kansainvälistä teknologia- ja konsultointiosaamistamme hyödyntäen.   Mitä tulet tekemään?    Tässä tehtävässä vastaat sekä myynnistä että asiakkuuksien kokonaisvaltaisesta johtamisesta. Vastuualueesi määritetään yhdessä, ja se sisältää yksityisen sektorin asiakkuuksia yhdeltä tai useammalta toimialalta, esimerkiksi valmistavasta teollisuudesta, prosessiteollisuudesta, metsäteollisuudesta, vähittäiskaupasta ja teleoperaattoreista.    Johdat valittujen nykyisten ja uusien asiakkaiden myyntiä ja asiakkuuksia kokonaisvaltaisesti.   Kehität asiakkuusstrategioita, tunnistat uusia liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia ja viet myyntihankkeita tuloksekkaasti eteenpäin.   Yhdistät asiakkaan liiketoimintatarpeet Tieto Tech Consultingin teknologia- ja konsultointiosaamiseen ja rakennat ratkaisuja, jotka tuottavat konkreettista asiakasarvoa.   Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä myynnin, konsultoinnin ja toimitusten parissa työskentelevien kollegoiden kanssa. Varmistat osaltasi myös omien asiakkaidesi asiakastoimitusten onnistumisen.   Rakennat pitkäjänteisiä kumppanuuksia asiakkaiden päätöksentekijöiden kanssa ja huolehdit siitä, että asiakkaalle luvattu arvo toteutuu.   Raportoit Tieto Tech Consultingin Suomen liiketoiminnasta vastaavalle johtajalle.     Mitä odotamme sinulta?     Menestyäksesi Tässä Tehtävässä     Sinulla on vahva kokemus ja näyttöä myynnistä konsultointiliiketoiminnassa ja ohjelmistokehitysalalla.   Ymmärrät sekä teknologiaa että liiketoimintaa ja osaat yhdistää nämä asiakkaan tavoitteisiin.   Sinulla on kokemusta sekä nykyisten asiakkuuksien kasvattamisesta että uuden liiketoiminnan rakentamisesta.   Osaat toimia uskottavasti asiakkaiden liiketoiminnan päätöksentekijöiden kanssa ja viestiä ratkaisujen tuottamasta arvosta vakuuttavasti.   Hallitset strategisen asiakkuu

title: Customer Success Acct Manager

As a Customer Success Account Manager, you will help customers realise value from their Microsoft investments by supporting cloud adoption, solution health, digital transformation and AI-powered innovation.  In this early-career role, you will collaborate with experienced Customer Success Account Managers, technical specialists, account teams and partners to support customers throughout their transformation journeys. You will develop an understanding of customers’ business priorities, help coordinate customer success activities and contribute to positive customer outcomes.  This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, develop customer engagement and programme management capabilities, build business and technical acumen, and gain experience with Microsoft’s cloud and AI solutions.  Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organisation on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realise our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Help customers adopt and realise value from Microsoft cloud, AI and digital solutions.  Build an understanding of customer environments, transformation objectives, priorities and challenges.  Collaborate with Customer Success Account Managers, account teams, technical specialists and partners to coordinate customer activities and follow-up actions.  Monitor customer solution health and help identify adoption opportunities, risks, blockers and recommended next steps.  Contribute to customer meetings, success reviews, adoption discussions and transformation initiatives.  Gather customer insights and feedback and communicate relevant information to internal stakeholders.  Develop trusted customer relationships while working under the guidance of experienced Customer Success professionals.     Qualifications   Required/Minimum Qualifications    Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.  Up to two years of relevant experience in customer success, programme management, project management, consulting, technology delivery, analytics, operations or another customer-facing environment.  Demonstrated interest in cloud technology, artificial intelligence, digital transformation and customer success.  Proficiency in English.  Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and work with a diverse range of stakeholders.  Ability to manage priorities, follow through on commitments and contribute within a team environment.     Additional Or

title: Customer Success Manager
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Success Manager based in Spain.   As a Customer Success Manager, you will be the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for German-speaking B2B customers, currently with a strong focus on Switzerland. You will build long-term partnerships while ensuring customers achieve measurable value from the products and services. The role combines strategic customer engagement, product expertise, onboarding, and cross-functional collaboration. You will become a subject-matter expert in country-specific pharmaceutical reimbursement processes and translate that expertise into customer value. You will work closely with Operations, Product, Sales, Support, and Technology teams to resolve challenges and drive improvements. This is an international, fast-growing environment where autonomy, creative problem-solving, and a proactive, get-things-done mindset are highly valued.  Accountabilities    Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for German-speaking customers, developing strong, long-term relationships.   Own customer-facing value transparency for reimbursement services by highlighting realized benefits, identifying deviations early, and escalating issues to the relevant Operations teams.   Develop deep expertise in Swiss pharmaceutical reimbursement processes and use this knowledge to deliver practical customer value and support customer-facing teams.   Coordinate account-critical escalations and ensure timely resolution across Support, Operations, Product, and Technology teams.   Proactively introduce new product features, identify additional customer needs, and lead upselling and expansion conversations that support customer satisfaction and account growth.   Orchestrate the onboarding of new customers, own the customer success plan, and ensure a smooth implementation experience.   Represent the Swiss customer perspective in product development and broader Customer Success initiatives, working with Product teams to identify and prioritize opportunities.   Maintain a predominantly proactive approach to customer engagement, while supporting operational activities when required in a growing and evolving environment.      Requirements     Experience in healthcare and B2B customer-facing roles, with a strong understanding of customer needs and relationship management.   A customer-oriented and entrepreneurial mindset, with a genuine drive to exceed expectations and solve complex problems.   Strong organizational skills, with the ability to structure work effectively, manage competing priorities, and stay focused on outcomes.   High degree of autonomy, ownership, and goal-oriented execution in a fast-paced environment.   Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with different teams and stakeholders, including under pressure.   Excellent written and verbal communication

title: Office Manager
description: Customer Services Manager       This position sits at the heart of our growing global organisation, you will be responsible for all aspects of your centre’s performance. We’ll give you the autonomy and resource to manage your centre as though it’s your own business. You will have a wide range of responsibilities including:   Being responsible for managing anything and everything on site.  Rising to every challenge and solving problems.  Giving tours to prospective customers.  Upselling to existing customers.  Above all, looking after our customers so well that each becomes a brand ambassador - for you, your team and IWG.          What We Can Do For You      You’re reading the right advert if you’re looking for:   a fun, challenging and rewarding career.  great induction training and excellent ongoing learning and development.  fantastic promotion prospects.  generous, achievable incentives and sociable hours.  access to a comprehensive range of flexible, personalised workplace benefits that support mental, physical and financial wellbeing.z          About You   Ideally, you’ll have some experience of delivering against targets when leading a small, close-knit team. You may have run a flexible workspace centre before, or else a store, restaurant or any site with a high degree of customer focus. Alongside your natural sales and commercial skills, what matters most is that you’ve got the right mindset: passion, drive, ownership and resilience.   Passion: looking after our diverse prospects, customers and guests is at the heart of what we do, so you must bring your passion and positivity to work every day.  Drive: your own and your team’s collective drive for success means you’ll only relax once you’ve delivered the results you’re looking for.  Resilience: a relentless focus on business priorities, regardless of any obstacles placed in front of you.      Above all, you’ll be key to ensuring all our customers only ever receive a truly world-class service.  And your sense of  ownership  means you’ll continuously ensure the quality of service and the workspace are as good as they possibly can be. With 80% of the Fortune 500 already among our customers, and plans to expand to 30,000+ centres over the next decade, we’re uniquely placed to offer the right person exciting career opportunities as we continue pioneering the workspaces of tomorrow.  We know we can only succeed if we give all our people every opportunity to shine. That’s why so many of our most senior leaders started their careers in our centres. title: Senterleder SATS Hillevåg
description: Vi søker senterleder til SATS Hillevåg   Brenner du for å inspirere mennesker til et sunnere og gladere liv?  🙌   Vil du lede et team som utgjør en forskjell hver eneste dag? SATS Hillevåg jobber for å skape positiv forandring ved å motivere medlemmene våre og tilby en treningsopplevelse utenom det vanlige. Som senterleder går du foran med engasjement og retning, og har ansvaret for at ditt senter leverer sterke resultater - både driftsmessig og økonomisk. Du har spesielt fokus på enestående service, målrettet salgsinnsats og et høyt nivå på renhold - alt for å sikre de beste rammene og opplevelsene for medlemmene våre.  🌟 Dine ansvarsområder   Gå foran som leder!  Du får det overordnede ansvaret for den daglige driften i ditt senter og sørger for en livlig, imøtekommende og energifylt atmosfære for både medlemmer og ansatte.   Skap resultater!  Du tar eierskap for senteret ditt – inkludert resultater og utvikling – og har det fulle økonomiske ansvaret. Du jobber strategisk for å nå salgs- og inntektsmål, samtidig som du styrer kostnadene effektivt.   Bygg et fremragende team!  Du rekrutterer, onboarder, inspirerer og utvikler et dedikert team som konsekvent leverer service i verdensklasse og skaper ekstraordinære opplevelser for medlemmene våre.   Skap en kultur preget av kvalitet!  Gjennom synlig og involverende ledelse sørger du for at alle detaljer – fra kundeservice til renhold, sikkerhet og vedlikehold av utstyr – holder høyeste standard.   Sett trivsel i fokus!  Som leder har du ansvar for arbeidsmiljøet i senteret ditt, og du sikrer en trygg, positiv og motiverende atmosfære for både ansatte og medlemmer.   Sørg for et skinnende rent senter!  Sammen med teamet ditt bruker du tid daglig på å gjøre rent – slik at senteret alltid møter SATS’ høye standarder. Uansett når medlemmene trener, skal de bli møtt av et ryddig og innbydende senter.  🤩 Hvem er du?  Du er utadvendt, vennlig og karismatisk, og har en naturlig evne til å bygge sterke relasjoner – både med medlemmer og kollegaer. Du tar initiativ, er handlekraftig og trives med å ta ansvar, samtidig som du har et skarpt blikk for struktur og systematikk i hverdagen. Du engasjerer og motiverer andre med energien og arbeidsgleden din, og du leder ved å være et inspirerende forbilde.    Du har solid erfaring med salg og ledelse og motiveres av å skape gode resultater.  Det er et krav at du snakker og skriver flytende norsk og engelsk.  Du kan identifisere deg med våre verdier: Members First, Accountable, Professional & Extraordinary.  Du trives med fleksible arbeidstider, da vaktene varierer – inkludert tidlige morgener, sene kvelder, helger og helligdager. Dette sikrer at det alltid er en leder til stede i de travleste periodene, samtidig som du får muligheten til å jobbe sammen med teamet ditt på ulike vakter. Du må også være forberedt på å være tilgjengelig utenom vanlig arbeidstid ved akutte hendelser, som for eksempel sykdom.    🚀 Hvorfor jobbe hos SATS?  ✅  Gjør en forskjell!  H

description: Additional Information    Job Number  26119605   Job Category  Rooms & Guest Services Operations   Location  Diplomatic Street, West Bay Area, Doha, Qatar, Qatar,VIEW ON MAP   Schedule  Full Time   Located Remotely?  N   Position Type   Management   Job Summary   Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence. I grunden har du en god kunskap om ITIL-processer och har du dessutom en eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT och erfarenhet av arbete med statistik ses det meriterande. Työskentelet asiakkaiden tukena valokuitupalvelun toimitusprosessin eri vaiheissa aina tilauksesta käyttöönottoon saakka. Samalla toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä Elisan asiantuntijoiden ja sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa varmistaaksesi asiakkaalle sujuvan ja laadukkaan palvelukokemuksen.  Tehtävän keskiössä on asiakkaiden tarpeiden tunnistaminen ja niihin sopivien, räätälöityjen ratkaisujen tarjoaminen Elisan palveluiden ja tuotteiden avulla. Työ on tavoitteellista ja suoriutumista seurataan selkeiden mittareiden kautta, jotka ohjaavat tekemistä ja tekevät onnistumisen näkyväksi. Entä työajat ja palkka?    Etsimme kahta uutta työkaveria  toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan kokoaikaiseen (37,5 h/vko) työsuhteeseen.    🕙 Työskentelemme  vuoroissa ma-pe klo 07:50-18:30 välillä  ja odotamme sinulta valmiutta työskennellä näissä vuoroissa.   📍Työskentelypisteesi sijaitsee  Tampereen toimistollamme.  Työsuhteen alussa työskentelemme toimistolla sujuvan perehdytyksen varmistamiseksi. Osaamisen karttuessa sinulla on myös mahdollisuus tehdä töitä etänä yhteisiä pelisääntöjä noudattaen. Elisalla on käytössä hybridityön malli, jonka mukaan työskentelemme toimistolla keskimäärin kolmena päivänä viikossa.    💰Tehtävässä varmistat osaltasi asiakaspalvelumme myynnillistä onnistumista, ja me myös palkitsemme sinua onnistumisista ja itsesi ylittämisestä! Lisäansiot vaihtelevat tyypillisesti muutamista sadoista aina useisiin tuhansiin euroihin kuukaudessa!     Mitä toivomme sinulta?   Aikaisempi kokemus asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntitehtävistä on avuksi, mutta emme odota sinun olevan valmis ammattilainen. Meille kaikkein tärkeintä on aito halu kehittyä ja kasvaa asiakaskohtaamisen- ja myynnin monipuoliseksi osaajaksi! Arki on ajoittain nopeatempoista, joten tehtävässä viihtyminen ja menestyminen ede

description: Number1 ricerca 1 candidato/a da inserire presso il sito di Paullo (MI)  Il/La candidato/a si occuperà di presidiare a livello commerciale, tutti i processi relativi alla relazione con i clienti di riferimento, sarà il punto di giunzione strategico tra i nostri clienti chiave e i reparti interni (magazzino, trasporti, customer service). title: Key Account Manager Life Partnerships (all genders)
description: Job-Beschreibung    80 - 100%, Winterthur / Smart Working    Gestalte deine Zukunft – gemeinsam mit uns!    Jede Erfolgsgeschichte beginnt mit dem Glauben an sich selbst.  “Partnerships & Major Accounts” ist eine Vertriebseinheit der AXA, die bedürfnisgerechte und innovative Versicherungslösungen mit Mehrwert schafft und erfolgreich im Markt positioniert. Zusammen mit unseren Partnern prägen wir den kundenzentrierten Versicherungsvertrieb in der Schweiz und nehmen gemeinsam eine starke Position ein. Das erwartet dich       Key Account und Stakeholder Management: Du entwickelst und steuerst unsere starken Leben-Partnerschaften auf allen Ebenen – Du verantwortest die strategischen, kommerziellen und operativen Belange zur Stärkung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Marktposition. Vertriebs- und Beratungskonzepte: Du trägst zum Wachstum in unserer Leben-Sparte bei, indem Du kundenzentrierte Beratungs- und Akquisitionskonzepte erarbeitest sowie Massnahmen zum Bestandsausbau vorschlägst und diese bei der Implementierung begleitest.    Schulung und Coaching: Du konzipierst Ausbildungspfade für die Kundenberatenden, schulst selbst an der Verkaufsfront und stellst so die hohe Beratungsqualität an der Kundenschnittstelle sicher. Führung des Partnership Service Center: Du trägst die personelle sowie die qualitative Verantwortung von unserem Service Center, mit welchem wir eine hochstehende Dienstleistung für unsere Partner und deren Kundschaft erbringen. Du gibst Dein Expert-Wissen weiter und unterstützt bei komplexen Fragestellungen.    Projekt-Arbeit: Du wirkst in verschiedenen bereichsübergreifenden Transformations-Projekten mit und vertrittst die Interessen unseres Sektors und unsere Partner. Du analysierst fachliche und regulatorische Vorgaben und bringst unsere Anforderungen zur Erarbeitung

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role responsible for shaping the entire post-sale customer experience within a fast-growing B2B SaaS environment. You will own retention, expansion, and adoption outcomes while developing the strategies and systems that support sustainable customer growth. Working closely with senior leadership, you will combine strategic direction with direct involvement in key customer relationships. You will lead and develop an expanding Customer Success team while establishing scalable playbooks across onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion. The role offers significant autonomy and the opportunity to build the Customer Success function during an important stage of company growth. Success will be measured through meaningful business outcomes, customer value, and recurring revenue rather than activity alone. Drive customer adoption by increasing both the breadth and depth of product usage across the customer base.  Coach, enable, and actively support the Customer Success team, stepping directly into strategic accounts when intervention or additional leadership is required. Build and continuously refine a scalable Customer Success playbook covering onboarding, adoption, success planning, renewal, and expansion. Partner closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to communicate customer needs, surface opportunities, and represent the voice of the customer.  Maintain accurate visibility into customer health, risks, opportunities, and performance through HubSpot or comparable CRM systems.  Proactively identify accounts at risk as well as expansion opportunities, developing practical and actionable recommendations for leadership.  Build a culture of ownership and customer value, ensuring processes and team activity remain closely connected to business outcomes.  Use customer insights and performance data to continuously improve the Customer Success operating model. Demonstrated experience owning retention and expansion metrics and coaching teams toward measurable commercial outcomes. description: Description De L'entreprise   Nous sommes un groupe leader dans les services aux investisseurs, offrant des solutions de bout en bout en matière d’administration, de comptabilité, de reporting, ainsi que pour les besoins réglementaires et de conformité du secteur de l’investissement à l’échelle mondiale. title: Head of Customer Activation
description: Do you want to lead the next step in how technical expertise is turned into stronger customer relationships, new business opportunities and measurable growth? As Head of Customer Activation, you take on a global leadership role with significant transformation responsibility – shaping how we engage customers and create commercial impact across markets.   Be part of our continued journey   At Sandvik Coromant, we help shape the future of manufacturing by developing solutions, products and services that make a real difference for our customers. This is a place where trust, empowerment and collaboration are part of everyday work, giving you room to lead with both strategic direction and practical impact.   Your mission   As Head of Customer Activation, you lead a global function that is evolving from a traditional marketing-oriented role into a commercially focused platform for customer acquisition, engagement and revenue growth. A central part of your mission is to strengthen how we meet, inspire and develop customers through our global network of Sandvik Coromant Centers, Tech Days customer events and Sandvik Coromant Academy learning offerings. Together, these platforms play an important role in turning technical expertise into stronger customer relationships, new business opportunities and measurable commercial impact.  This is a role with significant transformation responsibility. You continue the journey of redefining how Customer Activation creates value, turning technical knowledge, customer interactions and learning experiences into stronger customer pipelines and measurable sales outcomes. You also ensure that technical product information is accurate, accessible and presented in ways that help customers understand the value of our solutions.  Your main responsibilities include:    Driving activity and customer engagement through Sandvik Coromant Centers globally.  Developing and expanding Tech Days as a customer acquisition and engagement platform.  Transforming Sandvik Coromant Academy and training offerings toward a more commercial, revenue-generating model.  Making technical content relevant, engaging and attractive to customers.  Leading a global team and collaborating across markets, functions and senior stakeholders.    You report to the Vice President of Global Sales. The location is flexible globally, with international travel as a natural part of the role.   Your profile   We’re looking for a leader with deep technical credibility in manufacturing, CNC, metal cutting or a related industrial environment, combined with a strong commercial mindset. You understand how technical expertise can be translated into clear customer value, engaging communication and measurable business outcomes. Experience from industrial B2B sales, product management, technical leadership, customer-facing roles or industrial training organizations could all be relevant. Your background includes a university degree in a relevant field.  To succeed

title: Myynti- ja asiakkuusjohtaja (julkinen sektori) – Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
description: Job Description   Haluatko vaikuttaa siihen, miten teknologia ja digitaalinen innovaatio luovat uutta liiketoiminta-arvoa?  Etsimme nyt  Myynti- ja asiakkuusjohtajaa (julkinen sektori)  Tieto Tech Consultingille vastaamaan valituista asiakkuuksista, kasvattamaan nykyistä liiketoimintaa ja rakentamaan uutta yhdessä asiakkaiden ja tiimimme kanssa.  Tässä roolissa työskentelet teknologian, liiketoiminnan ja asiakkuuksien rajapinnassa ja pääset vaikuttamaan merkittävien asiakkaidemme toiminnan kehitykseen.   Mikä on Tieto Tech Consulting?    Tieto Tech Consulting on digitaalisen suunnittelun ja ohjelmistokehityksen yksikkö, jossa autamme asiakkaitamme kasvamaan yhdistämällä liiketoimintamuotoilun, teknologisen osaamisen ja modernin ohjelmistokehityksen.  Asiakkainamme on yli 130 organisaatiota eri toimialoilta – kuten julkishallinnosta, pankkisektorilta, eläkealalta, energiasta, logistiikasta ja valmistavasta teollisuudesta.  Kehitämme arkipäivän digitaalisia palveluita, joita todennäköisesti käytät itsekin ja joilla on todellista vaikutusta ihmisten arkeen ja yhteiskuntaan.  Tarjontamme pohjautuu konsultointipalveluihin ja räätälöitäviin asiakaskohtaisiin ratkaisuihin, joita rakennamme kansainvälistä teknologia- ja konsultointiosaamistamme hyödyntäen.   Mitä tulet tekemään?    Tässä tehtävässä vastaat sekä myynnistä että asiakkuuksien kokonaisvaltaisesta johtamisesta. Vastuualueesi määritetään yhdessä, ja se sisältää julkisen sektorin asiakkuuksia.    Johdat valittujen nykyisten ja uusien asiakkaiden myyntiä ja asiakkuuksia kokonaisvaltaisesti.   Kehität asiakkuusstrategioita, tunnistat uusia liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia ja viet myyntihankkeita tuloksekkaasti eteenpäin.   Yhdistät asiakkaan tarpeet Tieto Tech Consultingin teknologia- ja konsultointiosaamiseen ja rakennat ratkaisuja, jotka tuottavat konkreettista asiakasarvoa.   Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä myynnin, konsultoinnin ja toimitusten parissa työskentelevien kollegoiden kanssa. Varmistat osaltasi myös omien asiakkaidesi asiakastoimitusten onnistumisen.   Rakennat pitkäjänteisiä kumppanuuksia asiakkaiden päätöksentekijöiden kanssa ja huolehdit siitä, että asiakkaalle luvattu arvo toteutuu.    Raportoit Tieto Tech Consultingin Suomen liiketoiminnasta vastaavalle johtajalle.      Mitä odotamme sinulta?     Menestyäksesi Tässä Tehtävässä     Sinulla on vahva kokemus ja näyttöä myynnistä konsultointiliiketoiminnassa ja ohjelmistokehitysalalla.   Ymmärrät sekä teknologiaa että liiketoimintaa ja osaat yhdistää nämä asiakkaan tavoitteisiin.   Sinulla on syvä ymmärrys julkishallinnon toiminnasta ja sen erityispiirteistä, kuten hankintalaista, puitejärjestelyistä, päätöksentekoprosesseista ja tarjouskilpailuista.   Osaat rakentaa asiakkuus- ja kasvusuunnitelmia sekä tunnistaa asiakkaan todelliset tarpeet ennen varsinaista tarjouskilpailua.   Osaat toimia uskottavasti asiakkaiden päätöksentekijöiden kanssa ja viestiä ratkaisujen tuottamasta arvosta vakuuttavasti.   Hallitset strategisen asiakkuussuunn

title: Head of Customer Success
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Customer Success based in Spain.   This is a senior, hands-on leadership role responsible for shaping the entire post-sale customer experience within a fast-growing B2B SaaS environment. You will own retention, expansion, and adoption outcomes while developing the strategies and systems that support sustainable customer growth. Working closely with senior leadership, you will combine strategic direction with direct involvement in key customer relationships. You will lead and develop an expanding Customer Success team while establishing scalable playbooks across onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion. The role offers significant autonomy and the opportunity to build the Customer Success function during an important stage of company growth. Success will be measured through meaningful business outcomes, customer value, and recurring revenue rather than activity alone.  Accountabilities    Own overall Customer Success strategy and execution, with direct accountability for retention, expansion, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and churn outcomes.  Drive customer adoption by increasing both the breadth and depth of product usage across the customer base.  Coach, enable, and actively support the Customer Success team, stepping directly into strategic accounts when intervention or additional leadership is required.  Lead, develop, and scale the Customer Success organization as the business grows, including hiring and onboarding future team members.  Build and continuously refine a scalable Customer Success playbook covering onboarding, adoption, success planning, renewal, and expansion.  Establish customer success plans, health-scoring frameworks, account-management standards, and repeatable processes tied to measurable retention and expansion outcomes.  Partner closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to communicate customer needs, surface opportunities, and represent the voice of the customer.  Maintain accurate visibility into customer health, risks, opportunities, and performance through HubSpot or comparable CRM systems.  Proactively identify accounts at risk as well as expansion opportunities, developing practical and actionable recommendations for leadership.  Build a culture of ownership and customer value, ensuring processes and team activity remain closely connected to business outcomes.  Use customer insights and performance data to continuously improve the Customer Success operating model.     Requirements     Proven leadership experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, including direct people-management responsibility.  Demonstrated experience owning retention and expansion metrics and coaching teams toward measurable commercial outcomes.  Hands-on leadership approach, with the ability to personally engage with strategic accounts while developing the team to operate effectively at scale.  Experience

As the leading data security platform purpose-built for the cloud era, Cyera’s mission is to reinvent how businesses secure data, enable agile collaboration, and boldly pursue new business opportunities. Trusted by security teams at leading global businesses, our team is proving that data security is the next big thing in cyber. THE OPPORTUNITY   We are searching for a highly skilled Associate Customer Success Engineer to play a key role in optimizing our customers' utilization and return on investment in Cyera. As part of this role, you can expect to travel between 25-50% annually, enabling you to engage directly with clients and enhance their overall experience. Troubleshooting and resolving technical issues impacting customers, ensuring smooth operation and seamless experiences.  Monitoring and reporting on the overall well-being of customers, tracking key health and usage indicators.  Collaborating with customers to develop joint success plans. title: Professional Services Specialist
description: Vi tror på ett samhälle format av framgångsrika företag där entreprenörskap och samhällsnytta går hand i hand. Att vara en del av Fortnox är att vara en del av en ständig förändring - en förändring där du själv bestämmer hur långt du vill nå. Vårt största fokus är att ge dig rätt förutsättningar att få leva din passion tillsammans med oss. Var du kommer ifrån är inte relevant - det är vart du är på väg som är intressant för oss. Precis som vi igår inte kunde drömma om det Fortnox som finns idag, så kan du vara med och forma vilka vi är imorgon.     Om tjänsten   Som Professional Services Specialist hos oss är du en  nyckelperson för våra kunder.  Din huvudsakliga uppgift är att säkerställa en framgångsrik onboarding och hjälpa kunderna att få ut maximalt värde av våra produkter. Du kommer bli specialist inom en rad områden som exempelvis koncernkonsolidering, rapportering och finansiell analys. Du kommer få tillfälle att arbeta med många bolag och koncerner inom olika branscher och storlekar med varierande komplexitet. Målet är att du, genom din expertis, hjälper dem att ta fram ett bra underlag för deras beslut och analyser.  Dina dagar kommer att vara fyllda med kundmöten, främst online, där du onboardar och stöttar våra kunder i våra produkter. Du kommer även:    Hålla i utbildningsforum för större byråer med många konsulter.  Agera expertstöd till säljorganisationen vid workshops och demonstrationer.  Samarbeta tätt med våra produktchefer och utvecklare genom att testa nya funktioner och rapportera eventuella buggar.  Vara en viktig länk mellan kunden och vår interna organisation.      Om dig   Vi tror att du har en stark grund inom ekonomi, antingen via utbildning eller tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet.  Du trivs i en konsultativ roll  där du får kombinera din ekonomiska expertis med ett stort intresse för kundvård och teknik. Du är lugn, pedagogisk och har en förmåga att anpassa dig efter olika kunders behov. För att lyckas ser vi gärna att du har:    En utbildning inom ekonomi eller motsvarande.  Minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet från en roll som exempelvis controller, redovisningsassistent, ekonom, ekonomiassistent eller liknande.  Ett stort intresse för att bygga relationer och förstå kundens behov.  En teknisk nyfikenhet och förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya system.      Fortnox - mitt i företagslivet    Fortnox hjälper företag att starta, växa och utvecklas. Med smarta tekniska lösningar för företag och redovisningsbyråer, smidig finansiering och ett ekosystem av starka partnerskap är Fortnox ett nav för företagande i Sverige. Vi drivs av visionen om ett välmående samhälle format av framgångsrika företag.     Fortnox grundades 2001 med huvudkontor i Växjö. Läs mer på www.fortnoxgroup.com.    Välkommen med din ansökan!    Behandling av personuppgifter   Vi på Fortnox värnar om din personliga integritet. När du skickar in din ansökan till oss kommer vi att behandla dina personuppgifter för att administrera rekryteringsprocessen. Perso

title: Technical Account Manager (IT)
description: It usually starts like this.  You're grabbing a coffee at your favourite cafe, pretending you're just "checking emails," when in reality you're solving three client problems, calming down a fourth, and wondering if there's a role out there where you could actually  shape  things instead of just reacting to them.  Good news, there is.   About First Focus   First Focus has spent the last  nine years  being recognised by Cloudtango as  Australia's #1 mid-market Managed Service Provider . While the award might have been earned across the Tasman, the standards, culture, and customer experience that got us there are exactly what we're bringing to New Zealand. (And after nine years of winning, we're starting to think we might actually need a bigger trophy cabinet.)  We're now pushing close to  500 people globally , and just when things were getting interesting, we've announced our  merger with Integris . Which means we're about to become one of the largest and broadest SMB MSPs on the planet.  No pressure.  What that actually means for you is simple: bigger clients, broader capability, more opportunity, and a front-row seat to something genuinely exciting, without losing the culture that got us here in the first place.  We're still a business where people know your name, where leadership is accessible, and where being  informed, aligned, supported, and rewarded  isn't just a slide in a deck, it's how things actually run day to day. You can read more about how we think about that here: https://www.firstfocus.com.au/about-us/. And yep, we know everyone has these, but here we hire by them, reward by them, and make business decisions using them.   The Role   This role is for someone who's a bit tired of being "the account manager" or "the consultant" and would quite like to be both, properly.  You'll operate as a  trusted advisor and Technical Account Manager , working with a range of SMB and mid-market clients, some approaching 500 seats, partnering directly with senior stakeholders and the C-suite. You won't just manage relationships, you'll shape them.  The way this role plays out is not fixed. There's no dusty playbook to follow. You get to build this role in a way that actually makes sense, for you and for your clients.  You'll help organisations navigate complexity, make smarter decisions, and turn business priorities into practical technology roadmaps that actually get delivered. You'll lead strategic conversations, help clients plan what's next, and occasionally stop them from buying something they absolutely do not need (they'll thank you later).  If you've ever wanted to have a bigger impact, this is where you stop saying it and start doing it.   Why You'll Love It Here     You'll have real autonomy, not the "empowered within strict boundaries" kind  You'll work with established SMB and mid-market clients who expect, and value, proper thinking  You'll help shape your clients' technology strategy and roadmap, not just report on it  You'

title: Responsable de atención al cliente y experiencia posventa
description: En  Galerías del Tresillo  buscamos incorporar una persona que lidere la evolución de nuestra experiencia de cliente en la etapa más importante después de la compra: la  posventa .  No buscamos únicamente a alguien que  resuelva incidencias . Buscamos a quien quiera  escuchar → resolver → acompañar → aprender → mejorar .      ¿Qué harás en tu día a día?   • Coordinar la atención de consultas, solicitudes e incidencias de clientes, asegurando su seguimiento hasta el cierre.  • Supervisar y gestionar los casos de mayor complejidad o impacto.  • Trabajar transversalmente con tiendas, logística, almacén, transporte, proveedores y servicio técnico para agilizar las soluciones.  • Identificar puntos de bloqueo y proponer mejoras en los procesos de resolución.  • Analizar los principales puntos de dolor de la experiencia posventa.  • Transformar el feedback de clientes en insights accionables para otras áreas de la compañía.  • Identificar causas raíz y promover iniciativas para evitar la repetición de problemas.  • Definir y realizar seguimiento de indicadores de calidad de servicio y experiencia de cliente.  • Impulsar mecanismos de recuperación de clientes insatisfechos y contribuir a mejorar su satisfacción, fidelización y recomendación.      ¿Qué buscamos?   Una persona con experiencia senior en  Atención al Cliente, Posventa, Customer Service, Customer Experience o posiciones similares , que combine orientación al cliente con capacidad de gestión y visión analítica.     Valoraremos especialmente:   Experiencia gestionando incidencias y reclamaciones.  Capacidad para coordinarse con diferentes áreas y resolver situaciones complejas.  Orientación al cliente, empatía y capacidad de escucha.  Alta capacidad resolutiva y de organización.  Capacidad para gestionar conversaciones difíciles.  Visión analítica y orientación a la mejora continua.  Autonomía, iniciativa y sentido de responsabilidad.  Experiencia con ERP, ticketing o herramientas de gestión de incidencias será valorable.  Experiencia en retail, mobiliario, hogar, distribución o logística será un plus.          ¿Cómo mediremos el éxito?   Entre otros indicadores, trabajaremos sobre satisfacción de cliente, NPS, tiempos de respuesta y resolución, resolución dentro de plazo, reincidencia de incidencias, reclamaciones y recuperación de clientes insatisfechos.      El reto   Queremos evolucionar la posventa desde un modelo centrado principalmente en gestionar incidencias hacia un modelo que convierta cada contacto con el cliente en una oportunidad para mejorar la experiencia y también el funcionamiento de la compañía. En esta posición coordinarás un equipo de 3 personas, acompañándolo en su día a día, ayudando a priorizar, mejorar procesos y asegurar una atención al cliente excelente.     📍 ¿Dónde y cuándo?     • Oficinas centrales en Terrassa  • Jornada presencial de lunes a viernes  • Horario: de 8:00 a 16:00 h     Si te identificas con esta forma de entender el Customer Experience,  queremos

title: Learning & Development Manager
description: Job Description    Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You   Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work!  As a Learning & Development Manager, you are not just managing training initiatives for hotel team members , you are spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by developing our people and helping them deliver memorable experiences for every guest.  This role will be particularly important as the hotel progresses through its renovation journey and into its next chapter. You will work closely with the leadership team and department heads to support our team members throughout the transformation, maintain engagement and service standards during renovation, and build the skills, confidence, and knowledge required for the successful relaunch and operation of the renovated hotel.   Responsibilities     RESPONSIBILITIES    Here’s what you will do during a typical day:     Develop training programs: Design, plan, and deliver hotel training programs in alignment with corporate goals and industry standards, inclusive of topics such as harassment-free workplace, diversity, new team member orientation, leadership, and service.   Support the hotel renovation journey: Develop and coordinate learning initiatives that support team members throughout the different phases of the hotel renovation, ensuring they remain informed, engaged, motivated, and prepared for operational changes.   Prepare teams for the renovated hotel: Partner with hotel leadership and department heads to identify new skills, service behaviors, operational knowledge, and training requirements resulting from renovated facilities, new concepts, guest touchpoints, and ways of working.   Drive pre-opening and relaunch readiness: Develop and execute training plans ahead of the reopening of renovated areas, including service simulations, departmental training, product knowledge, guest journey training, and other readiness activities to ensure teams are fully prepared from day one.   Embed the new guest experience: Following renovation, ensure new service standards, concepts, and operational practices are successfully embedded through continuous coaching, refresher training, observation, and follow-up.   Support change and team engagement: Act as a learning and culture partner throughout the transformation, helping leaders communicate change effectively and supporting team members in adapting positively to the hotel’s new chapter.   Monitor and review performance: Conduct meetings with department managers, trainers, and team members to review performance trends, develop action plans, and recognize achievements.   Deliver continuous improvement: Assess existing training initiatives, identify opportunities for enhancement, and recommend solutions to address specific department needs. title: International Human Resources Manager
description: We are looking for an exceptional  International HR Manager  to drive human resource operations and workforce excellence across key international markets in MENA region.      Position Overview:   In this pivotal role, you will spearhead HR operations across international offices and regional developments in MENA, aligning talent strategies with continuous business expansion. You will own the full employee lifecycle for a diverse, multicultural workforce, ensuring seamless multi-country regulatory compliance while championing talent excellence in a dynamic real estate market.      Key Responsibilities:    International HR strategy & Governance:    Designing and implementing HR frameworks, policies, and standard operating procedures  (SOPs) tailored to our operational footprint across MENA region.      Regional Talent Acquisition:   Overseeing specialized recruitment pipelines for key leadership, project management, asset management, and engineering talent across the region.      Multi- Country Compliance:   Ensuring rigorous adherence to diverse labor laws, employment regulations, and statutory compliance across the operating regions in MENA.      Total Rewards & Performance Management:   Driving competitive compensation, benchmarking salary structures, bonuses and performance management frameworks.      Culture & Employee Engagement:   Fostering an inclusive, high - performance corporate culture that bridges diverse regional offices across multiple continents, driving employee retention and professional development.      What we're looking for:    10+ Years of progressive HR experience, featuring 4-5 years in dedicated regional or international HR management capacity.  Demonstrated professional experience managing HR operations and talent acquisition across Asian and African markets.  Experience with real estate, property management or international construction/ engineering sector preferred.  Comprehensive knowledge of regional labor frameworks, HRIS platforms, and ATS. title: Business Development Executive
description:
Thoughtworks is seeking business development leaders to join and lead our client growth in the Americas region. Business Development Executives at Thoughtworks are responsible for developing and securing a pipeline of new opportunities and building relationships with both new clients and in new areas of existing client organizations. As a Business Development Executive you are responsible for prospecting, shaping and selling aspirational engagements for our clients as well as for Thoughtworks. You will work within Thoughtworks’ Strategic Sales team, leading the development and expansion of client relationships within our company.

Your responsibilities and accountabilities include prospecting, identifying and qualifying new opportunities, building trust with potential clients, shaping deals, developing winning value propositions, tightly orchestrating sales pitches, proposals and orals, negotiating win / win agreements with prospective clients, and expanding follow-on sales to create a sustainable business within each account. You will work across client organizations, from C-level and board members to front line business and technical staff, building relationships to secure long-lasting business opportunities.

To be successful, you will have multiple years of consultative selling experience within an enterprise IT services company. Your experience should demonstrate industry relevance and expertise across one or more industry domains. You will have sold custom software application development and digital transformation services, and have demonstrated proficiency in prospecting, leading and securing custom software and digital transformation deals with significant total contract value (TCV). You will have expertise dealing with both business and IT leaders and executives.

As a seasoned industry executive, you have spent your career enabling clients to solve complex challenges and achieve meaningful business outcomes. You’ve cultivated trusted relationships across the C-suite and executive levels of key enterprises within your domain, including organizations operating in or serving Capital Markets.

At Thoughtworks, you’ll use that industry-specific network and insight to articulate our differentiated value proposition, accelerate executive conversations, and drive new business opportunities. Your deep contextual understanding of the industry’s trends, challenges, and innovation priorities will position you to shape strategic solutions and drive meaningful client impact.

Job responsibilities

  • Develop relationships and leads with business and IT executives at target enterprise clients on an ongoing basis by leveraging your professional network, personal contacts and through creative networking, partnership and outbound selling strategies.
  • Execute on leads that may be generated through professional networks and industry events. Effectively position the full suite of Thoughtworks solutions

title: Business Development Manager, DACH
description:
At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!

What We Do…

We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online - quickly and simply.

We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.

And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 50,000 hotels in 150+ countries - with over 130 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.

As a Business Development Manager you will be a key driver of new business growth across the DACH region, engaging and advising customers across various segments from small independent hotels and boutique properties to large hotel groups and travel tech partners. You will be joining and representing the leading AI technology platform redefining guest acquisition and hotel revenue management. You will be relied on not just to close new business but to strategically influence pipeline growth, long-term partnerships and commercial excellence.

We won't throw you into the deep end - you'll be trained on our products, industry and sales processes. We have a month-long sales training and onboarding program to make sure you are set up for success. You will be supported by a dedicated sales coach and a buddy, as well as your team leader, who will coach, guide and motivate you to achieve your professional goals.

We know that an attractive compensation package is a key motivator in sales. SiteMinder offers you not only this, but also a working environment that represents ambition, collaboration, self-development and customer-centricity. If you identify with our core values (We Hustle, We Come Together, We Grow, We Make Things Simple) and you are a sales hunter at heart and able to work at a fast pace, we want to hear from you!

What You'll Do...

  • Lead full-cycle sales and business development: identify, engage and convert new prospects into customers.

  • Strategic territory and pipeline growth: define and execute strategic qualification routines, build segmented pipelines from your territory, and prioritise opportunities that deliver high value.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Are you a talented Senior Data Scientist looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

 

What we offer:

  • The rate depends on your skills and experience. We've already paid out over $11M to our engineers.
  • No more hunting for clients or negotiating rates — let us handle the business side of things so you can focus on what you do best.
  • We'll manually find the best project for you according to your skills and preferences.
  • Choose a schedule that works best for you. It’s possible to communicate async or minimally overlap within team working hours.
  • We respect your seniority so you can expect no micromanagement or screen trackers.
  • Most of our projects involve working in a fast-paced startup environment. We hope you like it as much as we do.

 

Requirements — Data Scientist:

  • 4+ years of commercial experience as a Data Scientist

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Python is a must

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Databricks

  • Experience with RAG and LLM is a must

 

  • Strong technical skills: as a Senior Data Scientist, you are expected to be able to create projects from scratch and have a deep understanding of application architecture.

  • Clear and effective communication in English — advanced ability to discuss business tasks, justify decisions, and communicate issues. Good self-presentation is also essential for upcoming client calls.

title: Senior Account Executive (Europe, 100% remote)
description:
Join our fully remote, mission-driven team dedicated to pioneering sustainable inflight service management. Work on innovative technology solutions with global impact, collaborate within a diverse, international environment, and continuously enhance your skills through ongoing learning opportunities.

Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland with team members across 11 countries, we offer a dynamic and engaging company culture that celebrates creativity, collaboration, and inclusion.

About the role

We are on a mission to contribute to a zero-waste future by drastically reducing food waste, fuel consumption, costs, and most importantly, CO₂ emissions in the airline industry. Every role in our company is a direct contributor to this vision and as a Senior Account Executive, you will be at the heart of the team that makes it possible.

You will report directly to one of the founders and work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, Product Management, Customer Success, and the broader founding team.

This is not a traditional SaaS sales role focused on high-volume transactions. Our customers are airlines, our sales cycles are complex, and our relationships often span many years.

You will be responsible for building and executing strategic sales plans, identifying and developing new opportunities, and managing enterprise sales cycles from initial engagement through to contract signature.

Rather than relying solely on inbound demand, you will proactively identify target airlines, build stakeholder relationships, and develop opportunities through a structured account-based sales approach.

Qui sommes-nous ?

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en apprentissage statistique et IA générative pour rejoindre le département Image Données Signal (IDS) à Télécom Paris.

Le sujet spécifique de ce post-doc porte sur la calibration des modèles génératifs pour des données. Dans la littérature, il existe très peu de résultats pratiques et théoriques concernant la capacité des modèles génératifs à fournir, au moment de l'inférence, une mesure d'incertitude sur certaines propriétés ciblées. C’est pourtant un pré-requis pour utiliser l’IA générative dans des domaines critiques tels que la santé ou la sécurité. Le post-doctorat explorera ce nouveau sujet à la lumière des outils récents de calibration en commençant pour la génération de données multivariées et étudiera à terme comment l'approche choisie peut être étendue à des données non euclidiennes telles que les graphes.

title: STAGE Fullstack - Socle générique de mini jeux temps réel (H/F)
description:
Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique.
 
Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ?
 
Techniquement, Winamax c’est :
  • Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude
  • Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme
  • Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audience

Contexte
Nos mini-jeux reposent sur la même logique de fond : une session courte, une animation qui doit rester fluide du début à la fin, un résultat traçable et auditable par le régulateur. Chaque nouveau mini jeu repart pourtant de zéro, alors que l'essentiel est commun.
 
Comment concevoir un socle générique qui permette d'en sortir un nouveau en quelques semaines, sans rien céder ni sur la fluidité ni sur l'auditabilité ?

Objectifs du stage
  • Concevoir le template générique et les API associées : cycle de vie d'une session, actions du joueur, résultats
  • Développer le socle d'interface à partir des maquettes UX/UI : L'enjeu visue

Je hebt twee rollen die elkaar versterken. Aan de ene kant lever je implementaties van A tot Z op. title: Senior DevOps Lead
description:
Location: Berlin, Germany Remote Status: Fully Remote (#LI-Remote)

LivePerson (NASDAQ: LPSN) is a leader in trusted enterprise conversational AI and digital transformation. The world's leading brands use our award-winning Conversational Cloud platform to connect with millions of consumers. We power nearly a billion conversational interactions every month, providing uniquely rich data analytics and safety tools to unlock the power of conversational AI for better business outcomes. Fast Company named LivePerson the #1 Most Innovative AI Company in the world.

Position Overview

The Observability Platform team is building a state-of-the-art observability ecosystem for logging, monitoring, and tracing across cloud and on-premises data centers. We’re looking for an experienced Senior DevOps Lead to lead our Logging and Monitoring initiatives and drive the development of robust, scalable observability solutions within Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

In this role, you’ll help build systems that give software engineers greater visibility into the health, performance, and reliability of their applications and services. You’ll oversee a modern observability technology stack that includes Elastic Cloud, Loki, Grafana Labs, and the ELK stack for logging, as well as Zabbix, Captain Hook, and Anodot for metrics, monitoring, and anomaly detection.

You Will: Key Responsibilities & Impact

  • Lead the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of LivePerson’s observability platforms across logs, metrics, traces, alerting, and synthetic monitoring.
  • Own and optimize large-scale observability pipelines processing high volumes of telemetry data daily, leveraging technologies such as Filebeat, Kafka, Logstash, Elastic Cloud, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana Labs, Zabbix, Anodot, and related tools.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, Kubernetes-based observability services using Helm, CI/CD pipelines, GCP, GKE, Docker, and cloud-native best practices.
  • Define and establish observability standards, dashboards, alerting frameworks, best practices, and onboarding resources for hundreds of engineering users.
  • Partner closely with DevOps, SRE, Engineering, NOC, Security, and vendor teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and actionable observability solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging observability technologies and drive adoption of modern practices in areas such as OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, anomaly detection, and proactive monitoring.
  • Lead the design and development of an end-to-end Synthetic Monitoring platform, running hundreds of daily synthetic tests on GCP Spot VMs to enable proactive service validation and help engineering teams identify potential issues before they impact customers.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship

title: Deputy Head of Financial Crime
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We’re looking for a Deputy Head of Financial Crime to join our financial Crime Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help safeguard the firm against financial crime risks, lead critical remediation initiatives, and drive control enhancements as part of our Financial Crime Operations team as we scale our business spend management platform. If you're excited about building robust, future-proofed compliance frameworks and leading high-performing operational teams and are passionate about financial crime prevention and regulatory excellence, then this is the opportunity for you!

eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. You are the person who makes sure the right signal reaches the ions at the right nanosecond, reliably, run after run.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Partner Integrations
description:
About the team

Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives.

Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks to link an account. The goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment.

As the founding backend engineer, you'll set the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control. You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with the team's engineering manager and a small founding group that will grow around you, but you'll be the one setting the technical direction. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk.

What you'll do

You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. You're setting the technical defaults a growing team will inherit, so the early decisions matter.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer
description:
YOUR MISSION

 

A software engineer today uses Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest.

 

We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products: one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers, with real revenue and customers who tell us when we are slow.

 

The problems are open ones. Getting an agent to reason usefully about geometry, making 3D search work on real customer part libraries, and figuring out what the interface even looks like when an engineer asks why a bracket failed. There is research to borrow from and very little product to copy.

 

Senior or staff level depending on experience.

 

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 

You will own large problems end to end, across the stack. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but here is what the last two years have actually involved.

 

  • A multi-agent orchestration SDK, built from scratch. Nothing off the shelf handled what we needed: long-horizon execution that runs for hours and survives restarts.

title: Founding Legal Engineer
description:
About Grubel

Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window.

To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands.

Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen.

Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg.

title: Senior Prototyping Engineer (f/m/d) – Thermal Systems & Cooling Integration
description:
As a Senior Prototyping Engineer – Thermal Systems & Cooling Integration, you will become an integral part of our Prototyping team, supporting the development of our Reliant platform – a next-generation long-range eVTOL unmanned aerial system designed for demanding ISR and logistics missions. Reliant combines exceptional endurance, modularity, and operational flexibility to deliver mission-critical capabilities in the most challenging environments.

In this role, you will be responsible for the integration, development, and validation of thermal management and cooling systems for the aircraft. You will develop efficient cooling concepts for hybrid propulsion components, power electronics, avionics, and other heat-generating systems by optimizing airflow, aerodynamic cooling, and thermal integration. Working closely with mechanical, propulsion, and systems engineering teams, you will ensure reliable operation across demanding flight and environmental conditions.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Lead the integration and development of thermal management and cooling systems for UAVs.

  • Design and optimize cooling concepts for combustion engines, generators, power electronics, avionics, and other onboard systems.

  • Develop aerodynamic cooling solutions, including airflow management, ducting, air inlets and outlets, heat exchangers, and passive and active cooling concepts.

  • Define thermal system architectures balancing cooling performance, weight, packaging, reliability, and manufacturability.

  • Design, build, and commission prototype cooling test rigs and instrumentation for system validation.

  • Plan and execute thermal, environmental, endurance, and performance test campaigns.

  • Analyze thermal performance, airflow distribution, and system efficiency, implementing improvements based on test results.

Das erwartet dich

Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Automatisieren und standardisieren

title: Firmware Engineer
description:
termios builds smart thermostats for real estate. Our product — termios Pro — replaces standard radiator thermostats in existing buildings, performs hydraulic balancing via a self-learning algorithm, and cuts heating energy consumption by up to 30%. No battery, no retrofitting: the device harvests energy from the temperature differential between radiator and room air (thermo-harvesting) and communicates over LoRaWAN.

The system runs at scale across multi-unit residential portfolios. Each thermostat is a constrained embedded device operating autonomously, syncing state through a LoRaWAN gateway to a cloud backend that runs the optimization logic. We're 35 people, growing, and the firmware team is small — your work ships directly to devices in real apartments.

Tasks

The firmware running on our smart thermostats — from first commit to field rollout. You write code, solder, measure, debug. No handoffs to someone else when it gets hard.

  • LoRaWAN communication stack (implementation + maintenance)
  • Low-power / energy harvesting optimization
  • OTA update mechanisms
  • Automated Hardware-in-the-loop test infrastructure (build, operate, extend)
  • Release process, Definition of Done, RED/CRA compliance
  • Field monitoring dashboards and post-rollout quality

Requirements

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years embedded/firmware development in C / C embedded
  • ARM Cortex-M architecture (bare-metal and/or RTOS)
  • Experience in Low-power design and energy efficiency
  • Knowledge of common communication protocols such as UART, I2C, SPI and hardware debugging: JTAG/SWD, logic analyzer, oscilloscope
  • Python for test automation and data analysis
  • Embedded security fundamentals
  • Degree in related engineering field

Nice-to-have:
